jobs.title: IT/AV Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** IT/AV Project Coordinator

**Department:** IT/AV Services

**IT/AV Project Coordinator - Job Summary**

Golden Star Technology (GST) is seeking an experienced **Project Coordinator** to support the successful delivery of **IT infrastructure, low-voltage, audiovisual (AV), unified communications, and technology deployment projects**. This role serves as the primary liaison between clients, internal teams, subcontractors, and project stakeholders to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and according to scope.

The ideal candidate has strong experience coordinating multiple projects, conducting **site surveys and on-site project visits**, managing project documentation, tracking schedules, and supporting cross-functional technical teams. Experience within the **IT, AV, structured cabling, low-voltage, or technology integration industry** is highly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and manage multiple IT, AV, and technology projects from initiation through completion.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, internal teams, vendors, and project stakeholders.
* Conduct **site surveys, field assessments, and on-site project visits** to gather requirements, evaluate project readiness, and support successful execution.
* Participate in project kickoff meetings and assist with project planning activities.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, timelines, resource plans, and status reports.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, budgets, risks, and action items.
* Coordinate project resources, subcontractors, vendors, and equipment deliveries.
* Monitor project performance to ensure scope, quality, budget, and timeline objectives are achieved.
* Collect, document, and manage business and technical requirements.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including project plans, meeting notes, change requests, closeout packages, and final project deliverables.
* Conduct quality assurance reviews and support project acceptance processes.
* Facilitate project status meetings and provide regular updates to stakeholders.
* Coordinate end-user training and project handoffs as needed.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum **5 years of experience** in Project Coordination, Project Management, Account Management, or a similar role supporting enterprise technology projects.
* Experience managing or coordinating **IT, AV, audiovisual, low-voltage, structured cabling, network infrastructure, or technology deployment projects**.
* **Required:** Experience conducting **site surveys, field assessments, job walks, and on-site project visits**.
* Strong understanding of project lifecycle management, scheduling, documentation, and resource coordination.
* Experience working with clients, vendors, subcontractors, and cross-functional technical teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience tracking project budgets, schedules, deliverables, and project risks.
* PMP certification or formal project management training is a plus.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive salary
* Medical / Dental / Vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation
* Additional company perks

**About GST**

Founded in 1985 and headquartered in Cerritos, CA, Golden Star Technology (GST) is a leading provider of IT and AV solutions, serving businesses, enterprise organizations, educational institutions, and government agencies nationwide. Through strategic partnerships with industry-leading technology manufacturers, GST delivers innovative solutions, customized services, and exceptional customer support.

Recognized by the Los Angeles Business Journal as one of LA's Best Places to Work for seven consecutive years, GST has also earned numerous industry awards and accolades for excellence, growth, innovation, and customer service. Our success is driven by a commitment to teamwork, integrity, accountability, and continuous professional development.

Learn more at **www.gstinc.com**

**Join us and be part of a team that drives innovation and excellence in IT/AV solutions!**

jobs.title: Project Coordinator I
jobs.description:
**About Company:**

**Element U.S. Space & Defense** stands at the forefront of testing innovation, serving as a trusted partner to NASA, the U.S. Department of Defense, government agencies, and prominent industry leaders across the space and defense sectors. Founded as NTS Technical Systems, our company brings over 60 years of experience and expertise in handling the most complex projects and programs in the world.

From centrifuge testing for the latest Mars rover, vibration testing for the Space Launch System (SLS), to environmental simulations for next-generation missiles, we are the pioneering partner for highly custom, end-to-end testing design and implementation. By advancing our state-of-the-art testing technologies, subject matter expertise, and service to critical missions, Element U.S. Space & Defense has become the go-to partner for ground-breaking industries.

**What We Offer:**

**Growth & Development:**

* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* A collaborative and innovative work environment.
* The chance to work on groundbreaking projects that shape the future of space and defense.

**Benefits:**  
Employees are eligible to participate in the benefits offered throughout their availability, including the following:

* Medical, Dental, Vision, Short- and Long-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts
* Seven (7) paid holidays and four (4) paid floating holidays, depending on your hire date
* Paid Time Off (PTO), accrued biweekly
* 401k with employer match
* Twelve (12) hours of Paid Volunteer Time Off (PVTO) each year
* Tuition reimbursement and other employee programs
* Flexible schedules offered at some of our labs
* Monthly Lab Bonus plans (Based on position)

**Salary:**  
At EUSSD, compensation is determined through a comprehensive approach that considers candidate qualifications, role responsibilities, market benchmarks, and organizational needs. Pay may vary by location; for this position, the annual base salary target range is $21.00 - $23.00/hr, with potential eligibility for bonuses or commission depending on the role.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Manages a book of active customer orders that consists primarily of quick-turn, transactional work. Primarily focused on ensuring production testing is completed on time (speed of completion is a priority). Manages the flow of work within or between departments. Provides the level of customer engagement required by type of project and specific customer to ensure the customer's needs and expectations are met. Acts as a customer service representative and focuses on creating a positive customer experience.

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:**

* Takes complete ownership of projects within book of business. Ownership entails:
* Fulfilling our commitments and customer needs,
* Delivering projects to operations in a timely manner to ensure schedule commitments can be met (CRDs and PDDs),
* Understanding project success means ensuring the project is completed on-time
* Providing customers with the expected amount of communication,
* Coordinating the flow of work through the facility with Customers and Department Managers,
* Consistently using the best practices of project coordination,
* Establishing collaborative and mutually supportive relationship with those responsible for operations,
* Striving to make operations successful.

**CORE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Performs duties for standard work with the use of standard SOPs.
* Ensures production tests are completed on-time.
* Works with operations to expedite testing through the facility.
* Follows standard practices and procedures in managing order book.
* Builds productive internal and external working relationships.
* May be responsible for billing of projects.
* Proactively manages planned subcontracted work (i.e: IJOs and non-EUSSD subcontractors) including setting expectations with the subcontractor and monitoring subcontractor progress.
* With assistance, able to manage unplanned subcontracted work.
* Primarily repeat work (operations as opposed to projects).
* Is primary point of contact for customer questions.
* Usually minimal customer interaction required due to quick timing of testing.
* Communication typically limited to confirmation of receipt/testing (CRD) initiation and test completion (PDD).
* Communicates schedule changes to the customer.

**MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* 1 - 3 years' experience. Customer service experience required.
* Must be organized and practice time management.
* Must have strong communication skills to work with different internal partners and customers.
* Applies company policies and procedures to resolve routine issues.
* Basic MS office skills.
* Basic skills in prescribed internal tools (scheduling, ERP, etc.).

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

Test lab with exposure to sudden, loud noises

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; climb stairs; balance; stoop; kneel; crouch or crawl; talk or hear; taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

**EEO POLICY STATEMENT:**

It is the policy of EUSSD to offer Equal Employment Opportunity to all individuals without regards to race, creed, ancestry, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, age, national origin, physical disabilities, pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions.

Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V

jobs.description:
**Job no:** 562875
  
**Work type:** Staff
  
**Location:** Pomona
  
**Categories:** Unit 4 - APC - Academic Professionals of California, Probationary, Full Time, Student Services, On-site (work in-person at business location)

**Type of Appointment:** Full Time, Probationary
  
  
**Job Classification:** Student Services Professional III
  
  
**Anticipated Hiring Range:** $5,540 per month
  
  
**Work Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; schedule may vary based on operational needs and may include occasional evenings and weekends in support of orientation and transition programs.  
  
  
  
**THE DEPARTMENT:**
  
  
New Student Programs and Family Engagement is responsible for preparing entering students for academic and personal success by providing an effective transition to the university from the point of admission through the end of the students' first year. New Student Programs and Family Engagement provides information, communications, and services to incoming students and their support system to orient them to the traditions, mission, philosophy, and culture of the campus and to make them knowledgeable about Cal Poly Pomona's opportunities, resources, challenges, and programs. New Student Programs and Family Engagement designs, plans, implements, and assesses mandatory online and in-person orientation events, as well as the ongoing engagement of family members and supporters throughout the academic year. The position will bring together existing decentralized institutional programs, services and activities for parents and families under one functional administrative structure to ensure optimum coordination and resource management, timely response and referral and identification of additional opportunities to enhance parent/family relations and outreach. New Student Programs and Family Engagement serves as the administrative office for the mandatory student orientation programs, parent/family orientation, and parent/family communication. The office is responsible for compliance with federal, state, CSU System, and University requirements and the timely and accurate dissemination of information to students, parents, families, supporters, and campus constituents. New Student Programs and Family Engagement is housed within the Division of Student Affairs and is part of the Student Experience cluster that reports to the Director of New Student Programs and Family Engagement. New Student Programs and Family Engagement works collaboratively with campus partners in support of enrollment management goals, student success and retention, equity and belonging, and institutional planning efforts. The Division of Student Affairs strives for excellence through a shared student-centered philosophy and values of collaboration, inclusivity, integrity, innovation, and student-centeredness. In performing the duties assigned to this position, the incumbent is expected to consistently demonstrate attitudes and behaviors that are in keeping with the division's philosophy and values.
  
  
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Student Leader Development & Program Leadership

* Coordinate the recruitment, selection, onboarding, and training of approximately 40 Orientation Captains and Orientation Leaders.
* Recommend student employees for hire and, when necessary, recommend appropriate corrective action or separation in consultation with the Senior Coordinator and Director.
* Develop and implement training that prepares student leaders to support incoming students and families during orientation and transition programs.
* Develop student staff work schedules and assign duties based on orientation and program needs.
* Provide day-to-day work direction, coaching, feedback, and clarification of performance and conduct expectations.
* Monitor student staff performance and provide input into performance evaluations in accordance with department and university practices. Develop learning opportunities for student leaders in areas such as communication, conflict resolution, peer support, student wellbeing, customer service, campus resources, and referral practices.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of student-leader training and recommend improvements based on program needs and assessment results.

Orientation and Transition Planning & Implementation

* Plan and coordinate orientation and transition programs in collaboration with the Senior Coordinator, Director, and campus partners.
* Develop program learning outcomes, activities, and assessment strategies that support incoming students' transition to the university.
* Coordinate New Student Convocation, welcome activities, and other transition experiences, including program logistics, campus partnerships, communications, and implementation.
* Analyze participant feedback, program assessment results, and identified student needs to recommend improvements to orientation and transition programming.
* Research and recommend student engagement activities that support peer connection, belonging, student success, and continued transition throughout the first year.
* Serve as a program lead during assigned orientation and transition programs, coordinating student staff and addressing operational or student-service issues within established guidelines.
* Collaborate with Student Affairs, Academic Affairs, colleges, and other university departments to coordinate information, resources, and services for incoming students.

New Student Enrollment Support

* Provide information and guidance to incoming students regarding orientation, transition, and enrollment-related processes.
* Identify the nature of student concerns, explain applicable university processes and requirements, and assist students in identifying appropriate resources and available courses of action.
* Refer students to academic advising, enrollment services, student support programs, or other campus resources as appropriate.
* Collaborate with Academic Affairs, college advising units, and other campu

jobs.title: Mobile Optometry Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
***Starting salaries are set in accordance with our compensation plan, which considers multiple individual and organizational factors, including internal equity. To uphold pay equity in alignment with the compensation plan, starting salary ranges are not negotiable. Before applying, please ensure that the compensation for this position meets your needs.***

**Our Mission**

To promote the well-being of the underserved by providing access to high-quality healthcare for all, regardless of ability to pay.

Our services, activities and governance reflect the Islamic values and moral principles which inspired our founders. These include the core values which are universally shared and revered by society at large: Service, Compassion, Human Dignity, Social Justice, and Ethical Conduct.

**Working at UMMA**

UMMA is looking for passionate and mission-driven Staff who look to make an impact on the lives of our patients and the members of our community. These roles include Physicians and Medical Staff, Behavioral Health Staff, Administration, and more! For more information on the services we provide, Click Here

**Benefits and Compensation**

UMMA offers a competitive compensation and benefits package with comprehensive and cost-effective medical plans. Benefits package includes Medical, Dental, Vision, AD&D and Supplemental Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Program Tuition Reimbursement, loan repayment opportunities, 403(b) savings plan, employee discounts, extended lunch on Fridays, and more!

Our compensation plan also includes Paid Holidays, Paid Time Off (accruals begin on the first day of hire), Employee Recognition, and more!!

**SUMMARY**
-----------

The Mobile Optometry Program Coordinator is responsible for coordinating patient access, scheduling, registration, school-site logistics, outreach, and follow-up activities for the Mobile Optometry Program. This position serves as the primary front-office and patient coordination resource for mobile optometry services and serves as the primary driver and logistics lead for the mobile optometry vehicle.

The Mobile Optometry Program Coordinator works closely with schools, clinic staff, patients, families, the Optometry Assistant, and the Program Manager to ensure patients are identified, registered, scheduled, prepared, and ready for their optometry services. At school locations, the Program Coordinator serves as the primary onsite liaison with school personnel and coordinates the movement and readiness of students scheduled to receive services. At clinic and community sites, the coordinator organizes patient arrival, registration, waiting areas, and flow into the mobile optometry unit.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**
--------------------

**Patient Scheduling and Registration**

* Coordinate scheduling of patients for mobile and portable optometry services.
* Contact patients and families to schedule or confirm appointments.
* Verify demographic and contact information prior to appointments.
* Obtain or coordinate collection of insurance information.
* Assist patients and families with completion of required registration forms, consents, questionnaires, and other documentation.
* Identify incomplete registration information before scheduled service dates and conduct outreach to resolve outstanding items.
* Coordinate appointment reminders through telephone calls, text messages, electronic systems, or other approved methods.
* Maintain accurate appointment schedules and patient rosters.
* Work to fill cancelled appointments and unused appointment capacity.

**School Coordination**

* Serve as the day-of-service operational contact for school administrators, nurses, teachers, office personnel, and other designated school staff.
* Receive and maintain approved student appointment rosters.
* Coordinate with school staff to identify students who are scheduled to receive services.
* Assist with coordinating students' release from classrooms according to school procedures.
* Escort or coordinate students from designated areas to the mobile optometry service location when appropriate.
* Ensure students are returned to the appropriate school location following completion of services.
* Track students who are absent, unavailable, decline services, or cannot be seen and coordinate rescheduling when appropriate.
* Communicate schedule changes, delays, or operational concerns to school representatives and the Program Manager.
* Protect student and patient privacy when coordinating services in school environments.

**Mobile Site Setup and Patient Flow**

* Serve as the onsite logistics lead for patient arrival and waiting-area operations.
* Establish and organize registration and waiting areas outside the mobile unit when appropriate, including tents, tables, chairs, signage, and registration materials.
* Check patients in and confirm completion of required documentation before entering the mobile unit.
* Coordinate patient flow with the Optometry Assistant to prevent congestion and unnecessary delays.
* Communicate delays and estimated wait times to patients, families, and school personnel as appropriate.
* Assist with setup and breakdown of mobile service locations.

**Outreach and Patient Communication**

* Serve as a primary telephone and program contact for patients and families.
* Answer general questions regarding appointments, mobile service locations, registration requirements, eyeglass delivery, and program processes.
* Conduct outreach to patients who miss appointments or require rescheduling.
* Provide approved instructions regarding where patients should report for services and what documentation they should bring.
* Assist patients with navigating follow-up appointments and other non-clinical next steps.
* Route clinical questions to the Optometry Assistant, licensed optometrist, or appropriate clinical staff.

**Eyeglass and Follow-Up Coordination**

* Track patients requiring eyeglasses or additional follow-up following their optometry examination

jobs.title: Production Coordinator, A+E Studios
jobs.description:
A+E Global Media offers a work environment where employees collaborate in office 3 times per week. New hires must be commutable to one of our current office locations in New York City, Los Angeles, Chicago, and Stamford, CT. Please refer to the job description for any specific division requirements.

**Division Story**
==================

A+E Global Media is not in the television business. It’s in the storytelling business. Our job is to bring consumers new ways to experience those stories. We get up every day excited to discover new talent, narratives and characters, and live for any chance to shepherd a great idea through development to air.

**Job Description**
===================

**THE ROLE:**
=============

The **Production Coordinator** supports the Head of Production by managing complex scheduling, production documentation, reporting, travel logistics, payment processing, and cross-department coordination across multiple scripted television projects.

This role serves as a central operational hub for Studio Production as a bridge with Creative, Finance, Business Affairs, Legal, and external partners. The Production Coordinator ensures accurate documentation, timely communication, and smooth execution of workflows throughout development, prep, production, and post.

**MORE ABOUT WHAT YOU'LL DO:**
==============================

**Executive & Studio Support:**
-------------------------------

  

* Provide daily operational and administrative support to the Head of Production and as needed, the scripted production team.
* Prepare and send a daily agenda outlining meetings, priorities, deadlines, and production updates.
* Manage high-volume calendars and coordinate executive-level meetings across multiple departments and time zones.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for internal Studio teams and external partners.

**Scheduling & Meeting Coordination:**
--------------------------------------

  

* Maintain the daily schedule for the HOP. Schedule various department meetings for Head of Production and larger group meetings for the scripted production team with production service companies, producers, vendors, agencies, and production facilities.
* Lead the coordination of series production and concept meetings in collaboration with production office teams.
* Create internal Studio calendar invites for all external series production meetings as needed.
* Support pre-commencement kick-off meetings and post-mortem sessions through agenda preparation and coordination of all key participants.
* Capture detailed notes and action items during meetings, maintaining accurate records in Airtable and Box.

**Studio P-Report Management:**
-------------------------------

  

* Coordinate weekly reminders with Production and Production Finance teams to ensure meeting updates are collected and accurately reflected in the Excel tracker.
* Share materials in advance of meeting, screen share as needed, and note changes, comments and corrections during the weekly Studio meeting.

**Payment Processing:**

  

* Prepare and coordinate execution of commission agreements.
* Gather individual/Loanout company information and ensure alignment with internal payment processing requirements.
* Ensure agreement details match Production Finance payment records to avoid delays.
* Track and update payment statuses regularly in Airtable.

**Travel Coordination for the Head of Production:**
---------------------------------------------------

  

* Book executive travel through Disney Global Travel, including hotel, flights and ground transportation.
* Create travel itineraries and team travel grids as needed.
* Monitor travel expenses, manage itinerary changes, create travel agendas, and resolve travel related issues as they arise.

**Expense Management:**

  

* Manage expense reporting for the Head of Production including receipt collection, approval tracking, and resolution of returned submissions.
* Ensure compliance with A+E’s travel and expense policy.

**Asset & Document Management:**
--------------------------------

  

* Coordinate retrieval, delivery, and storage of production assets.
* Oversee digital document organization for scripted projects across Box and Scenechronize.
* Maintain and update project document trackers and studio comparison grids.

**General Meetings & Vetting Support:**
---------------------------------------

  

* Support the coordination of vetting meetings for production service partners and key production roles, tracking meetings and follow-ups in Airtable.
* Support cross-team communication with Production, Finance, Legal, and Creative leadership.

**On-Call & Studio Operations:**
--------------------------------

  

* Remain flexible and responsive in a fast-paced production environment.
* Support urgent production issues and last-minute scheduling needs.
* Serve as a point of contact for external teams seeking project status updates.
* Track long-term Studio deadlines, offsites, and departmental initiatives.

**BASIC REQUIREMENTS:**
=======================

  

* 2+ years of relevant industry experience
* Are local to the L.A. area and will work from Century City office 3 to 4 days a week.
* Have a positive and upbeat demeanor with strong time management and multitasking skills
* Strong communication, written, and organizational skills are essential
* Candidate must be able to work well in a fast-paced environment, work independently and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines
* Must work well in a team environment and maintain strong internal and external relationships.
* Passion for TV and cutting-edge technology and content
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Airtable and Scenechronize and familiar with on set paperwork.
* Must be able to handle maintain confidentiality

jobs.title: Jewelry Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Production Coordinator is responsible for helping manage the daily flow of production from order entry through completion, quality review, and preparation for invoicing and shipment.

This position works closely with Production, Sales, Client Services, Accounting, Shipping, management, and outside vendors to ensure orders are progressing according to schedule, completed accurately, and meet MICHAEL M's quality standards.

The Production Coordinator is expected to maintain clear visibility into active orders, proactively identify delays or discrepancies, and follow through until issues are resolved.

Position Responsibilities

**Production Coordination and Order Management**

* Coordinate daily production orders and ensure orders are progressing according to schedule.
* Track production orders from start to finish and monitor expected completion and delivery dates.
* Coordinate with the production team to obtain accurate and timely updates on active orders.
* Identify orders that are delayed or at risk of missing their required delivery date and escalate concerns promptly.
* Prioritize and closely monitor rush orders, special orders, and other time-sensitive requests.
* Communicate with vendors and outside suppliers regarding materials, components, backorders, outstanding items, and rush requirements.
* Follow up consistently on outstanding production issues until they are resolved.
* Coordinate with Production, Sales, Client Services, Accounting, and Shipping to help ensure orders move efficiently through each stage of the process.

**Quality Control and Order Accuracy**

* Inspect finished merchandise for quality, workmanship, condition, and accuracy before products move to invoicing or shipment.
* Review completed merchandise against production orders, invoices, customer requirements, and applicable specifications.
* Verify item numbers, quantities, sizes, metals, materials, pricing, and other relevant order information.
* Confirm that finished merchandise matches the original order requirements and production instructions.
* Identify quality concerns, order discrepancies, missing information, or other issues before merchandise is invoiced or shipped.
* Communicate discrepancies to the appropriate department and coordinate corrections as needed.
* Assist in maintaining consistent MICHAEL M quality and accuracy standards throughout the production and fulfillment process.

**Order Processing and Documentation**

* Assist with order processing, quotes, production documentation, and other order-related requirements.
* Maintain accurate production statuses, notes, expected completion dates, and supporting information within company systems.
* Maintain organized and accurate production, quality control, and order records.
* Ensure relevant production updates and changes are communicated to the appropriate departments.
* Verify that required information and documentation are complete before orders move to the next stage.

**Production Reporting and Issue Resolution**

* Prepare weekly production reports for management.
* Maintain visibility into open orders, overdue orders, upcoming due dates, rush orders, backorders, and orders at risk of delay.
* Identify recurring production delays, bottlenecks, quality issues, or process problems and communicate them to management.
* Work with management and the appropriate departments to resolve production problems and minimize their impact on customer delivery dates.
* Assist with additional production and operational responsibilities as needed.

Core Expectations

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator (Contract)
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

**Role Overview:**

*This is a* ***6-month contract position*** *with the potential for extension or conversion to a full-time role based on performance and business needs. This role offers a strong opportunity to gain exposure to a fast-paced, high-growth recruiting environment and make a meaningful impact from day one.*

As a Recruiting Coordinator at CHAOS, you'll be a key player in driving our growth and expansion. Your role is vital in shaping the future success of our company, from managing daily recruitment activities to fostering positive candidate relationships throughout the entire process. You will be instrumental in creating a lasting impression on prospective candidates, setting the tone for their journey with us!

In this role, you'll report into our Recruiting Operations Manager and regularly partner with Recruiters and hiring teams to support the rapid development of our dynamic team. Your responsibilities encompass overseeing all aspects of the employee lifecycle, from interview scheduling, related logistics, and onboarding activities. Beyond that, you'll actively contribute to identifying opportunities for enhanced efficiency & improvements while exercising creativity and innovation toward making our experiences top-notch. Your primary objective will be to ensure an outstanding candidate & employee experience, making you an indispensable partner in guiding candidates seamlessly through our recruitment process and into their exciting career journey at CHAOS.

**Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate major aspects of the employee lifecycle from interview scheduling requests for candidates to executing onboarding tasks to assisting with new hire orientations

* Use (and identify where gaps exist) software tools to manage candidate logistics throughout the recruiting process such as booking travel & lodging accommodations, troubleshooting through last-minute scheduling changes, and facilitating onsite interview operations
* Liaise with hiring teams to ensure timely interview attendance, collect feedback and relay next steps for candidates while keeping hiring managers up to date on candidate statuses & recruiting process
* Manage logistics of the onsite interview process for candidates including: scheduling, facilitating tours, setting up conference rooms, ensuring interviewer attendance, and troubleshooting last-minute schedule changes
* Identify opportunities for process and system improvements, addressing bottlenecks and enhancing scheduling efficiency
* Cultivate strong relationships with key stakeholders, including hiring teams, Operations and IT team members
* Participate in projects to support the recruiting function
* Work full-time onsite out of our office in Los Angeles (Hawthorne), California

**Minimum Requirements:**

* 2+ years of experience in an administrative role with high-volume scheduling; preferably in a fast-paced environment
* Track record of supporting multiple scheduling or customer needs at a time with a high level of urgency
* Strong customer service mindset; proven ability to provide a candidate-first mentality, prioritizing the candidate experience throughout the recruitment process
* Process-oriented mindset with a passion for process improvement, efficiency and organization
* Ability to connect and relate to a wide range of people, personalities, and values
* Ability to thrive in a constantly evolving environment with shifting priorities
* Willingness to work in-person out of our Los Angeles (Hawthorne) office location 5 days per week

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience using ATS applications; Greenhouse experience is highly preferred
* Experience scheduling within Microsoft Outlook
* Familiarity with Slack
* Interest in the Tech Recruiting/Talent Acquisition/People Operations function as a career path

**Why CHAOS?**

* **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
* **Additional benefits**: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
* **Our Perks:** Free daily lunch, 'No meeting Fridays', unlimited PTO, casual dress code
* **Compensation Components:** Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
* **Team Growth:** 450 employees and counting across 5 global offices

***Hourly Range: $28.00 - $36.00***

*The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.*

jobs.title: Retail Merchandise Coordinator at Angel Stadium
jobs.description:
**LEGENDS GLOBAL**

Legends Global is the premier partner to the world's greatest live events, venues, and brands. We deliver a fully integrated solution of premium services that keeps our partners front and center through our white-label approach. Our network of 450 venues worldwide, hosting 20,000 events and entertaining 165 million guests each year, is powered by our depth of expertise and level of execution across every component feasibility & consulting, owner’s representation, sales, partnerships, hospitality, merchandise, venue management, and content & booking of world-class live events and venues.

The Legends Global culture is one of respect, ambitious thinking, collaboration, and bold action. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can be authentic, make an impact, and grow their career. Winning is an everyday thing at Legends Global. We have the best team members who understand every win is earned when we come together as one unified team. Sounds like a winning formula for you. **Join us!**

**PRIMARY FUNCTION:**

The Retail Coordinator / Merchandising Coordinator plays an important role in delivering an exceptional fan shopping experience by supporting the day-to-day merchandising and retail operations at Angel Stadium.

This position is responsible for executing visual merchandising standards, supporting product launches, maintaining retail presentation, coordinating promotional activations, and partnering with store leadership to ensure merchandise is displayed effectively and stores are prepared for every event.

Working closely with the Retail Director, Operations Manager, Warehouse, and Store Managers, the Retail Coordinator helps create engaging shopping environments that drive sales while maintaining brand standards across all retail locations.

This position is ideal for a creative, organized, and energetic individual who enjoys working in a fast-paced retail environment and has a passion for merchandising, retail presentation, and delivering exceptional guest experiences.

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Visual Merchandising**

* Execute visual merchandising standards across all retail locations.
* Set merchandise displays based on seasonal themes, promotional campaigns, and product launches.
* Maintain store presentation, fixture organization, and product placement to maximize sales.
* Create compelling merchandise displays that enhance the guest shopping experience.
* Ensure promotional signage, pricing, and marketing materials are accurate and properly displayed.
* Assist with window displays, feature tables, and promotional floor sets.

**Retail Operations**

* Support daily retail operations across all stadium retail locations.
* Conduct routine store walks to identify merchandising opportunities and ensure stores meet presentation standards.
* Assist store managers with product placement and merchandising adjustments based on sales trends.
* Coordinate merchandising for Opening Day, postseason, concerts, giveaways, and special events.
* Help prepare stores for new merchandise launches and promotional activations.
* Maintain clean, organized, and guest-ready retail environments.

**Merchandise Planning Support**

* Assist the Purchasing & Inventory team with new product launches and seasonal assortments.
* Provide feedback on merchandise placement, customer shopping behaviors, and product performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve product visibility and increase sales.
* Support markdown execution and promotional merchandise transitions.
* Assist in setting planograms and merchandising guides.

**Team Support**

* Partner with Store Managers to maintain consistent merchandising standards.
* Assist with training retail staff on merchandising expectations and product presentation.
* Collaborate with Warehouse and Retail Operations to ensure stores remain properly merchandised throughout events.
* Support special projects, store resets, remodels, and new retail initiatives.
* Provide additional operational support during high-volume events as needed.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Must be at least 18 years old
* Experience in professional sports, entertainment, hospitality, or high-volume retail environments.
* Experience executing visual merchandising standards across multiple retail locations.
* Experience setting planograms and promotional displays.
* Knowledge of retail sales trends and customer shopping behavior.
* Experience supporting product launches and seasonal merchandising initiatives.
* Ability to interpret sales data to improve merchandise presentation.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to work throughout the stadium, including office, retail, and stockroom environments.
* Ability to walk and stand for extended periods.
* Ability to climb ladders and adjust merchandise displays safely.
* Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull merchandise weighing up to 30 pounds regularly and up to 50 pounds occasionally.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

**SCHEDULE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Must be available to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and all Angel Stadium events as business needs require.
* Occasional extended hours may be required during Opening Day, postseason, concerts, and special events.

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

**Location:** On-Site at Angel Stadium in Anaheim, CA.

**COMPENSATION:**

**Hourly Rate:** $27 Part-Time Seasonal

**NOTE:**

The essential responsibilities of this position are described below the above headings. They may be subject to change at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons. Also, this document in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant (Bilingual in Chinese)
jobs.description:
**GENERAL FUNCTION / SUMMARY**

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Executive Assistant to provide high-level administrative support to multiple senior executives while taking ownership of day-to-day operational coordination, including purchasing, vendor management, and shipment tracking. The ideal candidate is proactive, resourceful, and thrives in a fast-paced environment managing competing priorities.

This role requires excellent communication skills, strong judgment, and the ability to maintain confidentiality at all times. Bilingual proficiency in English and Chinese is required.

**MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**ExecutiveAdministrative Support:**

* Manage and coordinate complex calendars for multiple executives, including scheduling meetings, appointments, and resolving scheduling conflicts
* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, and detailed itineraries
* Serve as a primary point of contact between executives and internal/external stakeholders
* Prioritize and manage incoming requests, ensuring alignment with executive priorities
* Prepare, proofread, and manage correspondence, reports, and presentations
* Organize meetings, including agenda preparation, logistics coordination, note-taking, and follow-ups
* Track deadlines, action items, and deliverables across multiple executives
* Handle confidential and sensitive information with the highest level of discretion
* Assist with event planning and coordination as needed
* Support special projects and cross-functional initiatives

**Operations, LogisticsProcurement:**

* Own and manage procurement processes, including sourcing, vendor coordination, and purchase order execution
* Coordinate and track shipments, deliveries, and order fulfillment to ensure on-time and accurate delivery
* Communicate directly with vendors and suppliers to resolve issues, negotiate timelines, and prevent disruptions
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate replenishment to avoid shortages or overstock
* Process and reconcile purchase orders, invoices, and expense tracking with high accuracy
* Maintain organized and up-to-date records of vendors, orders, and logistics activities
* Identify operational inefficiencies and proactively implement process improvements
* Support cost control efforts through vendor comparison, pricing analysis, and negotiation

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Proven experience as an Executive Assistant supporting multiple executives or senior leadership
* Bilingual in English (written and verbal) and Chinese (verbal)
* Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to multitask and perform under tight deadlines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to exercise sound judgment
* High level of professionalism and discretion
* Experience in operations, logistics, procurement, or a related field (experience supporting executives is a plus)
* Experience with vendor management, purchasing, and shipment tracking

**Preferred Qualifications**

* At least 5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant
* Experience supporting C-level executives
* Experience in financial industries
* Familiarity with travel booking platforms and expense reporting systems
* Experience coordinating across multiple departments or teams
* Experience with inventory management systems, ERP platforms, or procurement tools
* Background in supply chain, distribution, or operations-heavy environments
* Experience with cost analysis, budgeting, or vendor negotiations
* Comfortable handling high-volume operational workflows

**Additional Expectations**

* Ability to act as a gatekeeper and effectively manage executive time and priorities
* Proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate needs and address issues before they arise
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
* Occasional flexibility outside standard business hours, as needed
* Takes ownership of tasks and drives them through completion with minimal supervision

**WHO WE ARE**

With over 30 years of experience, TransGlobal has grown into the largest Asian-focused, all-in-one financial services platform in the U.S. We offer a comprehensive suite of services-including life and health insurance, annuities, real estate, private lending, tax and estate planning, and investment management-through a network of 30+ branches across 14 states and over 5,000 professional independent agents. Our mission is to deliver trustworthy, customer-centric financial solutions, all in your language and aligned with your goals.

**WHY JOIN US**

* **Industry Leader**: Join the nation's largest Asian-focused financial services firm with a well-established brand and expansive network.
* **MultilingualMulticultural**: Work in a dynamic, diverse environment that understands and serves multicultural communities.
* **Career Growth**: Access to cross-functional training, licensing support, and professional development opportunities.
* **Collaborative Culture**: Be part of a supportive team that values innovation, initiative, and shared success.
* **Impactful Work**: Help individuals and families achieve financial security and generational wealth.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to work in a collaborative and innovative environment.
* Professional development and growth opportunities.
* Pay starts at $25 ~ $38/hour based on experience.

jobs.description:
**About Westlake Financial**

Westlake Financial is the largest privately held auto finance company in the United States with demonstrated growth year over year. We continue to expand our teams and diversify our business model. This leads to cementing us as a leader in the automotive lending industry.

Westlake continues to grow its market share within the Auto Industry with assets in excess of 22B. We have business relationships in all 50 states, including Puerto Rico. We are looking to acquire talented individuals as we expand our market share. Westlake Financial believes in PEOPLE with the PURPOSE and PASSION to assist our more than 22,000 dealer partners throughout North America.

Our Account Manager – Internal Sales Representatives are individuals with the vision and dedication to provide world-class customer service to our dealer partners through training and prospecting for business opportunities. This is a challenging, dynamic position with high earnings potential and opportunities for career advancement.

The Account Manager – Internal Sales Representative position offers a highly incentivized performance-based compensation package. A motivated and driven individual can earn up to and beyond a six-figure income.

We invite you to learn more about the position, please visit https://www.westlakefinancial.com/employee-recruitment/ (https://www.westlakefinancial.com/employee-recruitment/)

  

**Job Description**

Our Account managers create and nurture ongoing relationship contacts with our number one customer – our dealers. Your objective is to increase the number of deals funded by partnering with nationwide dealers who will be a good fit. Your ability to identify, onboard, and manage growth with dealers around the US from our headquarters office locations.

Being in a fast-paced environment, this role requires a consultative sales and management approach. Each Account Manager will manage their own dealer base to understand the Westlake Program so they can grow and succeed.

This is a full-time position including full-time benefits. We are looking for highly motivated, highly dedicated candidates who are comfortable working in an office-based team environment.

  

**What is it like being part of the Westlake Team?**

* New Hire training is provided to ensure your success in your new role. This training will prepare and provide you with proper knowledge and skills to perform the role successfully.
* You will be part of a positive environment and supportive team where you will be encouraged to raise questions, promote ideas to yield good results.
* We are a well-established and constantly growing auto finance company; we believe in PEOPLE with the PURPOSE and PASSION.

  

**What will you do as our Account Manager - Internal Sales Representative?**

* Present and communicate company products and services to all levels of management within Independent and Franchise Dealerships
* Identify sales prospects and contact these and other accounts assigned to you
* Follow-up on new CRM generated leads and referrals resulting from telephone calls to Independent and Franchise Dealerships
* Develop, maintain and grow current and potential dealer partners within the Independent and Franchise Dealer communities
* Constant and effective communication via phone, email and video meetings with dealer partners to train on current programs and fast funding requirements
* Provide solutions, rehash and restructure vehicle loans for approval in a profitable manner for Westlake and the Dealership Partners

  

**Qualifications**

**Qualities we look for in our Account Manager - Internal Sales Representative?**

* Demonstrated experience in Automotive, Finance and Sales (preferred)
* 1-2 year’s previous experience in a Sales role with a proven track record of success
* High School Diploma required
* College degree (preferred or equivalent work experience)
* Strong knowledge of warm calling, appointment setting, and sales techniques
* Clear and effective presentation skills
* Strong Interpersonal and communication skills
* Knowledge of advertising and sales promotion techniques
* Strong computer skills, telephone management, and adaptability to new technology
* Goal oriented with a desire for improvement and advancement
* Able to communicate and work amicably with diverse teams

  

**Benefits**

**What is our pay plan?**

* Target first year income: $55,000.00 - $130,000.00
* Self-determined, performance-based compensation package
* Hourly position, $18.47/hr + performance-based commissions and bonuses
  + 6-month compensation guarantee of $5,000.00 monthly, Then another 6-month compensation guarantee of $4,000.00 monthly
  + Average rep earnings after 1 year - $160,000.00
  + Average earnings of the top 25% reps - $245,00.00
  + Average earnings of the top 50 reps - $305,000.00
* No limit on commissions
* The exact starting compensation to be offered will be determined at the time of selecting an applicant for hire and will be dependent on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to geographic location, skill set, experience, education, credentials, and licensure when applicable

  

**Full Time Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
* Life Insurance and Long-term disability plans
* Flexible Spending Account
* 401K matching
* Employee Stock Ownership Program in a $18.2 Billion Company, plus company matching
* Wellness Programs
* Metro Tap Card and Metro-link Reimbursement (for Los Angeles, CA employees only)
* Career Path Opportunities
* Discounts on Parks, Museums, Movie Tickets, and Attractions
* Annual Flu Shot
* Paid Vacations Days
* Paid Sick days
* Paid holidays
* HGym (available in our Los Angeles, CA & Dallas, TX office)
* Rental Car Discounts, Dell Member Purchase Program
* UKG Wallet

  

**Acknowledgement**

jobs.title: Digital Marketing and Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**About:**  
IJW Whiskey Company, LLC (IJW) is a dynamic, fully integrated spirits company. Founded in 2017, we’ve compiled the largest independent library of aged Kentucky bourbon and rye and established a global presence including offices in Beverly Hills, Louisville and Tokyo, Japan, a 40-acre campus in Danville. Our ambitious growth trajectory includes a new whiskey distillery in Shelbyville, KY, slated for completion in early 2026, and a Japanese distillery in Chitose that that will be completed in late 2026.
  
  
With over 100 years of combined industry expertise, our diverse team of seasoned professionals and dynamic newcomers has propelled IJW to the forefront of the spirits industry. Our strategic partnership with one of the nation's largest independent Wine & Spirits distributors has enabled us to offer 22 products across four unique private label bourbon brands in 28 states. We have added to our spirits portfolio with our first Tequila and Mezcal brands.
  
  
Role Overview
  
The Digital Marketing and Social Media Manager, reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, is responsible for building and growing digital marketing as a key strategic pillar of the IJW organization. You will drive brand awareness, engagement, and e-commerce performance through social media, content marketing, influencer partnerships, and paid digital advertising. This role is ideal for a creative, data-driven marketer who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment and understands how to build impactful digital brand ecosystems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Digital Strategy and Execution
  

* Develop and implement integrated digital marketing strategies across social media, paid media, email, and SEO to enhance brand awareness and drive conversions.
* Lead and evolve IJW’s digital marketing function, aligning efforts with business goals and brand positioning.
* Manage digital marketing budgets, ensuring effective allocation across paid social, programmatic advertising, and e-commerce initiatives.

Social Media and Content Creation
  

* Oversee organic social media strategy and execution for all brands, ensuring engaging and brand-aligned storytelling.
* Build and nurture online communities, fostering brand advocacy and consumer engagement.
* Collaborate with internal and external teams to develop high-quality visual and written content.

E-Commerce and Digital Advertising
  

* Optimize global and local e-commerce strategies, ensuring seamless integration with third-party retailers and DTC platforms.
* Plan and execute paid digital campaigns to maximize brand visibility and consumer acquisition.

Analytics, Optimization, and Innovation
  

* Analyze performance metrics across all digital channels, providing insights to optimize strategies and improve ROI.
* Stay ahead of digital marketing trends, tools, and best practices to maintain a competitive edge.

**Qualifications:**  

* 5+ years of digital marketing experience, preferably in the spirits, beverage alcohol, or luxury consumer goods industry.
* Proven ability to grow social media communities, manage content creation, and drive digital engagement.
* Strong understanding of SEO, paid media, e-commerce marketing, and influencer strategy.
* Analytical mindset with experience using Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, and social media management tools.
* Entrepreneurial and creative thinker who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Passionate about the spirits industry, with a deep appreciation for whiskey, bourbon, and tequila.

Why Join IJW Whiskey Company?
  

* Industry Disruptor: Rapidly growing spirits company with a global footprint and a unique portfolio of premium brands.
* High-Impact Role: Entrepreneurial environment where your ideas drive real business results.
* Collaborative Culture: Work with experienced industry leaders in a creative, fast-paced, and dynamic team.
* Competitive Benefits: Attractive salary, benefits, and perks to reward top talent.

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us**

At Veneto Luce and V2 Lighting International Inc., we provide luxury lighting solutions and trade resources to designers, contractors, and developers. Our 15,000-square-foot North Hollywood showroom serves as a premier destination for high-end architectural and decorative lighting. We are looking for an active, highly engaged Social Media Specialist to represent our brand online and capture the beauty of our fixtures out in the real world.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly analytical Social Media Specialist whose primary focus is data-driven audience engagement, community management, and on-site media capture. You will be the voice of our brand across our social platforms, actively interacting with the interior design and architecture community to drive visibility.

Additionally, you will serve as our "eyes in the field," traveling to project sites and utilizing our showroom to capture raw video and photography of our lighting installations. **Please note:** This is *not* a content creation or graphic design role. You will work closely with our full-time Graphic Designer, who will handle all editing and final content production based on the strategic direction you provide.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Cross-Team Strategy & Analytics:** Collaborate closely with our eCommerce Specialist and Graphic Designer to evaluate social data and web traffic. You will pinpoint exactly which types of content drive the most engagement and sales, and use those insights to guide the creative team's output.
* **Community Management:** Actively monitor all social media platforms, promptly responding to comments, direct messages, and mentions to foster a highly responsive online presence.
* **Audience Growth:** Proactively interact with the accounts of interior designers, architects, developers, and industry partners to build relationships and drive organic traffic to our platforms and online store.
* **On-Site Media Capture:** Travel to various job sites, client properties, and our North Hollywood showroom to take high-quality raw photos and videos of lighting fixtures, custom drops, and architectural installations.
* **Asset Coordination:** Organize and hand off all raw visual assets to the in-house Graphic Designer for formatting and publication.
* **Platform Scheduling:** Maintain the social media calendar, scheduling the final content to ensure consistent and optimal posting times.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Platform Proficiency:** Must have deep knowledge and hands-on experience managing all major social media platforms natively, specifically Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Facebook. You must know how to navigate the unique algorithms, features, and best practices for *all* of these channels to optimize performance.
* **Proven Track Record:** Must submit a portfolio of past clients and campaigns demonstrating clear achievements in social media growth, traffic generation, and engagement metrics.
* **Experience:** Proven experience managing brand social media accounts, interpreting analytics tools, and driving meaningful engagement.
* **Strategic Collaboration:** Highly organized and capable of bridging the gap between eCommerce sales goals, raw social data, and graphic design execution.
* **Visual Eye:** A strong eye for framing and lighting when taking raw photos and videos (experience capturing architectural or interior design elements is a major plus).
* **Communication:** Strong written communication skills, with a professional and welcoming tone suitable for a luxury trade audience.
* **Logistics:** Must have reliable transportation and a willingness to travel locally to project sites for media capture.

Pay: $28.00 - $32.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description:
As the Community Manager, you will serve as the always-on voice of Squishmallows, executing out-of-the-box campaigns that drive brand growth and reach new audiences! Reporting to the Senior Manager, you will maintain a strong connection with our passionate community, blending original content, influencer partnerships, and proactive engagement. You will leverage your deep understanding of social platforms to maintain a strong brand voice while strategically tapping into cultural trends. Come join one of the world's biggest toy-making companies and help us shape the future of play!

**What You Will Do:**

* Manage and grow our Squishmallows community through regular posting, active engagement, and proactive identification of category- and culture-defining trends
* Maintain a consistent brand voice and style in creative assets and post copy across all social media platforms (including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Threads)
* Own and maintain the Social Media Posting Calendar, collaborating closely with social and marketing teams to ensure alignment across all business needs
* Ideate and create highly engaging social media content tailored specifically for platforms like Instagram and TikTok
* Respond to comments, messages, and inquiries in a timely, professional manner while fostering positive, lasting relationships with the fan community
* Proactively identify and address customer concerns, escalating trends and immediate issues to key internal stakeholders
* Perform comprehensive social listening and monitoring, delivering actionable weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports on campaign success metrics
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Supervisor Responsibilities:** Yes

**What We Are Looking For:**

* 3+ years of professional experience in community management and social media
* Proven experience supporting best-in-class, large-scale social media campaigns with a track record of delivering on key KPIs
* Hands-on experience ideating content and managing diverse social channels (including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, X/Twitter, and Threads)
* Strong copywriting skills specifically tailored for social media posts, community engagement, and brand storytelling
* Fluency in measurement and social platform tools (such as Sprout Social) with a passion for research and data analysis
* Highly organized, self-starting mindset with extreme attention to detail and timeline management in a high-pressure, time-sensitive environment
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and a collaborative attitude, demonstrating the ability to work effectively across different teams, departments, and external partners

**Nice To Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field is a plus
* Prior experience within the toy, entertainment, or consumer packaged goods (CPG) industries

**What We Offer**

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee, but provide the primary duties and responsibilities of the role. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

**What We Offer**

The salary range for this position is $98,640.00 - $121,320.00 / Yr. The base salary may vary based on experience, role tenure, performance, industry, and location. Eligibility for the annual performance incentive may apply. Jazwares is a multi-state employer, so the salary range may not apply to other states.
