jobs.description:
### **Description**

We are seeking an experienced **Community Manager** to serve as the voice, heartbeat, and front line of HexClad's online world. You'll live where our fans live—Reddit, Meta, TikTok, live streams, and IRL gatherings—scaling high-energy communities, catching the conversations that matter before they trend, and turning everyday interactions into moments people remember. Bridging our social and customer service teams, you'll protect and grow our reputation in real time, translate community sentiment into actionable insight for brand, product, and sales, and lead community-forward experiences that move fans from support tickets to lasting loyalty.

**Location |** In Office, LA HexQuarters

**Time Zone Expectations |** PST

**Details |** Full Time - Exempt

**Reporting to** | Assoc. Director, International Social Media

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Community Scaling:** Build, manage, and scale high-performance communities across Reddit, Meta, TikTok, and emerging platforms, driving organic growth and engagement in every key market.  
  
**Reputation & Crisis Management:** Partner with social and customer service teams to develop and maintain brand playbooks for real-time crisis response, brand tone, and ongoing reputation maintenance.  
  
**Social Listening & Insights:** Use social listening tools to monitor community sentiment and translate it into actionable feedback for brand, customer service, product, and sales teams.  
  
**Experiential Engagement:** Spearhead community-forward initiatives—live streams and virtual/IRL events—that create memorable moments and deepen customer connection.  
  
**Proactive Touchpoints:** Identify new touchpoints and maintain high-energy, consumer-facing interactions, shifting the brand from reactive support to proactively 'making moments.'  
  
**Unified Community Leadership:** Provide unified internal and external leadership for organic community growth, aligning social, CS, product, and sales around one cohesive community strategy across key markets.  
  
**External Platform Expansion:** Extend brand presence beyond owned channels to external platforms like Reddit, ensuring a proactive brand presence and cohesive reputation management across the digital landscape.

### **Requirements**

  

* 3-5 years proven experience managing and scaling high-performance communities across Reddit, Meta, and TikTok.
* Expertise bridging social and customer service teams to develop brand playbooks for real-time crisis response, brand tone, brand-building, and reputation maintenance.
* Proficiency with social listening tools and the ability to translate community sentiment into actionable feedback for brand, customer service, product, and sales teams.
* Experience spearheading community-forward initiatives such as live streams and virtual/IRL events.
* Strategic proactivity—a deep commitment to identifying new touchpoints and maintaining high-energy, consumer-facing interactions.
* Experience managing international communities and navigating localized content complexities is a plus.
* Trend forecasting—the ability to identify and translate community trends into social-forward content is a plus.
* Love of food and cooking! Cooking skills and/or experience in the culinary industry are a plus.

  

### **Compensation + Benefits**

**Compensation |** *Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.*  
**Bonus |** Annual bonus potential

**Health |** 100% of the employee premium covered on select choice plans, and offers dental+vision

**401k |** up to a 4% match of salary on 401k contributions

**Time Off |** A generous approach to support your time away from work

**Cookware |** Upgrade your home with employee perks

### **About HexClad**

HexClad is a pre-IPO premium cookware brand headquartered in Los Angeles, with a global footprint across DTC, Amazon, wholesale, Costco, and international channels. Endorsed by Gordon Ramsay and built on our patented hybrid technology, we are redefining the category through design, performance, and brand-led commerce.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Inside Sales Representative**

CODAN USA Corporation

**On-Site - Santa Ana, CA**

**Salary Range:** $25-$30 hourly+ commission/incentive opportunity

CODAN USA Corporation is seeking a motivated **Inside Sales Representative** to support continued growth across U.S. hospital, EMS, specialty-care, and distribution markets.

Working closely with the Inside Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager, the Inside Sales Representative will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, expanding existing customer relationships, supporting distributor growth initiatives, and advancing qualified opportunities through the sales process.

This is a hands-on sales role focused on proactive prospecting, lead qualification, account development, customer and distributor support, opportunity management, and sales administration. The ideal candidate is a results-oriented professional who enjoys building relationships, identifying new business opportunities, following up with customers, and working collaboratively across Sales, Customer Service, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Quality, and Product Management.

* Conduct proactive outbound prospecting to hospitals, health systems, EMS agencies, ambulatory surgery centers, specialty-care facilities, distributors, and other targeted customer segments.
* Qualify and follow up on sales leads, quotations, product evaluations, sample requests, distributor inquiries, and inactive opportunities.
* Work with Regional Sales Managers to develop new accounts, expand existing customer relationships, and advance opportunities requiring field-sales involvement.
* Identify opportunities to expand product utilization and increase business within key distribution channels, including Medline, Cardinal Health, Owens & Minor, McKesson, Henry Schein, IMA, and regional distributors.
* Support business development efforts across CODAN's product portfolio, including infusion, transfusion, EMS/whole blood, neonatal/pediatric, specialty, and custom products.
* Maintain accurate opportunity and account information, including opportunity stage, estimated annual potential, expected close date, next steps, and activity history.
* Coordinate pricing requests, product information, literature, samples, product evaluations, customer onboarding activities, and internal follow-up required to support sales opportunities.
* Re-engage dormant customers, identify account growth opportunities, and support customer retention and increased product utilization.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and distributors while providing timely and professional communication.
* Collaborate with Customer Service, Marketing, Product Management, Quality, Engineering, Finance, and Operations to support customer needs and remove barriers to sales conversion.
* Manage inbound customer and distributor inquiries, including product questions, account requests, order-related questions, and appropriate follow-up.
* Maintain accurate customer, activity, opportunity, and pipeline information within Microsoft Dynamics 365 to support forecasting, reporting, and sales execution.
* Support CODAN's online-store activities, including customer inquiries, order coordination, issue resolution, product updates, and activities involving WooCommerce, Foundry, EDI, and Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Provide regular sales activity, opportunity, and pipeline updates to the Inside Sales Manager and Regional Sales Managers.
* Support sales campaigns, customer outreach initiatives, product launches, special projects, market research, and other business-development activities as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in inside sales, customer service, account management, sales support, business development, or a related commercial role preferred.
* Experience in medical device, healthcare, distribution, manufacturing, or B2B sales preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct outbound prospecting, build customer relationships, and develop new business opportunities.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with a professional and customer-focused approach.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain consistent follow-up and effectively manage sales activities and opportunities.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow through on commitments.
* Experience using CRM and ERP systems to manage customer and sales information preferred.
* **Microsoft Dynamics 365 experience preferred.**
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, Teams, PowerPoint, and other business applications.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred; equivalent education and experience may be considered.
* Experience working with hospital, EMS, infusion, transfusion, acute-care, or healthcare distribution markets is highly desirable.

**Benefits**

Medical, dental and vision insurance

401(k) with company contribution

Paid vacation and sick time

Paid holidays

Commission/incentive opportunity

and more

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - Multi-Cultural - San Fernando Valley
jobs.description:
Are you a current Associate? To be considered, you must submit your application through the internal Career Portal (Jobs Hub). Click here to access.

**Time Type:**

Full time

**Remote Type:**

**Job Family Group:**

Sales

**Job Description Summary:**

This position is designed as a sales development role and will rotate through a number of different territories. The primary responsibility for this position will be to fill in open territories as needed in order to maximize the sales of supplier brands to the trade. This position may be asked to assist the Merchandising Department during particularly heavy merchandising periods.

**Job Description:**

**Job Responsibilities:**

Calls on accounts and covers daily routes by creating an established and efficient routing pattern.

* Prepares and delivers professional sales presentations to customers by balancing the company’s priorities and customer’s needs to include selling display ideas, new products, cold box, shelf, back bar placements and resets, drink and wine lists, and promotions.
* Maintains product levels in accounts by taking inventory and restocking shelves (where legal).
* Ensures maximum brand visibility within accounts by using effective and current point of sale materials when appropriate.
* Obtains payments for company by collecting and delivering checks or other remittance from accounts where legally permissible.
* Educates account staff by conducting educational staff training seminars on brands.
* Services accounts by delivering products to customers in extenuating circumstances, handling customer issues and complaints and referring these issues as appropriate to management.

Strategizes/preplans on how best to achieve sales and merchandising objectives by understanding company pricing and product programming information on a monthly basis and maintaining accurate historical account purchase information.

* Ensures national account compliance where applicable by accurately completing all necessary surveys.
* Understands the account’s buying patterns by reviewing the company pricing and product programming information on a monthly basis and maintains accurate historical account purchase information.
* Attains standards of performance goals by achieving the distribution, volume and activity goals of supplier brands as set by management.
* Manages customer account receivables by timely processing of credits and returns and communicating with accounts on aged receivables.
* Remains informed of company/supplier activities and updates by attending and actively participating in weekly sales meetings.

Other duties, as assigned by the jobholder’s supervisor, may also be required.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or equivalent training and work experience
* Minimum of 2 years’ experience in sales
* Basic PC skills using MS Office and other various computer programs including presentation software
* Must be a results-oriented professional with verbal/written communication skills using diplomacy and discretion as well as customer service skills
* Ability to multi-task, work independently and/or within a team, pay attention to detail and meet deadlines
* Analytic and Reporting skills
* Utilize sound judgement and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work in fast-paced, high-volume, team environment
* Have a valid driver’s license

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ability to hold a Solicitor’s Permit
* Understanding of wine and spirits

**Physical Requirements:**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to, stand, sit; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to reach overhead, squat and bend
* Carrying and lifting 45-65 pounds

**Competencies:**

* Accountable for results which impact the department.
* Selects best option from a set of defined procedures/ solutions using common sense and experience of similar situations.

*This job description is only a summary of the typical functions of this position, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible job responsibilities, tasks and duties. Responsibilities, tasks, and duties of individual jobholders may vary from the above description.*

***Salary and Benefit Statement:***

Any offered salary is determined based on internal equity, internal salary ranges, market data/ranges, applicant's skills, and prior relevant experience.

**Compensation**

* $45k - $50k Salary
* Mileage Reimbursement at 70 cents per Business Miles driven

**Benefits**

* Medical (HMO & PPO), Dental, Vision (PPO)401(k) matching.
* Annual PTO Accrual and holidays
* Rollover Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
* Free Life and AD&D Insurance Employee Assistance Program

Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.





Breakthru Beverage Group is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information and other legally protected characteristics. The EEO is the Law poster is available here. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please call (708) 298-3536 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

jobs.description:
Inizio Engage has a long-standing partnership with Boehringer Ingelheim Pharmaceuticals to offer support for an expanding product portfolio in primary care.

We are seeking a performance driven Pharmaceutical Field Sales Representative with strategic problem- solving skills that can collaborate with multiple stakeholders. The Ideal candidate will demonstrate a track record of sales success or related experience, regardless of industry background. Pharmaceutical experience is not required. We are seeking individuals who can quickly make a meaningful impact, leveraging their proven ability to deliver results, build relationships, and adapt in a dynamic environment.

The Pharmaceutical Field Sales Representative will achieve sales and activity targets on assigned territories across primary care customers and meet all relevant standards as set by Inizio and Boehringer Ingelheim Pharmaceuticals leadership. This is your opportunity to join Inizio Engage and represent Boehringer Ingelheim Pharmaceuticals!

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

We believe great people deserve great support—at work and beyond. That’s why we offer a rewards experience designed to help you thrive personally, professionally, and financially:

* Competitive pay that recognizes your experience, expertise, and impact
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; accrued paid time off; 401(k) with company match; disability and life insurance; and paid maternity and paternity leave
* Company-paid holidays so you can rest, recharge, and focus on what matters most

jobs.title: Business Sales Representative - Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
**Exciting opportunity to be eligible for a $5,500 bonus when you join our team.**

As a **Business Sales Representative - Strategic Accounts,** you will own and grow a portfolio of complex, high-growth Medium Business customers while developing new opportunities across assigned accounts. These customers are expanding, evolving, and navigating increasingly complex technology decisions, requiring a consultative seller who can build trust, uncover business needs, and position solutions that create measurable value. This is a strategic, quota-carrying outside sales role for an experienced B2B seller who can balance account maintenance, service coordination, prospecting, pipeline creation, and complex solution selling. You will work closely with sales engineers, wired and mobility partners, indirect partners, and cross-functional teams to help customers evaluate technology choices, solve business challenges, and invest in solutions that support long-term growth. This role is designed for sellers who are technical, resourceful, disciplined, and comfortable competing in a sophisticated market where customers have more choices than ever.

**Earn with confidence and upside.** This role offers a competitive base salary as well as performance-based commission tied directly to your sales results. At 100% of target, **annual earnings range from $116,700 – $147,500.** If you are motivated by ownership, measurable goals, and the ability to increase your income through performance, this role is designed for you.

**What you’ll do**

* **Balance field and office collaboration:** When not in the field, sales employees are expected to collaborate with their team from their assigned office location and place of work.
* **Own and grow Platinum level accounts.** Build account plans that prioritize retention, expansion, new opportunity creation, customer relationship depth, and long-term revenue growth.
* **Balance service and sales priorities.** Manage account maintenance and customer service needs while protecting time for prospecting, pipeline development, and closing new business.
* **Create and manage strategic pipelines.** Generate opportunities through account mapping, executive outreach, referrals, partner collaboration, customer expansion plays, and targeted prospecting.
* **Navigate complex technical solutions.** Learn and position wired, mobility, connectivity, and advanced technology solutions while translating technical capabilities into business outcomes.
* **Orchestrate internal and partner resources.** Collaborate with sales engineers, wired and mobility partners, indirect partners, product specialists, and support teams to design and deliver the right customer solution.
* **Differentiate in a competitive market.** Compete against direct providers, indirect competitors, vendors, resellers, and internal channel overlap by selling value, relationship, expertise, and business impact.
* **Lead a consultative sales process.** Diagnosing customer needs, uncover growth opportunities, overcome objections, and build solutions aligned to operational, technology, and financial priorities.
* **Maintain disciplined CRM and forecast accuracy.** Track pipeline, account activity, deal stage, next steps, expected close timing, and revenue impact with consistency and accuracy.
* **Protect customer relationships.** Serve as a trusted business advisor who can coordinate across service, sales, technical, and partner resources to help customers succeed.

**What you’ll Bring**

  

* 5+ years of successful outside B2B sales experience, preferably with complex accounts, telecommunications, technology, SaaS, mobility, wired solutions, or business services.
* Documented success meeting or exceeding quota in a full-cycle sales role that required prospecting, account growth, negotiation, and closing.
* Ability to manage both sales and account-maintenance demands without losing focus on pipeline creation and revenue growth.
* Strong technical curiosity and ability to learn complex product sets, internal processes, wired and mobility terminology, and solution-design concepts.
* Demonstrated ability to work through internal teams, sales engineers, partner channels, and cross-functional resources to solve customer problems.
* Strong territory, account planning, pipeline management, prioritization, and forecasting discipline.
* Comfortable competing in a market where customers evaluate multiple providers, vendors, resellers, and channel options.
* Valid driver’s license, satisfactory driving record, current auto insurance, and reliable transportation for market coverage.
* Bachelor’s degree is preferred, or equivalent combination of relevant sales experience and demonstrated performance.

Join a sales organization where complex account ownership, technical growth, and customer impact matter. In Platinum, you will manage meaningful business relationships, compete in a sophisticated market, and partner across sales engineering, mobility, wired, indirect, and support teams to solve customer problems. This role is designed for experienced sellers who want more than transactional selling: it offers the challenge of balancing account strategy, service demands, technical solutioning, and new revenue growth. In addition to competitive pay and commission, AT&T offers paid training, comprehensive benefits, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, employee discounts, wellness programs, and career development resources designed to support long-term success.

**Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act**

Candidates with arrest or convictions records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Relevant Material Job Duties for which Criminal History may have a direct adverse, and negative relationship potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the Conditional Offer of Employment:

* Contact with Customers/

jobs.title: Independent Sales Representative Performance-Based Compensation
jobs.description:
**Independent Contractor | Defined Territory | Field-Based**

Growing a food and beverage business takes more than introducing a product. It takes understanding what customers will buy, helping operators select the right assortment, and following through so new placements become repeat orders.

G & J Marketing and Sales is looking for an experienced, self-directed salesperson based in Los Angeles, CA to actively cover the territory across vending, micro markets, office coffee, and pantry service.

The territory includes existing customer relationships and business already generating commissions. You will represent nationally recognized brands, develop those accounts, and pursue new business. Your earnings will reflect the sales you generate and actively service.

**About G & J**

G & J Marketing and Sales has represented leading manufacturers to operators, distributors, and national accounts in Vending, Micro Markets, and OCS across North America since 1984. Our success is directly tied to the business we generate for the manufacturers we represent.

**What You Will Own**

**Develop New Business**  
Identify prospective customers, arrange meetings, and secure new product placements. Present food and beverage options that fit each customer’s operation, consumer preferences, and sales goals.

**Grow Existing Accounts**  
Understand what each account purchases and where there is room to expand. Introduce additional products, support relevant promotions, and follow up on results to build repeat business.

**Manage Customer Relationships**  
Stay in regular contact with operators and distributors. Understand their priorities, respond to questions, and coordinate with G & J and manufacturer partners to address issues that affect sales.

**Represent Our Manufacturer Partners**  
Know the products, pricing, and programs you represent. Give customers accurate information and work with G & J’s National Sales Managers on opportunities that need additional supplier support.

**Manage Your Territory**  
Determine your daily schedule, sales approach, priorities, and methods within the defined territory and applicable brand standards. Keep customer activity and opportunities current in the CRM, and use sales reports to guide account follow-up.

**What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months**

* Retain and grow the existing business within the territory
* Add customers and expand product distribution within current accounts
* Turn new placements and promotions into repeat purchases
* Maintain a current pipeline and follow through on customer commitments
* Grow territory sales and commission earnings through active account development

**Who This Role Is Ideal For**

This role is suited to an experienced salesperson who enjoys working directly with customers and wants to manage a defined territory independently.

You are comfortable asking for the business, following up after a meeting, and staying involved after the first order. You recognize opportunities within existing accounts as well as with new customers.

Experience with CPG, foodservice, vending, office coffee, or distribution is valuable. You understand how product selection, availability, and consistent service influence a customer’s buying decisions.

You can organize your work without daily direction and are comfortable with earnings tied to sales performance. You want an established customer base to develop while taking responsibility for the business you build.

**Experience and Skills**

* Proven success in sales, account management, and new business development
* Ability to grow and manage a defined sales territory independently
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and customer communication skills
* Organization and consistent follow-through across multiple accounts and opportunities
* Comfort using CRM tools, sales reports, and virtual meetings to support field sales
* Experience in CPG, foodservice, brokerage, or related channels; local industry relationships a plus

**Compensation Structure**

This is a sales performance role with commission-based compensation tied to the sales you generate and actively service. The territory includes existing business already generating commissions, with additional earning potential through new accounts, expanded distribution, and growth within current customers.

Compensation reflects sales performance, account growth, and customer retention. You determine how to organize and develop your business within the defined territory.

**Territory and Travel**

The representative should be based in Los Angeles, CA and actively cover the territory. Travel within the territory is expected for customer visits, distributor meetings, and relevant industry events.

Application Question(s):

* Do you have sales experience in one or more of the following, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Vending, Office Coffee Services (OCS)?

Experience:

* Sales: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90041

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative – Local Business Growth & Media Partnerships
jobs.description:
Mirror Media Group is hiring an **Outside Sales Representative** to help local businesses grow through professional short-form video, local-news exposure, newsletters, SEO content, digital advertising, and print distribution.

You will represent established Westside community-media brands, including Santa Monica Mirror, Yo! Venice, Westside Today, Brentwood News, and Palisades News and The Pride LA.

This is a full-time, in-person **field sales position**. It is not a remote or inside-sales role. You will spend much of your week meeting local business owners and managers face-to-face, building relationships, presenting our marketing programs, and closing recurring partnerships.

What We Sell

We help West LA businesses create visibility and reach more local customers through a done-for-you local media and marketing program.

Our packages can include:

* Professional short-form vertical video for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and social media
* Local-news articles and SEO-focused website content
* Newsletter features and local audience distribution
* Digital advertising and website banner placements
* Print distribution through trusted community publications
* Add-on video packages and expanded content opportunities

Our recurring marketing partnerships typically range from **$550 to $2,000 per month**, with additional video packages starting at **$500 each**.

You are not selling a one-time ad. You are building ongoing media and marketing partnerships with local businesses.

What You Will Do

* Prospect local businesses in person throughout Santa Monica, Venice, Brentwood, Pacific Palisades, and West LA
* Walk into businesses and build relationships with owners, managers, and decision-makers
* Target restaurants, retail stores, boutiques, salons, med-spas, wellness businesses, fitness studios, dental offices, medical practices, professional services, home-service providers, and other local-business categories
* Present short-form video samples and explain the value of local media, content marketing, and community visibility
* Sell 6- and 12-month recurring marketing partnerships ranging from $550 to $2,000 per month
* Sell video add-ons and other expanded marketing opportunities
* Build and manage a sales pipeline through in-person prospecting, phone outreach, email follow-up, referrals, and local networking
* Maintain accurate sales activity, account details, opportunities, and next steps in the company CRM
* Work with internal production and account teams to ensure a smooth handoff after each sale
* Build a long-term territory and become a trusted resource for West LA business owners

The territory includes major commercial corridors such as Main Street, Montana Avenue, Abbot Kinney, Lincoln Boulevard, Venice Boulevard, Ocean Park Boulevard, Wilshire Boulevard, and surrounding Westside business districts.

Who We Are Looking For

This role is ideal for a motivated, confident field salesperson who enjoys meeting people in person and creating new business opportunities.

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Are comfortable walking into a business and starting a conversation with an owner or manager
* Have a hunter mindset and do not depend exclusively on inbound leads
* Can handle rejection professionally and continue building momentum
* Are highly organized with strong follow-up habits
* Can explain short-form video, local marketing, social media, and media exposure in simple, practical terms
* Are motivated by a base salary plus uncapped commission income
* Want to build a recurring book of business and long-term client relationships
* Are comfortable working independently in the field while staying accountable to sales and activity goals

Preferred Qualifications

* 1+ year of outside sales, B2B sales, media sales, advertising sales, local-business development, hospitality sales, or comparable customer-facing sales experience
* Experience prospecting, setting appointments, presenting proposals, and closing recurring business
* Comfortable using a CRM to manage opportunities, follow-up, and sales activity
* Comfortable presenting work samples on a smartphone or tablet
* Familiarity with Instagram Reels, TikTok, local advertising, short-form video, SEO, or content marketing is a plus
* Valid driver’s license and reliable vehicle
* Ability to travel throughout the assigned West LA territory
* Strong verbal communication and professional written communication skills

Compensation and Benefits

* $45,000 annual base salary
* Uncapped commission
* 10%–20% recurring commission structure based on production level
* Commission on eligible recurring marketing retainers and video upsells
* Target first-year earnings of $65,000–$100,000+

jobs.description:
### **The Position**

Are you looking to make a meaningful impact in bioprocess development and join a collaborative team dedicated to scientific excellence? As a **Project Coordinator**, you will drive sample logistics and testing integrity to support critical process validation studies across our global network. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional technical teams and quality assurance to help deliver life-changing biopharmaceutical products to patients.

  
  

**The Opportunity:**

  
  

* Coordinate assigned Process Validation (PV) study samples across technical development teams, internal laboratories, and external contract manufacturing facilities.
* Ensure the integrity and progress of PV studies by meticulously following protocols, preparing samples, coordinating submissions, and accurately entering data.
* Proactively monitor study status, communicate updates to key stakeholders, and guarantee the quality and compliance of all completed work.
* Review PV protocols and reports for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with regulatory guidelines and internal sample testing standards.
* Generate, review, and approve PV data summary tables.
* Perform routine and non-routine analytical testing using techniques such as ELISA, PCR, U/HPLC, CE, LC-MS, and ICP-MS according to established protocols.
* Actively engage in clear and impactful communication across all organizational levels and escalate PV issues at team and department meetings to drive resolution.
* Attend PV and project meetings to represent the analytical operations team and ensure cross-functional alignment.
  

  

**Who you are:**

  
  

* You hold a Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related field.
* You have a minimum of 1 year of laboratory experience in biotechnology or a related area, along with knowledge of analytical methodologies.
* You possess familiarity and working knowledge of GxP, including documentation and compliance standards.
* You demonstrate meticulous attention to detail and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality, compliant work.
* You bring strong written and verbal communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
  

  

**Preferred:**

  
  

* Experience in project management within a biopharmaceutical or biotechnology setting.
  

  

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

jobs.title: Program Coordinator (Youth Services RAICES)
jobs.description:
The **RAICES Program Coordinator** will provide gender-specific services to youth who are at risk. The RAICES Program Coordinator is responsible for the coordination and management of school groups. Will provide supervision to the Youth Engagement Counselors by checking in and supporting group facilitation as needed.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS / RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Primary Functions**

* Plan, coordinate, and evaluate gender-specific workshops, recreation and enrichment activities of the on-site and off-site RAICES program in accordance with contract regulations.
* Contact schools to coordinate groups for each cohort (Fall, Winter, Spring, and Summer Internship)
* Prepare and submit accurate reports as required by program, including monthly program reports to funding sources (DCYF) and the collection of evaluation and demographic data (surveys).
* Develop curriculum on gender specific topics such as healthy relationships, self-advocacy, hygiene, bullying, and others related to the DCYF contact.
* Supervise, evaluate and provide leadership development to Youth Engagement Counselors, Youth Interns, and volunteers involved in the RAICES program.
* Plan and implement project-based learning and experiential outings and activities to enhance youth learning and skill development.
* Plan outreach and resource events for the community, youth, schools, etc as part of the contract requirement.
* Ensure that all contact requirements are implemented, documented, and met.
* Support a program environment that is learner centered promotes a sense of physical and emotional safety.
* Support positive relationships between staff and youth, and between youth and their peers.
* Conduct case consultations and check-ins with the Youth Engagement counselors.
* Provide resources to youth, schools, families, community, and Youth Engagement Counselors.
* Communicate with school, community, public agencies and parents/guardians of youth.
* Supervise, evaluate and provide leadership development to youth interns and volunteers involved in the program.
* Ensure all youth completed the intake forms and communicate with youth families to complete.
* Utilize HUBB software to keep track of all youth’s profiles.
* Ensure Youth Engagement Counselors are completing incident reports on HUBB when youth disclose anything that would be reportable and is required to document.
* Provide individual follow-up services and information and referrals to youth as needed and to other MNC youth services and community services.
* Coordinates, schedules, and handles all logistical details of the weekly check ins and group coordination.
* Review CMS data and prepare monthly program reports.
* Develops and oversees outreach plan to recruit target population into case RAICES program.

* Monitors school advocacy efforts including school meetings such as parent conferences, IEP meetings, school disciplinary meetings, as necessary.
* Attending meetings with the Associate Director.
* Support the hiring process, selecting, interviewing, and filling out forms required to hire new employees in the department. Also, assist with the onboarding/offboarding of Youth Engagement Counselors.
* Supporting other MNC Programs as needed.

**Secondary Functions**

* Collaborate in the planning and production of community events including Dia de los Muertos, Holiday/Winter break, Black History month, Carnival SF, Spring break, family nights, program graduations and showcase, etc.
* Recruit in kind service providers to implement gender specific activities, cultural enrichment, health and wellness, youth leadership, and other enrichment activities within the program.
* Create partnerships with other organizations.
* Advocate for youth needs, providing referral information, when appropriate to internal and external services based on individual youth needs. Provide individual follow-up services to clients as needed.
* Collaborate with community to coordinate services.
* Represent MNC at appropriate community forums and funder meetings/trainings; maintain superior customer service with funders, staff, collaborating agencies, parents, and youth. Adequately inform, share information, and collaborate with anyone benefiting from the RAICES program.
* Maintain accurate program records and follow reporting procedures. Compile, analyze, verify, and submit data according to the funding schedule and guidelines.
* Participate in weekly staff meetings, 1:1 supervision, and as training courses are offered.
* Ensure team is completing all training, progress reports, and required documentation for program.
* Actively participate in the creation and implementation of a personal staff development plan striving for self-improvement.
* Must be available to participate in late afternoon, evening, and some weekend activities as needed (including Memorial Day Weekend, during school breaks, and MNC events).
* Ensuring that the curriculum, orders, and any required document is updated and completed.
* Collaborate with program staff to identify individual needs and create proactive strategies that foster social-emotional growth and success.
* Provide case consultations and support to staff, ensuring holistic and trauma-informed approaches.
* Maintain accurate program records and submit data in accordance with funding and reporting requirements.
* Attend required team meetings (weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly). Coordinate services with other MNC programs and community partners to ensure smooth referrals and continuity of care.
* Assist with planning and participating in MNC-sponsored community and cultural events.

jobs.title: Resident Services Coordinator/Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives! LifeSTEPS is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services.**

We are seeking a full-time, highly motivated **Resident Services Coordinator & After-School Program Coordinator** who will:

* Empower low-income individuals and families to flourish by providing education and resources.
* Ensure our residents, specifically older adults to have an opportunity to thrive in place through housing and services.
* Encourage individuals and families through stable housing and supportive evidence-based services to build resilient communities.
* Maximize the strengths of individuals by providing client assistance, case management, service coordination and conducting community outreach.

**Additional duties will include:**

* Empowering children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing After School education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go to After School to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Job Specifics:**

* **Formal Job Title:** Director of Social Services/Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, Full-Time 34 hours per week (14 hours per week Director of Social Services/20 hours per week Program Coordinator)
* **Job location:** Oakland/Alameda, CA
* **Pay: $21.00 per hour (Program Coordinator), $28.35-$30.00 per hour (Director of Social Services)**

**More about us:**

The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for **“Skills Training and Educational Programs”** and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by **LifeSTEPS** will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology or any related field.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing social services to multi-families, senior and children.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute for the degree
* A background or experience working for a non-profit would be a big plus!
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support people so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? **Apply today!!!**

*#SocialServices*

jobs.company: Episcopal Community Services of San Francisco
jobs.title: Meals Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Episcopal Community Services (ECS), employees work with participants who may be experiencing homelessness, behavioral health conditions, substance use challenges, and other difficult life circumstances. While this work is meaningful and mission-driven, it can at times be stressful, demanding, or unpredictable. Employees are expected to exercise sound judgment, remain aware of their surroundings, follow established safety, communication, and de-escalation procedures, participate in all required trainings, and promptly report incidents, threats, injuries, or unsafe conditions, in accordance with ECS policies and procedures.

This position is a fully onsite, client-facing role that requires in-person interaction and direct service delivery to participants at ECS program locations. Due to the essential nature of the duties and the need for consistent in-person engagement with clients, remote work or work-from-home arrangements are not available for this position.

**SUMMARY OF DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

The Healthy Aging Program Coordinator will oversee the DAS-funded meal programs, currently serving over 6000 meals each month at three ECS sites; Canon Kip Senior Center, 1064/66 Mission, and The Granada Hotel.

**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Responsible for coordination of administrative and educational aspects of the DAS-funded meals program at three sites.
* Collect all daily meal recording data from all sites, assuring accurate and timely information.
* Provide accurate meal recording, assurance of proper lunch service protocols, and garner feedback from consumers.
* Facilitate the distribution and collection of the annual consumer survey at all sites.
* Work with Director of Healthy Aging and Director of CHEFs to identify and reduce areas of waste.
* Coordinate the collection of all monetary contributions at each site according to the program’s strict requirements.
* Support all sites with database entries of new intakes, annual assessment renewals, and quarterly recertifications.
* Assist third-party organizations to facilitate nutritional education sessions at three sites, selecting appropriate topics and collecting accurate attendance
* Act as a liaison between the ECS kitchen and individual site needs for optimal quality assurance.
* Ensure all required signage is posted at all sites.
* Attend staff and community meetings as needed.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* At least 1 year experience in program coordination, project management or a related field is required
* Some experience working with people experiencing homelessness is preferred
* Collaborative work style, demonstrating initiative and flexibility
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills
* Computer and technology proficiency is required, with the ability to learn new applications quickly
* Commitment to ECS’s mission and to its organizational values
* Must be able to lift at least 10 pounds

**OTHER:**

Must secure annual TB test. Must be finger “imaged”. All offers are contingent on successful passing this background check. Will honor and abide by rules of confidentiality. Office space will be shared and will function as a group room when not in use as an office.

**Hotel Emblem**

***Temporary Position through April 2027***

**ABOUT THE PROPERTY**

Located in the heart of San Francisco where Nob Hill meets Union Square and the Theater District, Hotel Emblem is a distinctive boutique hotel inspired by the city’s Beat Generation and creative spirit. The 96-room property features eclectic accommodations, a book-filled Writer’s Alcove, Obscenity Bar & Lounge, Bluestone Lane Coffee Shop, and unique programming including live jazz, poetry events, and literary experiences. With its bold design, intimate atmosphere, and central downtown location, Hotel Emblem offers guests an experience that celebrates self-expression, creativity, and the unexpected.

**THE ROLE**

As Sales Coordinator, you’ll support the General Manager and Director of Sales in growing hotel revenue through group and business transient business. You’ll help manage sales leads and accounts, coordinate group bookings, support the sales process, and work closely with hotel teams to make sure every opportunity is followed through. You will:

* Support the General Manager and Director of Sales with day-to-day sales initiatives
* Assist with developing new group, business transient, and local business opportunities
* Conduct outreach to prospective accounts and help qualify new leads
* Maintain and grow relationships with existing accounts
* Support group bookings, including guest rooms, meetings, banquets, and F&B opportunities
* Assist with catering and sales activities as needed
* Respond promptly to sales inquiries, referrals, and customer correspondence
* Follow up on leads, accounts, and repeat business opportunities
* Maintain accurate account and group information in the sales system
* Confirm group bookings within approved availability and rate guidelines
* Stay informed about local competitors, market conditions, and hotel offerings
* Support site tours, networking events, civic activities, and other sales opportunities
* Communicate group arrangements and client needs to hotel departments
* Help create a positive, collaborative environment across Sales and Catering
* Promote other Parable-managed hotels when appropriate
* Prepare sales reports and assist with other projects and assignments

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

Sales opportunities are organized, followed up on, and moving forward. Leads and accounts are accurately documented, group arrangements are clearly communicated, and the Sales team has a reliable partner who helps turn opportunities into business while creating a positive experience for clients and hotel teams.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* 1+ year of hotel sales or Front Desk experience
* Interest in developing a career in hotel sales
* Strong communication, presentation, organization, and follow-up skills
* Comfortable with outreach, relationship building, and customer service

jobs.description:
**About Us**

Monarch Plumbing & Rooter, Inc. is a growing local plumbing company committed to providing reliable service and high-quality solutions to our customers. As our company continues to grow, we are looking for a creative, motivated, and highly efficient Marketing Coordinator / Content & Brand Specialist to take an active role in developing and managing our company's marketing.

We are looking for someone who can bring fresh ideas, think outside the box, and help us continue building a strong and recognizable brand.

**Position Overview**

This is a hands-on marketing position responsible for supporting and managing all aspects of Monarch Plumbing & Rooter's marketing—from our online presence and social media to photography, video production, advertising, printed materials, field marketing, branding, and community outreach.

A major part of this position will involve creating original photo and video content. This individual should be comfortable going into the field, photographing and recording our technicians, projects, equipment, company events, before-and-after work, and other content that can be used to market the company.

The person in this position will also be responsible for turning that raw content into professional, engaging marketing material through photo editing, video editing, graphic design, and content creation.

We are looking for someone who doesn't simply wait for marketing assignments. We want someone who can identify opportunities, develop ideas, and take those ideas from concept through execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist with developing and executing the company's overall marketing strategy.
* Manage the company's social media presence and content calendar.
* Create, schedule, and publish engaging social media content.
* Photograph and record company projects, technicians, equipment, events, and other marketing opportunities.
* Travel to local job sites when needed to capture high-quality photos and video content.
* Plan and produce before-and-after content, project highlights, educational videos, employee features, promotional videos, and other creative content.
* Edit photos and videos for social media, advertising, website content, and other marketing materials.
* Create short-form video content such as Instagram Reels, TikTok-style videos, and other social media content.
* Maintain an organized library of company photos, videos, graphics, and other marketing assets.
* Develop graphics, flyers, brochures, mailers, advertisements, signage, and promotional materials.
* Help maintain and improve the company's presence across Google, Yelp, social media, and other online platforms.
* Assist with website content and identify opportunities to improve the company's online presence.
* Develop marketing campaigns and promotions to help generate leads and increase customer engagement.
* Maintain consistent company branding across digital platforms, vehicles, uniforms, signage, printed materials, and advertising.
* Assist with email and customer marketing campaigns.
* Help develop strategies to increase positive customer reviews and online engagement.
* Research local advertising, sponsorship, partnership, and community outreach opportunities.
* Assist with company events, community events, sponsorships, and promotional activities.
* Research competitors and current marketing trends to identify new opportunities.
* Track marketing campaigns and results to determine what is generating leads and producing results.
* Work closely with office staff, management, and field technicians to identify and create marketing opportunities.
* Take ownership of marketing projects from initial idea through completion.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Previous experience in marketing, content creation, social media, or a related field.
* Photography experience and a strong understanding of how to capture professional-quality images.
* Videography experience and the ability to confidently record high-quality video content.
* Experience with photo and video editing software.
* Ability to create polished, engaging content from raw photos and video footage.
* Experience creating content for platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
* Graphic design experience and familiarity with programs such as Canva, Adobe or similar design platforms.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Comfortable working with Google Workspace and other digital platforms.
* Ability to work independently and take initiative.
* Comfortable working both in an office environment and visiting job sites to capture content.

**Additional Skills That Are a Plus**

Experience in any of the following areas is a plus:

* Digital advertising and paid social media campaigns
* Google Ads
* Google Business Profile
* Yelp business marketing
* SEO and local search marketing
* Website content management
* Email marketing
* Graphic design
* Branding and brand development
* Marketing analytics and performance tracking
* Community outreach and event marketing
* Home-service, construction, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, or similar service-industry marketing

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is creative, highly efficient, resourceful, organized, and proactive.

This person should have a creative eye and be able to recognize marketing opportunities in everyday company operations. Whether it's a technician completing an interesting project, a before-and-after transformation, new equipment arriving, a community event, or an opportunity to educate customers, we want someone who can recognize that opportunity and turn it into quality content.

The ideal candidate:

* Thinks creatively and outside the box.
* Has a strong eye for photography, video, design, and visual presentation.
* Understands how to create content that captures people's attention

* Strong attention to detail, particularly with quantities, units, product names, and recipe versions.

We're hiring a Field Marketing Manager in San Francisco to build and run the programs that turn Modal's target accounts into active customers. jobs.title: Patient account manager
jobs.description:
**About Serova**

Serova is building a fast-growing clinical network for its personalised cancer vaccine programme. Each vaccine is made for the individual patient from their own samples and given in partnership with their treating physician. We run the whole process for patients and their oncologists, from initial review through treatment and follow-up.

**The role**

We're looking for a Patient Account Manager to own each patient's experience from sign-up through to administration and follow-up. You'll be the main point of contact for the patient, their family, their physician and, where separate, the treatment sponsor-investigator. You'll answer their questions and keep every step on track.

Success looks like an excellent experience for every patient in our care, and a patient journey that runs smoothly and on time.

**What you'll do**

* Guide new patients and families through sign-up, consent paperwork, records requests and what to expect at each stage
* Coordinate sample collection and shipping with the patient's physician, pathology labs and sequencing partners, and track each sample through to results and analysis
* Keep patients, families and physicians regularly updated on sequencing, manufacturing and administration dates
* Answer non-clinical questions yourself, and quickly pass clinical or medical questions to our nursing, medical or scientific team
* Keep accurate, confidential records of each patient's status, communications and outstanding actions
* Arrange practical support such as travel, scheduling and help with financial-access questions

**Your first few months**

* Get to know Serova's personalised cancer vaccine programme end to end, from both our side and the patient's
* Take over communication and day-to-day management of patients already on the programme
* Set up patient trackers and make sure every outstanding action and question is dealt with

**What we're looking for**

* Experience in a patient-facing coordination role, such as patient services, case management, care coordination or clinical-trial patient support, ideally in oncology. If you've done similar work outside a clinical setting and have the right mindset, we'd still like to hear from you.
* A track record of managing complex, time-sensitive logistics across several external parties, such as clinics, labs and couriers
* Clear, compassionate communication with patients and families during a difficult time, and confidence working with physicians and their teams
* Careful handling of confidential health information, with working knowledge of HIPAA
* Good judgement about which questions to answer yourself and which to escalate to clinical colleagues

**Nice to have**

* Experience with personalised or autologous therapy programmes
* Specimen chain of custody
* Expanded-access or clinical-trial enrolment
* Patient CRM or case-management systems
* Familiarity with Good Clinical Practice (GCP)

**Details**

* **Location:** San Francisco, California
* **Type:** Full-time
* **Salary:** $100,000 to $130,000

Questions? Email clinical@serova.bio

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

A Strategic Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with AWS high-value strategic customer. Key aspects of the role include:  
  

* Relationship Management: Building deep, multi-threaded executive relationships, serving as the primary point of accountability for the overall account.

  

* Strategic Account Planning: creating and executing long-term account strategy that span quarters (not weeks), aligning cross-functional resources e.g. sales, customer success, product, and executive leadership.

  

* Revenue Expansion: owning revenue growth and identifying growth opportunities proactively, often before the customer realizes the need.

  
Key job responsibilities  
Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for a strategic account and owning the overall account strategy, relationship health, and long-term growth trajectory  
  
Develop and execute multi-year strategic account plans that align AWS services and solutions with customer business objectives, driving adoption across compute, storage, database, analytics, AI/ML, and generative AI workloads  
  
Build and maintain deep, multi-threaded executive relationships across all levels of the customer organization  
  
Drive revenue growth by identifying expansion opportunities, accelerating new workload migrations, and positioning AWS as the preferred cloud platform across the customer's global operations  
  
Collaborate cross-functionally with AWS specialist teams, solutions architects, partner managers, professional services, and executive leadership to deliver tailored solutions that address complex customer needs  
  
Lead strategic negotiations for large-scale enterprise agreements, including Enterprise Discount Programs (EDPs), Private Pricing Agreements (PPAs), and Marketplace procurement strategies  
  
Act as the customer's advocate within Amazon, influencing product roadmaps and service improvements by capturing and communicating customer feedback, feature requests, and competitive insights  
  
Monitor account health metrics, pipeline development, and revenue attainment against targets, proactively identifying and mitigating risks to retention and growth

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
* 10+ years of sales or sales management in infrastructure or cloud technology experience
* Experience in managing global stakeholders
* Experience leading and interacting with cross-functional teams
* 5+ years of business development, or account management with a proven ability to deliver results experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with customers on substantial, strategic, and complex software or cloud services/infrastructure deals from opportunity through closure
* Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
* Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint
* Experience in building and developing a high performance team

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Full time • San Francisco, CA • $80K – $90K base • $130K – $160K OTE**

Parameter builds AI agents that do offensive security work. Our agents run autonomous penetration tests against production applications and cloud environments, finding IDORs, broken access control, XSS, and infrastructure misconfigurations that scanners miss and that human pentest firms only look for once or twice a year.

We are not a theoretical security company. Our team has responsibly disclosed real, high-severity vulnerabilities to well-known technology companies, and our findings are the front door to most of our customer relationships.

Our best conversations start the same way: we find something real in a prospect's environment and tell them about it. You'll own the top of that funnel. That means researching accounts, working with the security team on what we found, and writing the outbound that makes a CISO reply within the hour.

This is not a role where you read a script into a dialer. The people you're emailing break software for a living and can tell within one line whether you understand their problem. You'll need to learn enough security to be credible: what an IDOR is, why broken access control is the thing that keeps them up, and why a once-a-year pentest doesn't cover a codebase that ships daily.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own outbound to security and engineering leaders: build the account list, write the sequences, and run the follow-up
* Turn our vulnerability research into first meetings. When we find something real, you're the reason the right person hears about it
* Book and prepare qualified calls for the founders, and sit in on them until you're running discovery yourself
* Keep the CRM honest. Clean data, accurate stages, and a pipeline number nobody has to caveat
* Close the loop on messaging. Tell us which lines land, which segments convert, and what we should stop saying

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 1+ years of outbound sales development, ideally into technical buyers, or a track record that makes the case some other way
* You write well. Short, specific, and free of the phrasing every other vendor in their inbox is using
* Genuine curiosity about security. You do not need a background in it, but you do need to want one
* Comfort with rejection and with volume. The job is a lot of activity and a small number of very good conversations
* You build your own leverage: research workflows, enrichment, automation, whatever gets you more at-bats without more hours
* Bonus: sold into security or developer tools, worked at an early-stage startup, or hold a security certification

**Interview process (3 rounds)**
--------------------------------

* Intro call with a founder (30 minutes)
* Written exercise and mock call (10 minutes)
* Paid work trial (1 day)
* References and offer

You'll have the founders on your calls, the research team feeding you reasons to reach out, and a product that proves itself in the first engagement. We move quickly and aim to make an offer within two weeks of first contact.

*This role is onsite in San Francisco. You must be authorized to work in the US; we are not able to sponsor visas at this time.*

**Sales Development Representative**

Full time • Onsite in San Francisco, CA • $80K – $90K base • $130K – $160K OTE

At Parameter, we build AI agents that autonomously conduct offensive security testing. Our agents run automated penetration tests against production applications and cloud environments, uncovering IDORs, broken access controls, XSS, and infrastructure misconfigurations that traditional scanners often miss—and that human pentest firms typically only check once or twice a year.

We’re not just theorists. Our team has responsibly disclosed real, high-severity vulnerabilities to leading technology companies. These findings often introduce us to new customers and establish trust from the outset.

Our best customer conversations start the same way: we identify a real vulnerability in a prospect’s environment and tell them about it. As our Sales Development Representative, you’ll own the top of this funnel—researching accounts, partnering with the security team to understand our findings, and crafting outbound messages that prompt CISOs to respond promptly.

This is not a generic sales role. The professionals you reach out to are seasoned security experts; they’ll know within one line if you understand their world. You’ll need to build credibility quickly. Major League Baseball is looking for an Investigative Intern in the Department of Investigations to assist in highly sensitive and confidential matters related to player, umpire, and baseball personnel conduct. This is a unique opportunity to gain experience at the intersection of sports, compliance, and investigations in a fast-paced and professional environment.  
  
*This position is intended for the Spring 2027 semester.*

**Responsibilities**

* Support investigations into allegations related to performance-enhancing substances, sports gambling, domestic violence, off-field misconduct, and other violations of baseball rules and policies
* Prepare timely reports of information gathered, presenting information in an organized and user-friendly format
* Gather and analyze publicly available information, including government records, social media, and news reports
* Conduct research and prepare drafts of memorandum following interviews
* Monitor and develop alerts for relevant court filings and social media updates
* Secure and preserve data and publicly available information
* Review and analyze documents, including organizing documents on a document review platform
* Perform related duties as required

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Current undergraduate or graduate student
* Excellent research, writing, and oral communication skills
* Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage deliverables with time-sensitive deadlines
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

**Pay Rate:** $20.00 per hour

The actual offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your work experience, education, skills, and any other factors MLB considers relevant to the hiring decision.

**Why MLB?**

Major League Baseball (MLB) is the most historic of the major professional sports leagues in the United States and Canada. Employees love working at MLB because of the culture of growth, teamwork, and professionalism. Employees who are most successful at MLB take initiative, know how to identify problems and provide solutions, and always put the Team first. For those ready to step up to the plate and join the major leagues, MLB takes the same approach as teams do with their players: empowering our "workforce athletes" to be at their best by engineering experiences that put employees in the best position to succeed. Major League Baseball is looking for candidates who are passionate about growing America's pastime to best serve its fans for decades to come.

California Residents: Please see our California Recruitment Privacy Policy for more details.

Colorado Residents: Colorado based applicants may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please email us at accommodations@mlb.com. Requests received for non-disability related issues, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response.

**Are you ready to Step Up to the Plate? Apply below!**

jobs.title: Research Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Research Project Coordinator**

**Grade:** 12

**Salary:** $24,697 - $29,513.5

The Research Foundation for Mental Hygiene is seeking a qualified candidate to fill a part-time Research Project Coordinator position. This is a part time position for a K01-funded study developing and pilot-testing web-based PrEP decision aid for young Black and Latino men who have sex with men (YBLMSM) and their providers. The project focuses on increasing PrEP uptake and equitable shared decision-making between YBLMSM and their healthcare providers, in partnership with a community-based clinic. The Research Coordinator will be responsible for all aspects of the research study and take a direct role in implementation of the study, including conducting qualitative interviews in English and Spanish

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Recruit, screen, and enroll research participants, and conduct qualitative interviews (in English and Spanish) with study participants.
* Support study personnel in monitoring assignments.
* Manage the financial aspects of the study, including subject payments and purchase of materials needed to conduct the study.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory and administrative requirements imposed by funders and IRBs.
* Communicate issues and solutions to the Principal Investigator in a timely manner.
* Revise and maintain research operating procedures throughout the course of the study.
* Other duties might include providing administrative support for the Principal Investigator including drafting/proofing documents, supervising staff with administrative tasks

**Minimum Qualifications:**

BA/BS in the Social Sciences, Public Health, Psychology or Behavioral Health Fields, and/or equivalent in relevant Education and/or Training

* Bilingual fluency (speaking, reading, or writing) in Spanish and English
* At least (2) years of experience conducting structured, in-person interviews covering complex and sensitive physical and mental health issues
* At least (1) year working knowledge of GCP guidelines including protection of human subjects, definitions and reporting requirements for adverse events, elements of informed consent, Federal Codes, Regulations and Guidelines relevant to the performance and conduct of clinical research.
* At least (1) year working knowledge with Windows environment, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SPSS.
* At least (1) year writing, editing and proofing skills with opportunities to collaborate on scientific publications and manuscripts.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's Degree
* Preferably two-three years of relevant project management experience in the social sciences, public health, psychology or behavioral health fields.
* Willingness and ability to travel occasionally may be required

**Work Location:** 1051 Riverside Drive, New York, NY 10032

**To Apply:** Submit an application through our website at https://rfmh.applicantpro.com/jobs/. Please note only applications submitted through our website will be considered.

The Mission of the Research Foundation for Mental Hygiene, Inc. (RFMH) is to promote the mental health of all New Yorkers, with a focus on providing hope and supporting recovery for adults with serious mental illness and children with serious emotional disturbances. Applicants with lived mental health experience are encouraged to apply. RFMH is deeply committed to supporting underserved individuals, organizations, and communities. To this end, RFMH is focused on implementing activities and initiatives to reduce disparities in access, quality, and treatment outcomes for underserved populations. A critical component of these efforts is ensuring that RFMH is a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees' unique attributes and skills are valued and utilized to support the mission of the Agency. RFMH is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.

The Research Foundation is a private not-for-profit corporation and is not an agency or instrumentality of the State of New York. Employees of the Research Foundation are not state employees, do not participate in any state retirement system, and do not receive state fringe benefits. Excellent Benefits Package. Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer - Disabled/Veteran, 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-300.5(a) compliant.

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Research Project Coordinator**

**Grade:** 14

**Salary:** $28.15 - $33.70

The Research Foundation for Mental Hygiene, Inc. is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Part-Time Research Coordinator to support a pilot study examining cannabis use and HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) engagement among young adults. The study is conducted through the HIV Center for Clinical and Behavioral Studies at the New York State Psychiatric Institute in partnership with a community-based clinical site.

The Research Coordinator will support the study's day-to-day implementation, including participant screening, enrollment, survey administration, data management, and coordination with research and clinical partners. The position will also provide opportunities to contribute intellectually to data analysis, secondary research projects, conference presentations, and manuscripts. This position is well suited for someone seeking hands-on experience across the full research process, from participant recruitment and data collection through dissemination of findings.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate day-to-day study activities in collaboration with the principal investigators, research team, and clinical-site partners
* Recruit potential participants through approved in-person and electronic methods
* Conduct eligibility screening and support informed-consent and enrollment procedures in accordance with the approved study protocol
* Administer research assessments or facilitate participant completion of self-administered surveys
* Respond to participant questions, provide appropriate study guidance, and support a respectful and affirming research experience
* Schedule study visits and maintain participant recruitment, screening, enrollment, and completion records
* Monitor survey completion and review study data for completeness, accuracy, and potential discrepancies
* Conduct participant follow-up when responses are incomplete or clarification is needed, consistent with approved procedures
* Enter, organize, clean, and maintain research data and study documentation
* Assist with quality-assurance activities, including routine review of study records and adherence to standard operating procedures
* Maintain participant confidentiality and ensure compliance with IRB requirements, human-subjects protections, and institutional policies
* Coordinate study materials, recruitment documents, regulatory files, and secure data-management systems
* Participate in regular research-team meetings and provide updates on recruitment, enrollment, data collection, and study progress
* Assist with descriptive analyses, data visualization, and interpretation of study findings under investigator supervision
* Contribute and/or lead secondary data analyses
* Conduct targeted literature reviews and assist with reference management
* Contribute to the development of scientific abstracts, posters, presentations, reports, and peer-reviewed manuscripts
* Support dissemination of findings to academic, clinical, and community audiences
* Perform additional study-related duties as needed

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in public health, or an equivalent combination of education and/or equivalent in relevant Education and/or Training
* At least (2) years working knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP) guidelines including protection of human subjects, definitions and reporting requirements for adverse events, elements of informed consent, Federal Codes,Regulations and Guidelines relevant to the performance and conduct of clinical research.
* At least (2) years working knowledge with Windows environment, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* At least (2) years of experience managing day-to-day research study activities including but not limited to data-organizing, analysis, cleaning & maintaining

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience (1 year or more) conducting human-subjects research, including recruitment, screening, informed consent, or survey administration
* 1 year or more experience working with sexual and gender minority communities, young adults, or populations affected by HIV or substance use
* Knowledge of or interest in HIV prevention, PrEP, cannabis use, behavioral health, or health disparities
* 1 year or more experience with REDCap
* Familiarity with statistical software such as R, SAS, SPSS, or Stata
* Experience conducting literature reviews or contributing to abstracts, posters, presentations, or manuscripts
* Familiarity with IRB requirements
* Interest in developing a career in behavioral, clinical, public health, or social science research

**Work Location:** 1051 Riverside Drive, New York, NY 10032

**To Apply:** Submit an application through our website at https://rfmh.applicantpro.com/jobs/. Please note only applications submitted through our website will be considered.
