jobs.title: Project Coordinator - Security Services (Day Shift)
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

  

Exciting Opportunity at MSK: Join one of the nation's leading cancer centers and help support critical security and operational initiatives that contribute to a safe environment for our patients, visitors, and staff. MSK is seeking a highly organized and technology-savvy **Project Coordinator** to join our **Security Services** team.

In this role, you'll partner with Security leadership to coordinate projects, manage key operational programs, maintain critical records and reporting systems, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency through technology and process improvement. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys project coordination, operational support, data management, and collaborating across departments to drive meaningful results.

  
  

**Role Overview:**

* Coordinate and support departmental projects, initiatives, and operational improvement efforts from planning through implementation
* Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, meeting materials, action items, and status updates
* Administer the employee locker program and maintain related documentation and records
* Coordinate the equipment locking device installation program across MSK locations
* Process requests for new keys and maintain key control historical files and tracking systems
* Maintain records of patient property and found property, ensuring proper documentation and disposition
* Prepare presentations, reports, dashboards, and project communications for Security leadership and key stakeholders
* Analyze operational data and provide insights to improve project visibility, communication, and workflow efficiency
* Partner with internal departments to address project-related inquiries, coordinate activities, and support operational needs
* See opportunities to improve processes through technology, automation, and innovative solutions
  

  

**Key Qualifications:**

* Previous experience coordinating projects, programs, operations, or administrative initiatives in a professional environment
* Strong organizational, administrative, and project coordination skills
* Sophisticated proficiency with Microsoft Office, including PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook
* Experience utilizing AI-enabled productivity tools to improve communication, reporting, workflow management, or operational efficiency
* Experience with Airtable or similar project management and workflow platforms such as Smartsheet, Monday.com, Asana, Jira, or Salesforce preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  

  

**Core Skills**

* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through
* Demonstrates strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills
* Takes ownership of projects and follows through on commitments
* Communicates effectively and collaborates with diverse stakeholders
* Embraces innovation and actively seeks opportunities to improve processes
* Learns new technologies quickly and adapts to changing priorities
* Values teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement
  

  

**Additional Information:**

* Location: 1275 York Ave
* Schedule: Monday-Friday, Hours between 7am and 5pm, must be flexible.
* Reports to: Security Services Leadership
* Career growth opportunities through MSK's professional development and tuition reimbursement programs
  

  

**Helpful Links:**

* Compensation Philosophy
Benefits  

Pay Range: $62,600.00 - $97,100.00  
FSLA Status: Exempt  

**Closing** :

At MSK, we believe in fair, competitive pay that reflects your job, experience, and skills.

MSK is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to diversity and inclusion in all aspects of recruiting and employment. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration without regard to race, color, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, religion, creed, disability, veteran status or any other factor which cannot lawfully be used as a basis for an employment decision.

Federal law requires employers to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.

jobs.title: Digital Skilling Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position Description: **Who We Are:**

Hispanic Federation (HF) is the nation's premier Latino nonprofit membership organization. Founded in 1990, HF supports Hispanic families and strengthens Latino institutions through grantmaking and direct services in the areas of education, health, immigration, civic engagement, economic empowerment and the environment. Values that drive our work include equality, fairness, diversity, and empathy.

Technological advancements are changing the workforce requirements of our economy. According to Brookings, nearly two-thirds of all new jobs created since 2010 required either high or medium level digital skills. Latinos make up 18% of the overall U.S. labor market and account for approximately one out of every two new workers entering the workforce in 2025 but also make up 35% of workers with no digital skills; 20% of those with limited skills; and only 8% of all STEM jobs. Hispanic Federation's Digital Skilling Program seeks to address these issues through community-based workforce development and technology trainings.

  

**Who we seek:**

Hispanic Federation (HF) seeks a Digital Skilling Program Coordinator to help manage and contribute to HF’s Workforce Initiatives programmatic efforts aimed at increasing the financial security of Latino families. Under the supervision of the Workforce Initiatives Program Manager, the coordinator will be instrumental in supporting administrative and reporting duties for a technology program running three (3) cycles a year at three (3) locations within New York City. The coordinator will learn the intricacies of community outreach, workforce development, program management, technology training programs, digital adoption programs, and poverty reduction efforts.

  

The successful candidate is detail-oriented and has experience and interest in technology training programs, workforce development, and nonprofits. The position requires a high attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and a commitment to increasing workforce development opportunities to underserved communities.

  

**Position Location:** New York, NY

**Reports to:** Workforce Initiatives Program Manager

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming and active program participants providing guidance through the entire program lifecycle and tracking attendance and engagement
* Coordinate day-to-today logistics across site locations for program cycles
* Weekly travel within New York City to the Bronx, Queens and Manhattan
* Prepare, organize, and update digital and physical course materials and cohort schedules
* Administer, distribute, and collect mid-cohort and closeout evaluation surveys; organize qualitative feedback and quantitative ratings into summary decks
* Travel nationally once a year to participate in a train-the-trainer program
* Manage regular communication with program leadership and stakeholders to provide updates on program health, and/or additional support
* Maintain accurate records and provide timely program activity reports
* Ensure compliance with all reporting requirements and prepare programmatic reports
* Serve as point of contact to other program service providers, grantees, and consultants, monitoring performance, funding, and payments
Complete additional tasks as assigned  

  

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* Minimum of a bachelor's degree and demonstrated knowledge of non-profit programs and services within underserved low-income communities preferably centered around digital equity and workforce development
* At least one (1) year of professional experience in administration, logistics, adult education and / or program management
* Excellent technology skills; experience with Office 365, conference platforms, and third-party databases
* Efficient, detail-oriented and organized
* Ability to multi-task and balance assignments from more than one staff person
* Strong, well-developed verbal and writing skills
* Exceptional ability to work with others and develop trust with partner agencies, staff and program participants
* Commitment to Hispanic Federation's mission and core values
* Willingness to learn new technology programs, including AI tools and the Swift Programming Language
* Familiarity with Apple products and systems is a plus, but not required
Fluency in written and spoken Spanish is a plus, but not required  

  

**Compensation**

The salary for this position is $55,000. Compensation includes fully subsidized medical, dental, vision insurance accessible on first day of employment; access to flexible spending for medical and transportation; and a 403 (B) retirement plan with a company match after 6 months of service.

**To Apply**

Please submit a résumé and cover letter detailing your interest and qualifications via the dedicated link. No telephone calls or emails will be accepted regarding this position. Only specific candidates will be contacted regarding their application for this role.

Hispanic Federation is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against actual or perceived race, color, religion, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, creed, disability, marital status, sexual orientation and/or other protected categories.

For more information about the Hispanic Federation, go to www.hispanicfederation.org.

jobs.title: Residence Program Specialist
jobs.description:
**Why Join ADAPT?**

It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.

For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**

Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
* Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.
* Ensures all actions are conducted in a manner that prevents abuse, neglect, or exploitation, and immediately reports any concerns in accordance with agency policy.
* Follows all OPWDD-approved behavior management guidelines, including use of approved interventions when required.
* Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
* Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
* Valid New York State Driver’s License, maintained in good standing
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $20.17/hour (after probation) + Industry-Leading Benefits for all full-time employees.

**At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging.** We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.

ADAPT Community Network is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified candidates of diverse ethnic and racial backgrounds and status are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Medical Communications
jobs.description:
Are you a recent college grad or professional looking to transform lives through medical communications? Are you ready for a rewarding career in a collaborative and growing environment? We're hiring a savvy **Program Coordinator** passionate about keeping projects on task and their team focused.

**About You**

* You are flexible and confident you can manage up to 20 projects at a time and be responsible for the project development process.
* You are solution-oriented and can anticipate potential workflow obstacles and provide solutions.
* You're highly organized, a self-starter with an eye for the details and a pulse on the bottom line.
* You flourish in fast-paced environments and relish the particulars.
* You work passionately, never satisfied with the status quo.
* You're a born problem-solver and enjoy when no day is the same.

**Your Day-to-Day**

As a Program Coordinator, you will track project deliverables through all departments, ensure due dates are relayed, and obstacles are identified and communicated efficiently. You will be responsible for running your clients medical/legal/regulatory (MLR) process. This includes submissions, coordinating with taggers, and communicating status updates to the client, the MLR Supervisor, and your supporting team. In addition, you will oversee coordinating internal and external meeting, taking meeting notes during meetings, and providing status updates to the team.

Under supervision from a program manager, you will review invoicing documents and final reconciliations, prepare Sunshine Act reports and any ancillary reports as required by the client. You will work closely with the logistics vendor to perform meeting planning tasks, including site search, venue contracting, travel arrangements, food/beverage, and AV equipment. You will be responsible for preparing and distributing the assignment report and facilitating assignment team meetings.

**Required Experience**

* Bachelor's degree, ideally with a concentration in advertising, marketing, communications, or journalism; other majors will be considered
* 0-2 years of prior work experience in a client service/agency setting or related internship experience
* A high level of computer competency and intermediate or advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Project, and Outlook)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

**Helpful Experience**

* Working knowledge of timeline and schedule development
* Experience supporting a project manager or marketing team with coordinating tasks and tracking deadlines

**Who We Are**

Precision AQ - Medical Communications was founded with the simple belief that the scientific story is the foundation of every pharmaceutical brand. Our teams of inquisitive problem solvers and passionate creators dig deep to translate the science behind today's cutting-edge therapies, then communicate the science clearly and credibly. jobs.title: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner and Clinical Research Coordinator/Rater
jobs.description:
Clinical Research Nurse Practitioner and clinical research rater (Senior Level) — Psychiatry & Neurology

About Us

Manhattan Behavioral Medicine is an independent clinical research site conducting industry-sponsored trials in psychiatry and neurology.

We are seeking a Clinical Research Nurse Practitioner to bring both advanced clinical expertise and senior-level research operations experience to our psychiatry and neurology trials. In this hybrid role, you will provide protocol-directed clinical assessment and medical oversight in partnership with our Principal Investigator, while also leading study coordination activities and mentoring our research staff. This position is ideal for an NP who has worked as a senior or lead Clinical Research Coordinator and understands what it takes to run industry-sponsored drug trials well from both the clinical and operational sides.

Key Responsibilities

**Clinical Responsibilities**

* Perform protocol-required clinical assessments, including medical and psychiatric histories, physical and neurological exams, and review of concomitant medications, within NP scope of practice and under PI delegation.
* Assess participant eligibility and ongoing suitability for study participation, in collaboration with the Principal Investigator.
* Evaluate, document, and follow up on adverse events and serious adverse events, including causality and severity assessment as delegated; ensure timely reporting to sponsors and the IRB.
* Conduct participant safety monitoring, including suicidality assessment (e.g., C-SSRS), vital signs, ECGs, and review of laboratory results.
* Administer or oversee standardized psychiatric and neurological rating scales and cognitive assessments per protocol.
* Serve as sub-investigator on select studies where permitted by state law, institutional policy, and sponsor requirements.
* Provide clinical guidance to the research team on medical questions and participant concerns, and escalate urgent issues to the PI as appropriate.

**Study Leadership & Coordination**

* Serve as lead clinical and operational point of contact on assigned industry-sponsored drug trials, from site initiation through closeout.
* Partner with sponsors, CRAs, and monitors; prepare for and support site initiation visits, monitoring visits, and audits.
* Ensure compliance with ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and sponsor requirements across regulatory documentation, source documentation, and informed consent processes.
* Oversee investigational product accountability, EDC data entry, and query resolution in collaboration with coordination staff.
* Support IRB submissions, protocol amendments, and continuing reviews.
* Mentor and train clinical research coordinators and other research staff on protocol requirements, clinical procedures, and best practices.
* Contribute to site feasibility assessments, recruitment and retention planning, and process improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

* Active, unrestricted license as a Nurse Practitioner (APRN) in NY and NJ, with national board certification (e.g., PMHNP-BC, FNP-BC, AGNP-BC, or equivalent).
* Master's degree (MSN) or Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) from an accredited program.
* Minimum of [2–3] years of clinical research experience, including prior experience as a senior or lead Clinical Research Coordinator on industry-sponsored drug trials.
* Experience in psychiatry and/or neurology clinical trials.
* Strong working knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines, FDA regulations, and human subjects protection requirements.
* Current GCP and human subjects research training; current BLS/CPR certification.
* Proficiency with EDC systems and clinical trial management systems.
* Excellent clinical judgment, organizational skills, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent studies.

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior experience serving as a sub-investigator on FDA-regulated trials.
* Experience with CNS rating scale training and certification processes.
* Certification such as CCRC (SOCRA) or CCRP (ACRP).
* DEA registration and prescriptive authority, as applicable to the role.
* Experience mentoring or supervising research staff.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: E-commerce Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Maure**

Maure is a New York-based gifting brand founded by chef Maureen Cavalieri. We sell curated gift sets alongside several hundred individual pieces across kitchen and dining, home decor, fragrance, and office.

Some products are designed and produced under our own label with specialist manufacturers in Europe, while others are sourced from makers and artisans around the world. Customers can purchase a ready-made gift set, build their own, or shop individual pieces.

We sell directly to customers through our Shopify website and wholesale to retailers through Faire.

We are a small team, which means the work is broad, visible, and moves quickly.

**The Role**

We are looking for an E-commerce Coordinator to help manage the day-to-day operation and presentation of Maure's online store.

This is primarily a **Shopify-focused e-commerce role**, not a social media or traditional marketing position.

The core of the role is maintaining and merchandising the website: adding new products, updating product information and imagery, building collections and landing pages, refreshing homepage content, supporting product launches, and making sure the site is accurate, organized, and visually strong.

You will also manage the execution of Maure's email program through Klaviyo, including building approximately two campaigns per week, preparing imagery and copy, scheduling campaigns, and ensuring emails align with current products, inventory, launches, and seasonal priorities.

You will work closely with the founder and operations team to translate product and business priorities into a strong online customer experience.

The ideal candidate is organized, visually minded, highly detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently inside Shopify and Klaviyo. You should be someone who notices when a product page needs attention, when a collection could be organized better, when imagery is missing, or when information on the website is outdated.

This is an in-person position based in New York.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Shopify & Website Management**

* Manage day-to-day updates to the Maure Shopify store
* Add and set up new products, including SKUs, pricing, descriptions, imagery, variants, tags, collections, and other product information
* Maintain and update existing product pages as information, inventory, imagery, or merchandising priorities change
* Build and update collections, landing pages, homepage modules, menus, and promotional placements
* Prepare products and collections for launch, ensuring all information and assets are complete and accurate before publication
* Upload, organize, crop, resize, and maintain product imagery across the website
* Update website creative and imagery for seasonal changes, launches, promotions, and merchandising priorities
* Merchandise products throughout the site based on seasonality, inventory, launches, best sellers, and business priorities
* Monitor product availability and adjust website merchandising accordingly
* Maintain accurate and consistent product information across the site
* Conduct regular website checks for outdated content, broken links, incorrect pricing, missing imagery, product errors, and other issues
* Identify opportunities to improve navigation, collection organization, product presentation, and the overall online shopping experience
* Work within the existing Shopify theme to make routine content and merchandising updates
* Coordinate with the team when technical or development support is required

**Product Launches & Digital Merchandising**

* Manage the e-commerce setup for new product launches from initial product information through publication
* Gather and organize product details, pricing, photography, descriptions, measurements, and supporting assets
* Ensure new products are correctly categorized and integrated into relevant collections and navigation
* Determine where new and priority products should appear throughout the site
* Update homepage, collection pages, gift guides, and other website areas to support launches and seasonal priorities

As the operations/facility coordinator for a shelter, your role is pivotal in maintaining the seamless and efficient operation of the shelter facility. Your primary goal is to establish a safe and supportive environment that meets the needs of shelter residents while aligning with the organization's mission and values.

They embody the values and standards of Midway Living, setting an example for colleagues. They prioritize building and nurturing relationships, fostering productive collaborations with superiors and colleagues while maintaining professionalism and constructive engagement.

jobs.title: Health Navigator/ Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* Health insurance
* Opportunity for advancement
* Paid time off
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule

***For 40 years, Haitian Centers Council (HCC) has served as a trusted community resource for underserved and vulnerable populations, including immigrants, seniors, and low-income individuals. HCC provides free educational programs, healthcare linkages, prevention services, and social support to the Caribbean community regardless of economic status. Guided by the needs and voices of those it serves, HCC has spent four decades fostering a stronger, more resilient community by promoting equity, addressing health and racial disparities, and collaborating with community partners. At its core, HCC believes that wellness begins with self-care and the creation of safe, inclusive environments where everyone can thrive.***  
  
**Program Overview**

The Young Men Who Have Sex with Men (YMSM) Program provides comprehensive, community-based HIV prevention, sexual health education, and navigation services for young men who have sex with men. The program utilizes evidence based, harm reduction, and culturally responsive strategies to reduce HIV and HCV transmission, increase access to biomedical prevention, and address barriers to care.

**Purpose of the Position**

The Health Navigator / Outreach Worker is responsible for engaging YMSM through targeted outreach, delivering rapid testing services, facilitating group-level interventions, supporting drop-in programming, and providing navigation and linkage to HIV prevention and care services. This role ensures participants have access to prevention resources, supportive services, and a welcoming, affirming space.

*Key Responsibilities*

**Outreach & Community Engagement**

* Conduct community outreach a minimum of three (3) times per week, specifically targeting YMSM, in physical and virtual spaces.

* Identify and prioritize outreach efforts in areas with high HIV infection rates using local NYS ETE dashboard data.

* Provide culturally affirming education on HIV, HCV, STI prevention, sexual health, and risk-reduction strategies.

* Work at least one (1) Saturday per month and one (1) evening per month to support outreach or agency-wide programming.

  

**Testing & Screening Services**

* Provide rapid HIV and Hepatitis C (HCV) testing in community-based, wellness center, and mobile health unit settings.

* Conduct pre- and post-test counseling per NYSDOH and agency protocols.

* Ensure informed consent, confidentiality, and accurate documentation.

  
**Navigation, Referrals & Linkage to Care**  

* Provide health navigation to support access to PrEP, PEP, STI testing, HIV/HCV medical care, and supportive services.

* Address barriers such as insurance, transportation, and system navigation.

* Facilitate warm handoffs and follow-up.

  

**Group-Level Interventions & Education**

* Co-facilitate evidence-based intervention such as, Popular Opinion Leader.

* Support recruitment and engagement for group activities and workshops.

  

**Drop-In Activities & Wellness Center Support**

* Support and facilitate drop-in activities designed to promote engagement, retention, and community building among YMSM.

* Provide informal education, resource navigation, and referrals during drop-in hours.

* Ensure the wellness center is stocked and organized with essential materials, including but not limited to:

* MetroCards and transportation assistance

* Snacks and beverages

* Hygiene kits and safer sex supplies

* Educational and outreach materials

* Monitor inventory levels and communicate restocking needs to supervisors.

* Maintain a welcoming, affirming, and safe environment during all drop-in programming.

  

**Data Entry, Documentation & Quality Assurance**

* Enter all outreach, testing, navigation, and drop-in service data by the end of each business week.

* Perform self-audits of testing forms and service documentation.

* Maintain confidentiality and adhere to HIPAA, NYSDOH, and agency policies.

  

**Training & Professional Development**

* Attend a minimum of twelve (12) trainings per contract year.

* Participate in supervision, staff meetings, and professional development.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator**

FMP Creation & Vertra Systems · Northern New Jersey · Part-time to start, with a path to full-time

**Two companies. One right hand. Not just a desk job.**

About us

**FMP Creation** is a marketing and production company. We build brands and produce video and photography for our clients, from strategy and design through shoot day and final delivery.

**Vertra Systems** places smart, AI-powered vending machines in residential buildings in northern New Jersey, stocked with better-for-you snacks and drinks. We're a young company, growing one building at a time.

The role

You'll be two executive's right hand across both companies. That means running his calendar, inbox, and priorities, and keeping two businesses moving at once.

It also means getting out from behind the computer. You'll sit in on client and partner meetings and help on set at FMP shoots. For Vertra, you'll restock machines, make inventory runs, and help run building events.

The role starts part-time, about 20–30 hours a week, with a path to full-time as both companies grow. If you're organized, quick on your feet, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, read on.

A typical week might include

* Planning the week with Jason, clearing both inboxes, and lining up meetings across FMP and Vertra
* Sitting in on a client meeting, then sending the recap and next steps within 24 hours
* Working an FMP shoot: loading gear, handling call sheets and release forms, and keeping the day on schedule
* Heading out on a Vertra run: picking up inventory, restocking and cleaning machines, and meeting a property manager
* Closing out the week: receipts and invoices, vendor orders, and prep for next week

What you'll do

**Executive support (both companies)**

* Run executive's calendar, inbox, and task list, and keep FMP and Vertra priorities from colliding
* Schedule meetings, calls, and site visits, and prepare agendas and briefing notes
* Attend meetings with clients, vendors, partners, and property managers; capture decisions and own the follow-up
* Draft emails, proposals, and documents for Jason, and track deadlines with a short weekly status update
* Keep files, contracts, and SOPs organized, and help write new SOPs and checklists as both companies grow

**FMP Creation: production and marketing support**

* Help on video and photo shoots: gear load-in and load-out, set-up, call sheets, shot lists, and release forms
* Coordinate shoot logistics, including schedules, locations, permits, and certificates of insurance
* Work on location at client sites, including active construction and healthcare facilities, following PPE and site rules
* Keep project folders and media organized in Dropbox to our naming and delivery standards
* Help prepare proposals, pitch decks, and quotes, and keep client follow-ups on schedule

**Vertra Systems: field operations and business support**

* Restock, clean, and merchandise machines; rotate product and check expiration dates
* Buy and pick up inventory, run stock counts, and keep storage organized
* Watch sales and inventory in our machine software, and flag low stock, slow sellers, and problems
* Handle first-line machine issues: basic troubleshooting, booking repairs, and resolving customer refunds
* Help run building launches and tenant events: setup, sampling, surveys, and breakdown
* Support growth by researching buildings, managing property-manager outreach, and keeping vendor compliance paperwork current

Who you are

* A true generalist, as comfortable in a client meeting as on a shoot or in a stockroom
* A strong multitasker who can switch between two companies and very different tasks in the same day
* Proactive: you spot what needs doing and handle it before you're asked
* Organized and detail-minded, with follow-through people can count on
* A clear, professional communicator in writing and in person
* Discreet with confidential business information
* Calm and flexible when shoots run long, machines break, or priorities shift
* Happy to do whatever the day needs; no task is beneath you

Requirements

* 5+ years as an executive assistant, operations coordinator, production coordinator, or in a similar fast-paced role
* A valid driver's license, a reliable vehicle, and a clean driving record (mileage reimbursed at the IRS rate)
* Able to lift up to 40 lbs and stay on your feet for several hours at a time, with or without reasonable accommodation
* Available for occasional early mornings, evenings, or weekends for shoots and events, with advance notice
* Able to work in person across northern New Jersey
* Comfortable with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 and spreadsheets, and quick to learn new apps

Nice to have

* Experience in video or photo production, a creative agency, or events
* Experience in vending, retail, route sales, or inventory management
* Familiarity with Dropbox, Canva, a CRM, or QuickBooks
* Comfort using AI tools to work faster

Schedule, location, and pay

* **Pay:** $35 per hour, based on experience
* **Schedule:** Part-time to start, about 20–30 hours a week, with a path to full-time. Mostly weekdays, with occasional early mornings, evenings, or weekends.
* **Location:** In person across northern New Jersey (meetings, shoots, and Vertra sites), with some admin work from home
* **Benefits:** Mileage reimbursement, paid sick leave, and room to grow into a full-time role

How to apply

Email your resume to Jason@fmpcreations.com and a short note to with the subject line **"Executive Assistant – [Your Name]"**.

In your note (five sentences or fewer), tell us about a day you juggled the most different tasks at once. What were they, and how did you keep everything on track? We read every application that follows these instructions.

Educational Alliance (EA), one of New York City’s original settlement houses, was founded in 1889 to offer educational, social, and cultural services to Jewish immigrants arriving to the Lower East Side. jobs.title: Media Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Pretzl**

Transforming B2B Marketing, One Buyer Journey at a Time

Pretzl is redefining what a B2B marketing agency can be. As a B2B Technology-and-People-as-a-

Service (TaPaaS) agency with approx. 350 people globally, we're not just advising clients - we're

building the technology that transforms how businesses connect with their buyers.

As part of our expansion, our media team in the US is growing fast and we need super stars to

help us grow and deliver great media plans, and best-in-class service for our clients

**Role:**

The Media Account Manager plays a central role in turning client objectives into effective paid

media campaigns and ensuring those campaigns are delivered successfully from brief through

to reporting and optimization.

You will support the day-to-day of client relationships and media activity, working with the

wider team to meet client marketing and business objectives - translating these into clear media

recommendations and direction for the activation teams.

This is both a client-facing and hands-on media role. You’ll be expected to understand the detail

of the campaigns you manage (direct buys) while also seeing the bigger picture, helping to

coordinate activity being managed by our activation teams. You’ll have the opportunity to

interrogate briefs, identify opportunities to improve performance, and ultimately help clients

make better marketing decisions.

You’ll also play an important role in developing more junior members of the team and creating a

collaborative, proactive account culture.

**Skills:**

You’ll ideally bring:

* Strong knowledge of paid media and an understanding of how different channels can

work together within an integrated media plan.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign data into insights and actionable

recommendations.

* The ability to understand a client's marketing objectives and connect media

recommendations and performance back to their wider business goals.

* Confidence managing day-to-day client communications
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present

recommendations clearly and credibly.

* Excellent organization and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate

multiple campaigns, stakeholders and deadlines.

* A proactive, solution-oriented approach to campaign challenges and client needs.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial considerations involved in

managing media accounts.

* Strong attention to detail while maintaining sight of broader client objectives.
* Curiosity about the changing media and B2B marketing landscape and an interest in

bringing new ideas to clients.

* The confidence to constructively challenge a brief or existing approach when there is a

better solution.

* A collaborative style and the ability to support and develop junior colleagues (Account

Executives and Senior Account Executives).

* Adaptability, initiative and the ability to make sound decisions in a fast-moving

environment.

**Responsibilities:**

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

* Acting as a key day-to-day contact for clients and building trusted relationships through

responsive, knowledgeable and proactive account management.

* Developing a strong understanding of clients' businesses, audiences, products,

competitors and marketing objectives.

* Interrogating client briefs, asking the right questions and helping translate business and

marketing objectives into effective media recommendations.

* Leading the development of multi-channel media plans, working with specialist teams

and senior colleagues where appropriate.

* Evaluating media opportunities and recommending the channels, partners, audiences

and approaches most appropriate to the brief.

* Clearly communicating media recommendations and the rationale behind them to

clients and internal stakeholders.

* Coordinating campaign activation across internal teams, clients, media partners and

other stakeholders to ensure campaigns launch accurately and on time.

* Maintaining a clear view of campaign delivery, budget and performance and proactively

addressing issues before they affect client outcomes.

* Identifying and driving optimization opportunities based on campaign data, audience

insights and wider client objectives.

* Ensuring reporting goes beyond campaign metrics to explain what performance means,

what has been learned and what action should be taken next.

* Contributing insight and recommendations to client reviews, QBRs and wider strategic

conversations.

* Working with analytics and technology teams to resolve reporting challenges and

improve the quality and usefulness of campaign measurement.

* Managing the day-to-day financial processes for assigned accounts, including budgets,

forecasts, bookings and billing, in partnership with the wider team.

* Managing client and media partner expectations and handling day-to-day issues

confidently, escalating appropriately when needed.

* Delegating effectively to Account Executives and other junior team members, helping

them prioritize their work and supporting their development.

**Benefits:**

* 20 paid vacation days per year, increasing to 25 days after 1 year's service
* X3 Float Days per year to celebrate moments that matter
* x2 Volunteer Time Off days a year
* 11 paid holidays per year
* 10 paid sick days per year
* Time off to vote
* Flexible working
* Flexible medical, dental and vision coverage
* Modern Health mental health and emotional wellness support
* Carrot fertility services
* 401(K) retirement plan administered through Fidelity
* Pet Discount Program: Nationwide offers a voluntary employee-paid pet insurance benefit covering various types of pets

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Advertising operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of digital advertising solutions with the goal of helping consumers find and discover products and services. We help advertisers reach global audiences via Amazon owned and operated sites (Amazon.com, IMDb.com), millions of Fire TVs, Kindles, and Fire Tablets, and on high-quality sites across the internet via the Amazon DSP. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, our advertising solutions help businesses build brand awareness, increase product sales, and solidify brand loyalty. If you are interested in joining a world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.  
  
Amazon Adapt is a program designed to offer coverage solutions for business gaps which may occur due to extended leave (parental, medical) and unexpected account transitions. Amazon Adapt deploys highly skilled, hyper-agile talent that ensures customers can continue to invest in their partnerships with Amazon Advertising, uninterrupted. The program ensures that the high bar for customer service, strategic partnership, and revenue attainment is maintained during these coverage gaps.  
  
As a member of the Amazon Adapt team, you will have the opportunity to complete a series of rotations across a range of consumer industries. This enables Adapt team members to experience high-velocity exposure to teams across the organization and to clients across different verticals. From day 1 Adapt team members must use their experience to earn trust with multiple stakeholders and take ownership of account relationships within a team. As a member of the Adapt team you will use your experience and vast knowledge to drive results for advertisers and internal stakeholders. Adapt team members are decisive, knowledgeable, and use high judgement. The Adapt role will give you a chance to Learn and be Curious and the autonomy to own projects that will help you advance your career at Amazon. The Adapt team prioritizes flexibility, and hires for both 40 and 30 hour work weeks.
  
  
As a Full Funnel Seller on the Adapt team, you will serve as the sole commercial point of contact for advertiser accounts during leave of absence coverage periods. You will independently own all client relationships, revenue targets, and product selling. For endemic accounts, you will manage the full product suite across SPB, Display, and Video. For non-endemic accounts, you will manage DSP renewals, audience strategy, and multi-tactic adoption across Performance+, Brand+, and 3P Deals. You will execute sprint-based playbook-driven pitches, manage DAA renewals, own the Salesforce pipeline end-to-end, and maintain 100% pitch coverage and zero dark periods across a book of 4 accounts.
  
  
If you are ready to make an immediate impact, embrace change, and accelerate your career at Amazon, come join us!  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Independently own all client relationships and revenue for a book of business
* Execute sprint-based playbook-driven pitches across the full product suite
* Manage full-funnel selling: SPB + Display + Video (endemic) or DSP + P+ + B+ + 3P Deals (non-endemic)
* Own Salesforce pipeline end-to-end including DAA renewals and forecasting
* Deliver 100% pitch coverage and 90%+ renewal rates
* Maintain zero dark periods greater than 60 days
* Conduct quarterly sprint themes from Core4 diagnostic (endemic) or quarterly performance reviews (non-endemic)
* Present QBRs, campaign performance reviews, and proposals to clients
* Identify and execute upsell/cross-sell opportunities across the full product suite
* Manage all sales calls, proposals, and stakeholder relationships independently
* Collaborate with partner teams via scaled support model (office hours, pitch repository)
* This is a client-facing role and requires up to 20% domestic travel as needed

  
A day in the life  
As a Full Funnel Seller on the Adapt team, you start your day with a pipeline review in Salesforce, checking renewal timelines, campaign pacing, and upcoming pitch deadlines across your accounts. You then lead a client call to discuss campaign performance, present optimization recommendations, and advance a Video pitch (endemic) or DSP audience refresh (non-endemic). Mid-morning, you prepare a sprint pitch using playbook templates for an upcoming quarterly presentation. After lunch, you conduct a campaign optimization review, identify upsell opportunities, and draft a proposal. You close out the day updating Salesforce, managing stakeholder follow-ups, and planning tomorrow's client meetings. You own the entire commercial relationship for your accounts.
  
  
About the team  
The Amazon Adapt team specializes in dynamic work. Our team supports the Global Amazon Ads Organization during gaps in business coverage due to leaves of absence, roles to be hired, and unexpected employee movement. Amazon Adapt's vision is to provide the world's most customer-centric business coverage, exceeding both customer and employee expectations during periods of transition.  
  
This role provides rotational coverage for single-seller accounts where you own the advertiser relationship. When a single seller goes on LOA or there is a TBH, Adapt is the only solution to maintain account relationships and protect revenue. You will operate as the sole point of contact across the full product suite. The Adapt team prioritizes flexibility and hires for both 40 and 30 hour work weeks.

**Who Are You?**

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
As a **Field Sales Representative** at the Pittsburgh Paints Company (PPC) supporting The Home Depot, you will cultivate and execute sales plans and selling PPC products through several of the Home Depot stores. Primary end-use customers will include multi-family maintenance, facilities maintenance, residential repaint, hospitality and government.

You will be assigned Pro Managed Accounts within a territory and have responsibility for organic growth and new customer acquisition and development. You will work onsite in the **Syosset, NY** territory and report to the Regional Manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with The Home Depot management teams to develop and achieve sales growth plans.
* Engage customers throughout The Home Depot store looking to uncover opportunities to introduce PPC products.
* Utilize a Customer Relationship Management Tool (CRM) – you will increase sales growth of the PRO customers' list of accounts.
* Analyze territory sales performance reports and develop strategic territory business plans to support growth.
* Identify in-store selling opportunities to secure wing stacks, bulk stacks, end caps, and stack outs to create impactful, cross merchandised, product displays.
* Ensure automatic replenishment system (CAR) is supplying product to support rate of sale, and on-hand inventory counts are accurate by performing cycle counts.
* Maintain color centers and perform shelf maintenance of all products in addition to completing resets of shelves and product during Product Line Reviews.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred.
* 1 Year of experience can include educational classes and/or internships.
* This position is based on a 50-hour work week which includes base salary and overtime.
* Valid driver's license and a clean driving record.

*Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without employment-based visa sponsorship (now or in the future). This includes H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visas).*

  

*PPC Participates in a Fixed and Variable Rate (FAVR) program. With FAVR, you drive your own car and receive tax-free reimbursements that cover both fixed costs (like insurance) and variable costs (like gas), giving you more choice and equity in your vehicle.*

*The anticipated base salary range for this position is $50,000 - $55,000 annually. This position is also eligible for incentive compensation, including commissions and/or bonuses, subject to applicable plan terms.*

Equal Opportunity Employer

Calling all sales agents!

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Sales Representative to join our team and drive our growth through exceptional customer engagement and strategic sales initiatives. In this role, you will be the face of our company, building strong relationships with clients, understanding their needs, and providing tailored solutions that foster loyalty and satisfaction. For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Burson is seeking an Executive Assistant to support one or two members of Burson Leadership Team in New York. This role serves as a trusted partner responsible for managing executive operations, coordinating priorities, and ensuring the smooth execution of activities across the Executive Office.

The Executive Assistant plays a critical role in maximizing leadership effectiveness by managing complex scheduling, travel, communications, meetings, and stakeholder interactions. Working closely with senior leaders and key stakeholders across Burson and WPP, this individual helps ensure executive time, attention, and resources are focused on the organization's highest priorities.

* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to support business needs.
* Assist with special projects and administrative initiatives as assigned.

* Serve as a professional and responsive point of contact for stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships across Burson, WPP, and partners.
* Support leadership communications and coordination efforts.
* Partner closely with leadership team members and key stakeholders to ensure alignment across executive priorities and activities.

* Exceptional organizational and time-management skills.

**DEPARTMENT:** Youth Services

**LOCATION:** Brooklyn: PS 196 Ten Eyck at 207 Bushwick Ave, Brooklyn NY 11206

**REPORTS TO:** Program Director/ Assistant Program Director

**SALARY:** $40 per hour (15 hours per week)

**SCHEDULE:** Monday-Friday Between 3:00pm to 6:00pm, schedule may be modified based on program needs. Open availability needed for School Holidays breaks; schedule is 8:00am until 6:00pm

**JOB SUMMARY:** As part of the Youth Services Department’s vision: All Youth Services Staff will assist in promoting growth, leadership and positive self-image in all young people at all of the Grand Street Settlement’s sites. The Education Specialists will promote and develop a safe and engaging learning environment for youth. Homework help, small group tutoring or individualized tutoring, creating literacy and STEM lessons, as well as supervising group leaders’ facilitation of lessons is included as part of the Education Specialist’s scope of work.

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s Degree required; Master’s Degree in Education or related fields, preferred.
* Must have experience teaching and designing curricula.
* Prior experience supervising staff required.
* Three (3) or more years of experience and expertise working with youth (volunteer experience is acceptable).
* Three (3) or more years of experience coaching, instructing, or facilitating curriculum-based lessons (to youth preferred).
* Experience working with youth in grades K-12 required.
* The ideal candidate should be personable, energetic, and enthusiastic.
* Candidates must be able to communicate effectively with all students and participants while remaining professional at all times.
* Ability to motivate the students while setting an example in all areas, including responsibility, timeliness, organization, attendance and most importantly, professionalism.
* Candidate should successfully complete the following: NYSDOH Fingerprinting Screening; New York State Clearance Review Background Check-$25 nonrefundable fee; three (3) Reference Checks; Physical with updated TB Test (fees may apply).
* Valid CPR/AED Pro certification through recognized accrediting body preferred.
* Valid First Aid/RTE certification through recognized accrediting body preferred.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee tutoring component of the program and supervise academic tutors.
* Assess students academic progress: collecting report cards and entering report grids, communicating to parents, teachers, and school administration.
* Create and develop individual educational plans.
* Oversee group leader’s facilitation of lesson plans.
* Conduct observations of lessons and meet with group leaders to discuss strategies.
* Coordinate and facilitate academic activities such as games and events.
* Prepare reports as required.
* Problem solve and intervene directly with youth.
* Perform special projects as assigned from time-to-time.
* Engage children and young adults into conversation to determine their needs and interests.
* Plan and facilitate all program activities to meet the individual needs of the participants.
* Conduct staff training to ensure that all personnel are on the same page regarding achievement of program objectives.
* Coordinate community relations campaigns to promote youth programs.
* Provide literacy intervention materials and resources to members of educational programs.
* Provide job preparation services individually and through workshops including training in resume building, dressing for success, and interview preparation.
* Provide support for staff that are running other youth development or support service programs.
* Develop and coordinate youth development programs as defined through grant contracts and community needs.
* Coordinate annual workshop series for college applications and topics including financial aid, scholarships, and personal statement writing.
* Evaluate programs to ensure that they meet the needs of the youth and are effective in producing their intended outcomes.

Please submit a resume and thoughtful cover letter, outlining how your skills and experience meet the qualifications of the position you are applying for. If selected, we ask that you also provide us with three (3) professional references that we can contact (at least one (1) professional reference should be from a former supervisor). In this role, you'll help keep projects organized, informed, and progressing toward key milestones. You'll support contract administration, track project activities, facilitate communication among stakeholders, and contribute to the successful delivery of construction projects from initiation through closeout.

  
  

**What you'll do:**

* Support the Resident Engineer with construction contract administration activities in both field and office environments.

* Track project progress, milestones, deliverables, and key performance metrics.

* Support weekly construction meetings and other project coordination meetings.
* Review construction drawings, revisions, specifications, and contract documents to verify field activities and project compliance.
* Develop presentations, graphics, reports, and visual materials that communicate project status and updates to stakeholders.
* Coordinate with user groups and stakeholders to support project objectives and operational requirements.
* Assist in planning and coordinating facility or system shutdowns to minimize operational impacts.
* Facilitate communication between project teams, contractors, consultants, clients, and stakeholders.
* Support project reporting, scheduling, documentation, and administrative activities.
* Assist in identifying and resolving project issues through collaboration with project team members.
* Perform additional project coordination and administrative duties as assigned.

  

Here's what you'll need

**What you'll need:**

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or a minimum of 5 years of construction administration experience.

Experience supporting construction projects through project coordination, contract administration, or project controls activities.

Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Outlook.

Ability to read and understand construction documents, including plans, specifications, and submittal documentation.

Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.

Ability to effectively communicate with clients, contractors, stakeholders, project teams, and leadership.

Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented and matrixed project environment.

Ability to follow written, verbal, and visual instructions and manage multiple priorities effectively.

Familiarity with project management software such as PMWeb, Expedition, e-Builder, Microsoft Project, Bluebeam, Primavera P6, or similar platforms.

Familiarity with construction administration, contract documentation, and project delivery processes.

  
  

**Ideally, you'll also have:**

OSHA 10 certification.

Experience supporting aviation, transportation, infrastructure, or public-sector construction projects.

Familiarity with critical path method (CPM) scheduling concepts and schedule analysis.

Familiarity with construction cost estimating, project controls, and contract administration practices.

Experience preparing project reports, dashboards, and executive-level presentations.

Experience coordinating among diverse stakeholder groups in active construction environments.

Knowledge of document control and project information management best practices.

4. Experience managing projects or project work streams and works as an Individual Contributor  
5. Knowledge of the industry's competitive landscape and the factors that differentiate Truist and its competitors

jobs.description:
**About us**

Crabapple Martial Arts Academy is a family-focused martial arts school in Milton, GA (the Crabapple / Alpharetta area). We teach children and families focus, confidence, discipline, and respect — skills that show up in the classroom, at home, and for life. We're the flagship school of a growing martial-arts company, so there's real room to grow with us.

**The opportunity**

We're hiring a Sales and Enrollment Representative to be the person who brings new families through our doors. You'll start by getting our name into the community and booking families for their first lesson. As you prove yourself, you'll grow into closing new enrollments and selling our long-term programs — with your pay growing at every step. This is for someone who loves people, loves to win, and wants their income to reflect their results.

**What you'll do**

* Build interest in the community through school events, local partnerships, and referral events
* Follow up with interested families and book qualified appointments for a first lesson
* Reconnect with past families through friendly outreach
* Keep our lead-tracking system accurate and up to date
* As you grow: lead enrollment conversations, sign new families, and guide current families into our long-term programs

**How you'll grow — and earn more**

This role is built in stages. You start by filling our pipeline and booking appointments. Once you do that consistently, we add enrollment and commission on every family you sign. Once you've proven that, we add our long-term program sales — the highest-earning part of the job. Each stage adds responsibility and pay.

**What we're looking for**

* 2+ years in a goal-driven, customer-facing role (sales, membership or enrollment sales, business development, recruiting, real estate, hospitality, or similar)
* Comfortable starting conversations with new people and following up professionally
* Organized, reliable, and able to work on-site including some evenings and weekends
* Genuinely warm with children and parents
* Able to pass a background check (we work with kids)

**Nice to have**

* Experience in martial arts, fitness, youth programs, or another membership business
* Familiarity with a CRM or lead-tracking tool
* Roots in the Milton / Alpharetta community

**Compensation**

* $48,000 base salary, steady from day one
* Monthly performance bonus while you build the pipeline
* Uncapped commission as you take on enrollment and long-term sales
* Milestone bonuses tied to the academy's growth
* Typical first-year earnings around $60,000; top performers $90,000–$125,000+

Pay: From $48,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

jobs.description:
**Founding Sales Growth Advisor – Software (Remote)**

$20k – $100k

Founding Sales Growth Advisor – Software (Remote)

Help Build the Future of Business Technology

Arriv Global is building an interconnected ecosystem of business technology designed to help organizations communicate, sell, recruit, hire, train, manage teams, and grow more efficiently.

We're looking for ambitious, relationship-driven individuals to join our founding software sales team and help introduce businesses to the growing Arriv ecosystem.

If you enjoy building relationships, learning technology, solving business problems, and creating opportunities, we'd love to meet you.

Why Join Arriv?

This isn't just another software sales position.

You'll be joining an early-stage technology company where you'll work closely with the founder and help shape how our sales organization grows.

Our founding Sales Growth Advisors aren't simply stepping into an established sales department and following an old playbook.

You'll help build the playbook.

As Arriv expands its technology, customer base, and markets, our founding sales team will help influence future sales strategies, processes, territory development, and growth initiatives.

If you've ever wanted the opportunity to help build a technology company from the ground up, this is your opportunity.

What You'll Represent

Sales Growth Advisors may introduce businesses to authorized solutions within the growing Arriv ecosystem, including:

Arriv One – AI-powered business communication, sales, CRM, calling, messaging, and workflow technology

Khetha IQ – recruiting, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and workforce technology

Arriv Payroll – payroll and compensation solutions designed to integrate with business operations

Additional Arriv products and services as the ecosystem continues to expand

Rather than selling disconnected software products, you'll help businesses understand how different parts of the Arriv ecosystem can work together to solve real operational challenges.

What You'll Do

As an Arriv Sales Growth Advisor, you'll:

Build relationships with business owners, executives, managers, and decision-makers.

Introduce organizations to Arriv's software and technology solutions.

Conduct discovery conversations to understand how businesses currently operate.

Identify problems, inefficiencies, and opportunities where Arriv technology may help.

Recommend appropriate Arriv solutions based on each organization's actual needs.

Conduct virtual product conversations, demonstrations, and presentations.

Generate new business through networking, referrals, phone calls, email, social outreach, and approved local outreach.

Build and manage your own sales pipeline.

Follow up with prospective customers throughout the sales process.

Develop long-term relationships with the accounts you originate.

Maintain accurate sales and customer activity records.

Represent Arriv professionally within your assigned market.

Collaborate directly with leadership as Arriv's products and sales organization continue to evolve.

Our approach is discovery first.

We don't want Sales Growth Advisors pushing the largest package possible.

We want you to understand the customer's problem and recommend the Arriv solution that makes sense for their business.

Who We're Looking For

This opportunity may be a great fit for someone who:

✔ Enjoys talking with people

✔ Loves building professional relationships

✔ Is curious about technology

✔ Is comfortable speaking with business owners and decision-makers

✔ Is self-motivated

✔ Has an entrepreneurial mindset

✔ Enjoys solving problems

✔ Can manage their own pipeline and follow-up

✔ Is comfortable creating new opportunities

✔ Wants to grow alongside an early-stage technology company

✔ Is coachable, motivated, and willing to learn

Previous experience in B2B sales, SaaS, technology, business development, recruiting, payroll, HR technology, or other customer-facing roles is helpful, but not required.

You don't need to arrive knowing every Arriv product.

We'll teach you the technology, the sales process, and how the different parts of the ecosystem work together.

Compensation

This is a commission-based sales opportunity with uncapped earning potential.

Compensation may include:

Implementation/setup commissions on qualifying new customer accounts

Recurring commissions from eligible customer accounts

Performance accelerators

Additional sales incentives

There is no cap on commissions.

Because eligible accounts can generate recurring revenue, successful Sales Growth Advisors have the opportunity to build a growing portfolio of customer relationships rather than relying exclusively on one-time commissions.

Complete commission structures, eligibility requirements, and available accelerators are reviewed during the interview and onboarding process.

Estimated annual earnings: $20,000–$100,000+

Actual earnings depend on individual sales performance and are not guaranteed.

Why Sell Arriv?

Businesses increasingly rely on multiple platforms to manage communication, sales, recruiting, hiring, training, payroll, customer relationships, and internal operations.

Arriv is building technology designed to bring more of those functions into a connected ecosystem.

That gives our Sales Growth Advisors an opportunity to do more than simply sell software.

You'll learn how a business operates, identify where problems exist, and help determine where Arriv technology can provide value.

And because Arriv is still growing, you'll have the opportunity to introduce new products and capabilities to the relationships you build as the ecosystem expands.

Training & Support

Every Sales Growth Advisor receives:

Comprehensive onboarding

Sales training

Product and platform education

Software demonstration training

Prospecting and discovery training

Ongoing coaching

Sales resources

Marketing resources

Technology training

Founder support

We'll train

jobs.description:
**POSITION TITLE:** Assistant Community Manager

**DEPARTMENT:** Resident Services

**REPORTS TO:** Community Manager

**CLASSIFICATION:** Exempt

**JOB SUMMARY:**The Assistant Community Manager assists with managing operations, leasing activity, renewals, collections, financial reporting, supplies, and communications for assigned residential community.

**VALUES MODELED:** All employees are expected to find ways to bring our values to life every day by demonstrating: leadership, commitment, and integrity.

**MEASURES OF SUCCESS:** Resident feedback on quality and timeliness of resident services provided; resident turnover.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Assists in managing day-to-day operations.**
* Assist in managing daily community requirements.
* Ensure all monies received are deposited and recorded on a daily basis and confirms proper bookkeeping procedures are followed.
* Assist Community Manager with preparation of daily and weekly reports, resident communications, move-in inspections, etc.
* Compile weekly/monthly community status reports.
* Promptly respond to resident concerns, comments, and/or complaints.
* Perform routine general office duties, such as filing, cleaning, etc.
* Ensure that the proper move-in paperwork, keys, and remotes are prepared for a new resident.
* Operate the office in a professional, clean, uncluttered, and well-staffed manner.
* Inspect make-ready apartments prior to move in.
* Maintain and/or create a resident renewal program to encourage resident retention; including planning and executing resident functions.
* Create a sense of community at the community while maintaining the policy of non-fraternization.
* **Manage community maintenance with the assistance of the service team.**
* Assist in managing requests for repairs and maintenance and evaluate timely completion of work orders.
* Maintain compliance with required permits for operating the community, such as pool, elevator, etc.
* Monitor electric, water, and gas usage on the community.
* **Manage and monitor rental collection.**
* Ensure rent and other charges are collected timely and posted daily.
* Ensure the proper legal notices are given and deadlines met concerning filing eviction, filing writs, and attending court hearings.
* Ensure compliance with community policies and lease agreements. Responds to violations and communicates with the residents.
* Assess move-out condition of apartments and has a final account statement sent with the final disposition.
* Immediately inform and refer any liability claims, legal complaints, or other violations to the Regional Manager and/or corporate office.
* **Assist with community personnel management.**
* Create, mentor, and manage a cohesive community management team in accordance with policies.
* Coordinate orientation and ongoing training programs for community staff.
* **Manage, create and monitor marketing activities.**
* Understand the market and any other aspects of the sub-market that could impact occupancy and/or income of the community.
* Assist with marketing and leasing apartments.
* Assist with the creation of marketing surveys and understand marketing strategies to secure prospects.
* **Perform other duties as assigned or requested to support community operations.**

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Language Skills:** Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos. Ability to write simple correspondence.
* **Mathematical Skills:** Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent.
* **Reasoning Ability:** Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.
* **Computer Skills:** Strong computer skills in Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Excel software. Experience in conducting Internet searches and using online calendars and databases.

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:**

**Required**

* High school diploma or GED.
* Minimum one year of experience in an Assistant Manager role and property management industry experience, unless being promoted from within.
* Entrata or other property management software.
* Must have reliable transportation, maintain auto insurance, and have a valid driver's license.
* Proven ability to market communities.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.

**Preferred**

* Associate’s Degree.
* CAM, ARM, or CCRM certification.
* Bilingual or multilingual skills.

**COMPETENCIES**

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

**Productivity**

* **Dependability** - Follows instructions; responds to management direction; takes responsibility for own actions; keeps commitments; commits to long hours of work when necessary to reach goals: completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan.
* **Initiative** - Volunteers readily; undertakes self-development activities; seeks increased responsibilities; takes independent actions and calculated risks; looks for and takes advantage of opportunities; asks for and offers help when needed.
* **Integrity** - Treats people with respect; keeps commitments; inspires the trust of others; works with integrity and principles; upholds organizational values.
