jobs.title: Sanitation & Food Safety Program Specialist, US
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and highly technical Sanitation & Food Safety Program Specialist, US to join our growing team!
  
This corporate-level role is responsible for advancing and standardizing sanitation programs across DO & CO’s U.S. operations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on food safety professional who can assess complex production environments, identify sanitation and microbiological risks, lead root-cause investigations, and translate technical requirements into practical, sustainable solutions.
  
  
About DO & CO
  
  
We have a passion for hospitality culinary delights on every elevated floor and in the sky. With our three business segments, Airline Catering, International Event Catering, Restaurants, Lounges & Hotels, we offer gourmet entertainment all over the world. We operate in 33 locations, 12 countries and 3 Continents, maintaining the highest standard of quality in both our products and services. We refine the classics, develop the unknown and grow constantly – sometimes beyond our own expectations.
  
  
Responsibilities
  

* Provide technical oversight and guidance for sanitation programs across DO & CO’s U.S. facilities.
* Develop, standardize, and continuously improve SSOPs, Master Sanitation Schedules, cleaning procedures, and verification standards.
* Conduct sanitation assessments across production areas, ready-to-eat environments, equipment, coolers, freezers, dishrooms, drains, docks, and waste areas.
* Evaluate cleaning methods, chemicals, concentrations, contact times, equipment, sanitation contractors, and service providers.
* Identify hygienic-design concerns and sanitation vulnerabilities and partner with facility teams to implement sustainable solutions.
* Establish standardized pre-operational inspection and release programs across facilities.
* Conduct independent inspections to verify sanitation effectiveness and production readiness.
* Identify food residue, grease, biofilm risks, standing water, damaged surfaces, inaccessible areas, and other sanitation deficiencies
* Ensure corrective actions are completed and effective before equipment or production areas are released for use.
* Maintain consistent documentation, escalation, and follow-up procedures for significant findings.
* Support the development and continuous improvement of Environmental Monitoring Programs, with particular focus on ready-to-eat and high-risk areas.
* Review sampling plans, locations, frequencies, zoning, ATP results, and environmental trend data.
* Lead or support investigations involving recurring environmental findings or pathogens, including Listeria species and Listeria monocytogenes.
* Verify intensified cleaning, resampling, mitigation activities, allergen-cleaning validation, and corrective actions.
* Ensure sanitation tools are properly segregated, dedicated, and color-coded where required.
* Verify the proper selection, concentration, labeling, storage, dispensing, and use of sanitation chemicals.
* Ensure cleaning practices follow manufacturer instructions and established sanitation procedures.
* Evaluate equipment and facilities for harborage points, damaged surfaces, standing water, condensation, deteriorated seals, and other contamination risks.
* Participate in sanitation reviews for new equipment, renovations, construction projects, and process changes.
* Partner with Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, FSQA, chemical suppliers, and facility leadership to resolve sanitation-related deficiencies.
* Review pest-control programs, activity trends, and corrective actions with FSQA and facility leadership.
* Assess waste-handling areas, docks, compactors, recycling areas, and exterior conditions for sanitation and pest risks.
* Verify sanitation procedures supporting Halal segregation and shared-equipment controls.
* Evaluate cleaning and tool-control practices designed to prevent allergen and Halal/non-Halal cross-contact.
* Lead sanitation-related investigations and root-cause analyses.
* Develop risk-based corrective and preventive action recommendations.
* Verify the completion and sustained effectiveness of sanitation CAPAs.
* Identify recurring findings across facilities and recommend long-term, systemic solutions.
* Escalate significant sanitation and food safety risks to FSQA leadership.
* Develop and deliver technical training on SSOPs, GMPs, chemical safety, sanitation verification, environmental pathogen controls, and cross-contamination prevention.
* Coach Sanitation Managers, supervisors, FSQA personnel, Operations teams, and frontline employees.
* Verify training effectiveness through field observations and follow-up assessments.
* Support FDA inspections, customer audits, third-party audits, and internal food safety assessments.
* Assist facilities with regulatory observations, customer findings, CAPAs, and effectiveness verification.
* Promote sanitation as a critical food safety preventive control and shared organizational responsibility.

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Food Safety, Biology, Environmental Health, Public Health, Food Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* At least five years of progressive experience in food manufacturing, airline catering, commissary operations, sanitation, food safety, or quality assurance.
* Strong working knowledge of food sanitation, GMPs, HACCP, Environmental Monitoring Programs, sanitation verification, and preventive controls.
* Demonstrated experience conducting sanitation inspections, investigations, root-cause analyses, and corrective-action follow-up.
* Experience identifying microbiological, sanitation, hygienic-design, allergen, and cross-contamination risks in complex food-production environments.
* Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Capable of working independently while effectively influencing and collaborating with cross-functional tea

**Department**

BSD MED - Emergency Medicine - Del Rios Research Staff

**About the Department**

The Del Rios lab, housed within the section of Emergency Medicine, centers on identifying and mitigating place-based barriers to preventing and surviving catastrophic medical emergencies. We partner with multidisciplinary, multi-institutional research teams to combine rigorous quantitative methods, community engagement, and implementation-focused approaches to address urgent public health challenges, including out-of-hospital cardiac arrest, respiratory virus communication, and the mental health effects of structural and policy environments on minoritized youth. Our work emphasizes the use of mixed methods including machine learning, statistical modeling, epidemiology, and health services research, while fostering trusted community partnerships to develop practical, scalable strategies that improve preparedness, strengthen public health communication, and advance equitable health outcomes.

**Job Summary**

The Clinical Research Coordinator 1 will be responsible for day-to-day research operations across community-based, clinical, and data-driven projects; managing IRB submissions and regulatory documentation; assisting with participant recruitment and enrollment; organizing qualitative interviews, focus groups, and stakeholder engagement activities; tracking study timelines and deliverables; and maintaining high-quality study data. The coordinator may also help liaise with community health workers, public health agencies, healthcare providers, schools, and other partner organizations, making strong communication and relationship-building skills especially important. Because the lab’s work spans topics such as out-of-hospital cardiac arrest, health communication, and policy impacts on youth mental health, the position would be well suited for someone with interests in public health, emergency medicine, health services research, and community-engaged, equity-focused research.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as a resource person or act as a consultant within area of clinical expertise.
* Maintain working knowledge of current protocols, and internal SOPs.

* Develop and implement procedures, maintain records, track progress, and conduct quality assurance on data collected.

* Provide Investigators with guidance regarding protocol requirements.
* Maintain regulatory documentation.
* Assist other research personnel with reports to regulatory agencies, such as the IRB, FDA and Data and Safety Review Committee.
* Prepare for and assist with audits, inspections, and monitoring visits from regulatory agencies or sponsors.

* Performs various professional, organizational, and operational tasks under limited supervision.
* Acts as a resource on clinical research and related aspects of clinical study for other clinical research staff.

jobs.title: Luxury Inventory & Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
Luxury Inventory & Logistics Coordinator

**PROVENANCE by Diana Michelle**  
900 North Michigan Shops | Chicago, IL  
**Part-Time | Approximately 15–25 hours per week**  
**Compensation: $24–$28 per hour, based on experience**

About PROVENANCE

PROVENANCE by Diana Michelle is an independent luxury boutique located at 900 North Michigan Shops in Chicago. We specialize in niche luxury fragrance, custom clothing, cashmere, jewelry and accessories, with an emphasis on exceptional product curation, personalized service, and long-term client relationships.

We are seeking a highly organized, trustworthy, and detail-oriented **Luxury Inventory & Logistics Coordinator** to oversee the movement and documentation of merchandise from receipt through delivery to our boutique.

This is an operational role requiring a high degree of accuracy, discretion, personal accountability, and comfort working with valuable merchandise.

The Role

The Luxury Inventory & Logistics Coordinator will help manage the merchandise flow between our vendors, receiving location, inventory system, and retail boutique.

You will be responsible for ensuring that incoming merchandise is properly received, counted, inspected, documented, entered into our inventory system when authorized, organized, and transferred to the store with a clear chain of custody.

Because this position involves access to valuable merchandise and confidential business information, **integrity, discretion, and adherence to security procedures are essential.**

Key ResponsibilitiesInventory Receiving & Verification

* Receive domestic and international merchandise shipments.
* Carefully open, inspect, and count incoming merchandise.
* Match merchandise against packing slips, invoices, purchase orders, and other receiving documentation.
* Verify quantities, SKUs, product descriptions, and other identifying information.
* Identify shortages, overages, incorrect merchandise, damaged goods, or other discrepancies.
* Photograph and document shipments or discrepancies when appropriate.
* Promptly report receiving issues to management rather than making unauthorized corrections or assumptions.

Lightspeed & Inventory Records

* Receive approved merchandise into the Lightspeed POS/inventory system.
* Accurately enter and verify quantities and product information.
* Maintain clean and accurate inventory records.
* Assist with inventory counts and reconciliation.
* Help identify discrepancies between physical merchandise and system inventory.
* Maintain accurate documentation of merchandise transfers and adjustments.
* Follow established authorization procedures for inventory changes.

System access will be limited to the functions necessary for the position. This role does not require unrestricted access to customer information, financial reporting, or other sensitive areas of the business.

Inventory Organization & Logistics

* Maintain an organized and secure receiving area.
* Sort and prepare merchandise for transfer to the PROVENANCE boutique.
* Label and organize merchandise according to established procedures.
* Coordinate the movement of inventory between the receiving location and store.
* Maintain clear documentation and chain of custody for merchandise movements.
* Confirm that merchandise leaving one location is accurately accounted for upon arrival at the other.
* Assist with vendor returns, damaged merchandise, shipment exceptions, and other inventory-related logistics.
* Keep receiving and storage areas orderly, professional, and secure.

Inventory Accuracy & Loss Prevention

* Follow established procedures for handling high-value merchandise.
* Maintain accurate counts throughout the receiving and transfer process.
* Document inventory movement rather than relying on memory or informal communication.
* Immediately escalate missing merchandise, unexplained discrepancies, damaged shipments, or unusual circumstances.
* Follow PROVENANCE security, access-control, and loss-prevention procedures at all times.

Confidentiality & Professional Standards

This position may provide access to confidential business information, including inventory levels, vendor information, purchasing records, product costs, receiving documentation, and internal operating procedures.

The successful candidate must be comfortable working within strict confidentiality and access-control guidelines.

Company information may not be copied, exported, photographed, stored on personal devices, forwarded to personal accounts, or shared with unauthorized individuals.

We believe access should be based on what is necessary to perform the job. The Inventory & Logistics Coordinator will therefore receive the system and physical access required for the position without unnecessary access to unrelated confidential business information.

Who We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who is:

* Exceptionally detail-oriented and accurate.
* Reliable and consistent.
* Highly organized.
* Trustworthy and discreet.
* Comfortable being accountable for valuable merchandise.
* Able to work independently without sacrificing accuracy.
* Methodical about documentation and process.
* Comfortable following security and access-control procedures.
* Able to identify discrepancies and escalate them appropriately.
* Professional in handling confidential business information.
* Comfortable learning inventory and POS technology.
* Someone who takes pride in leaving systems, merchandise, and workspaces organized.

You should naturally be the kind of person who notices when **12 units arrived but the paperwork says 13**—and who stops to investigate rather than simply entering the number into the system.

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is helpful:

* Luxury retail
* Inventory management
* Merchandise receiving
* Stockroom or back-of-house operations
* Retail operations
* Showroom operations
* Logistics or fulfillment
* POS or inventory-management systems
* High-va

Ready to join our quest for better?

 **Job Description**

The **Administrative Coordinator** position reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Administrative Coordinator is responsible for higher-level administrative support to Directors within the organization and must use independent judgment and authority to execute projects and maintain workflow. The incumbent will work as part of team and demonstrate superior organization skills, strong interpersonal and communication skills, and attention to detail proficient Microsoft application skills (Word, Excel and PowerPoint) and be highly flexible and adaptable.

**Responsibilities:**

* Prepares documents and manages data using NM software applications including Microsoft Office.
* Manages calendar; sets meeting priorities; identifies objectives of meetings and identifies materials needed for meeting; exercises judgment to ensure appropriate parties attend meeting.
* Screens incoming email, mail and telephone calls to assign priority to call and/or identify additional resources to manage caller’s need.
* Independently plans and executes activities such as room scheduling, signage, catering, support staff and equipment, and preparation and distribution of notifications, in support of projects and meetings as appropriate.
* Assists with creation and preparation of materials, which are presented, to management, committees and subcommittees, particularly power point presentations and printed materials.

* Authors responses on behalf of Director or department.

**Position Summary**

The Marketing Coordinator, CRM & Loyalty will be the day-to-day driver of customer retention at Terrabis. This role builds and sends SMS and email campaigns, creates and maintains audiences, keeps CRM data accurate, and troubleshoots platform issues. It also serves as the direct point of contact for loyalty program members by phone and mail. This role reports to and works closely with the Marketing Manager, Growth & Communications, with one goal: keeping Terrabis customers engaged, rewarded, and coming back.

**Responsibilities**

***CRM Campaign Execution***

* Build, schedule, and send SMS and email campaigns in Alpine IQ (AIQ) or other CRM tools, from brief through final QA.
* Execute retention, winback, and loyalty campaigns, offers, and automations based on strategic briefs and the marketing calendar.
* QA every send for accuracy, links, segmentation, compliance, and brand standards before launch.
* Support A/B testing of subject lines, creative, offers, and send timing.

***Audience & Data Management***

* Create and maintain audiences and segments based on purchase behavior, visit frequency, preferences, and loyalty tier.
* Perform CRM data entry and maintenance, including customer profile updates, loyalty point adjustments, opt-in and opt-out records, and list hygiene.
* Track retention and campaign KPIs (e.g., open rates, CTRs, redemption rates, repeat visits, reactivations) and compile regular performance reports.

***CRM Troubleshooting & Platform Support***

* Monitor campaign delivery and troubleshoot send failures, data sync errors, and audience or automation issues.
* Serve as the first point of contact for store teams on CRM and loyalty questions, escalating complex issues to the Marketing Manager, Growth & Communications, or vendor support.
* Maintain up-to-date documentation of loyalty rules, tiers, processes, and customer-facing communications.
* Stay up to date on AIQ feature releases and CRM best practices to maximize platform value.

***Loyalty Program Customer Service***

* Handle inbound and outbound phone calls with loyalty members, resolving questions about points, rewards, tiers, account access, and communication preferences.
* Respond to escalated loyalty questions from customers and store teams by phone and email.
* Write, print, and mail customer letters, sending from home or through USPS, UPS, or FedEx using a company expense account. Terrabis covers all postage and shipping costs.
* Keep a log of customer contacts and outcomes to surface recurring issues and retention opportunities.
* Ensure all customer-facing communications comply with state cannabis regulations, SMS and email consent rules, and Terrabis brand guidelines.

***Collaboration & Vendor Liaison***

* Partner closely with the Marketing Manager, Growth & Communications, on campaign priorities, customer journeys, and program changes.
* Collaborate with retail activators and store teams to support in-store loyalty signups and drives.
* Maintain CRM vendor contacts and ensure timely follow-up on support tickets, fixes, and deliverables.

***Administrative & Ad Hoc Support***

* Draft presentation decks, slide updates, and one-pagers for manager reviews.
* Organize team meetings, take notes, and track action items to completion.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

***Education & Experience***

* Bachelor's degree (Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field) or equivalent experience.
* 1-3 years of hands-on CRM experience building and sending email and/or SMS campaigns.
* Customer service experience, ideally including phone support.
* Cannabis retail or dispensary experience a plus.

***Technical Skills***

* Alpine IQ (AIQ) experience strongly preferred; experience with a similar CRM or email/SMS platform considered.
* Experience building audiences and segments from customer and purchase data.
* Familiarity with Dutchie or other POS/ecommerce platforms a plus.
* Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets for data entry, cleanup, and reporting.
* Comfortable with Microsoft Teams.
* Familiar with Claude or ChatGPT AI platforms.
* Project management tool experience a plus (Asana or similar).

***Soft Skills***

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail, especially data accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional phone presence and the ability to write clear, friendly customer letters.
* Customer-first mindset with patience and sound judgment when resolving member issues.
* Proactive problem-solver who troubleshoots independently and escalates issues appropriately.
* Self-motivated and dependable in a remote work environment.
* Collaborative mindset, comfortable working across teams and vendors.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, pregnancy, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics.*

jobs.description:
As the leading global type 1 diabetes (T1D) research and advocacy organization, Breakthrough T1D helps make everyday life with T1D better while driving toward cures. We invest in the most promising research to turn ideas into life-changing therapies and devices. We work with government, regulatory officials, and insurance companies to address issues that impact the T1D community - breaking through barriers that limit access to care worldwide. We provide resources and guidance that makes it easier to live and thrive with T1D. This is more than a moment - we're empowering a movement for the T1D community. Share your support and help educate and empower individuals facing type 1 diabetes.

Our mission is to improve lives today and tomorrow by accelerating life changing breakthroughs to treat, prevent and ultimately, cure T1D and its complications. **Always, we are guided by a single purpose: As we drive towards curing type 1 diabetes, we help make everyday life better for the people who face it** .

**Summary**

The Operations Assistant (OA) at Breakthrough T1D is integral in the day-to-day execution of fundraising and community engagement event efforts, donor and supporter management, office operations, marketing, and event logistics to support our organizational strategy and mission. The OA helps to organize, coordinate, implement, and expand a variety of the territory’s development activities that build and strengthen links to potential and existing volunteers and donors and that grow the territory’s reach, revenue, and engagement. Their relationships with constituents and donors on behalf of Breakthrough T1D ensure the expansion of our reach to support maximum territory growth to further our mission.

The Operations Assistant role focuses on key operational needs of the territory that support relationship building with donors and fundraising volunteers. They are a force multiplier for their territory colleagues in driving impact and strengthening both donor and volunteer engagement resulting in increased revenue and results.

This individual is a detail-oriented team player who can effectively manage competing priorities and complex details through collaboration, communication, and engagement. They support the implementation of organizational strategies through their territory to drive optimal results and actively demonstrate and promote enterprise-wide mindsets.

  

As one of the top performing territories in the country, the Illinois Territory plays a vital role in the organization’s success. The Territory has 17 staff, 1 Chapter Board, and 10+ events collectively driving over $25 million in total net revenue.

  

We have a hybrid work schedule, in office two days a week and working remotely and in the field three days a week.

Administration – 40%

Awareness – 20%

**Qualifications**

  

* 2 years of administrative, operations or business/volunteer experience preferred. Fundraising and event experience preferred.

Proven ability to successfully manage various event details, timelines, and skilled in efficient time management. Able to meet deadlines under pressure. Detail-oriented and strong organizational skills.

* Ability to be an enthusiastic spokesperson/representative of Breakthrough T1D’s mission. Clear communicator.

jobs.title: Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Event Coordinator**  
**Gatherline Events · Chicago, IL · Hybrid with on-site event work**  
**$27–$30 per hour · Full-time, W-2**

Gatherline Events organizes conferences, team meetings, and client events for businesses and nonprofit organizations.

We’re looking for an Event Coordinator to help turn approved plans into well-organized events. You’ll work with an Event Producer, supporting registration, supplier coordination, schedules, and on-site delivery. You won’t be expected to lead complex events independently from day one.

**What you’ll do**

* Maintain event schedules, task lists, guest records, and planning documents.
* Request supplier quotes and confirm arrangements for catering, audiovisual equipment, signage, and transportation.
* Prepare attendee communications, joining instructions, name badges, and registration materials.
* Track confirmations, deadlines, and approved costs, raising missing information or changes promptly.
* Support events on-site by coordinating check-in, briefing suppliers, and helping guests find the right information.
* Collect feedback and organize receipts, invoices, and outstanding items after each event.

The Event Producer owns the overall budget, client commitments, and major supplier decisions. You’ll receive clear approval limits and a named escalation contact.

**What you’ll bring**

* Around one to two years of experience in events, hospitality, administration, or another role involving bookings and customer coordination.
* Strong organization and accuracy when handling names, dates, quantities, and instructions.
* Clear communication with guests, colleagues, and suppliers.
* Confidence using spreadsheets, shared calendars, and presentation tools.
* The ability to stay composed when plans change and ask for support when needed.

Relevant internships, volunteer event work, and community projects count toward experience. A college degree and event-management certification are not required. Familiarity with registration platforms is helpful; training is provided.

**Schedule, location, and travel**

During planning weeks, expect approximately **40 working hours**, usually Monday–Friday during Central Time business hours. The normal arrangement is three days in our Chicago office and two days remote.

Event assignments replace the usual office schedule and can include early starts, evenings, or weekends. Expect approximately **one or two evening or weekend assignments per month**, with busier periods communicated through the event calendar.

Event weeks may reach **45–50 hours**. All working hours are recorded, and hours worked above 40 in a workweek are paid at 1.5 times your regular rate. Meal breaks are separate from working hours.

Most events are in Greater Chicago. Expect up to four domestic trips annually, usually lasting two to three nights. Approved transportation, accommodation, and meals are covered, and required business travel time is paid under our company policy.

On-site work includes extended periods of standing and walking and handling light event materials. Reasonable accommodations are available.

**Pay and benefits**

* **$27–$30 per hour**, based on relevant coordination and event experience.
* Approximately **$56,160–$62,400 annually** at 2,080 paid hours, excluding overtime. No commission.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employer contributions.
* 401(k) with an employer match.
* 15 paid vacation days, paid company holidays, and separate sick leave.
* Company laptop, required software, and paid onboarding.
* Support for approved event-industry training and professional development.

You’ll initially support smaller meetings and accompany an experienced colleague on-site before taking ownership of more complex assignments.

**How to apply**

Submit your résumé and a brief example of an event, booking, or project you helped organize. Explain your contribution; a formal portfolio is not required.

Our process includes an introductory call and a conversation with the hiring manager about a sample event scenario. There is no take-home assignment.

Candidates must be able to commute to Chicago, meet the event and travel requirements, and be authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance are not available. Interview accommodations are available upon request.

Pay: $27.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60618

Green Office Partner, ranked the **#1** Best Place to Work by Crain’s (2023,24,25 & 26) and the Chicago Sun-Times (2024 & 2025), is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented **Post-Sales Operations & Implementation Coordinator (OTI Coordinator**) to manage the critical transition from a signed customer agreement through installation readiness and final project closeout.

We deliver HP and Xerox Managed Print Services, Intelligent Document Processing, and Conference Room/Audio-Video Solutions that help enterprises reduce costs, increase efficiency, and modernize their workplaces.

The **OTI Coordinator** serves as the operational connection between **Sales, Purchasing, Finance, Project Management, and Client Success**, ensuring every new customer order is accurate, properly staged, internally aligned, and ready for successful implementation.

This role owns the post-signature coordination process—including order verification, system setup, internal kickoff meetings, client onboarding coordination, milestone tracking, and final Delivery & Acceptance documentation.

The ideal candidate enjoys bringing structure to complex processes, coordinating multiple departments, communicating directly with clients, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Order Staging:** Review signed agreements for accurate equipment, leasing, billing, and customer information.
* **System Setup:** Coordinate post-sale customer setup and updates across CRM, ERP, and monitoring systems.
* **Internal Coordination:** Lead the internal handoff meeting with Project Management, Purchasing, Finance, and Client Success.
* **Client Onboarding:** Co-lead the customer kickoff, confirm scope and site requirements, and transition installation to the Project Manager.
* **Project Tracking:** Monitor key milestones and help resolve outstanding operational items throughout implementation.
* **Project Closeout:** Secure signed Delivery & Acceptance (D&A) documentation and submit completed packages to Finance.
* **Lease Returns:** Coordinate final payments, LOIs, timing, and documentation for equipment returns when applicable.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience in **order management, sales operations, project coordination, customer onboarding, or a similar operational role**.
* Experience working with CRM, ERP, order-management, or related business systems.
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple customer projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively between Sales, Finance, Operations, Purchasing, and Project Management.
* Professional client-facing communication skills and confidence participating in customer onboarding meetings.
* Ability to identify missing information, resolve operational issues, and proactively move projects forward.
* Comfortable working in a process-driven environment where documentation accuracy and timely follow-through are critical.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means that when a customer signs an agreement, the transition into implementation feels **organized, professional, and seamless**.

Orders are accurate. Internal teams know their responsibilities. Customers understand what happens next. Project Managers receive complete information. Installations move forward without avoidable delays. And final documentation is completed quickly so the project can be properly closed and funded.

The **OTI Coordinator** is the person who **connects all of those pieces together.**

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive base salary based on experience and qualifications.
* Performance-based compensation opportunities where applicable.
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and wellness benefits.
* 401(k) retirement savings program with competitive employer matching.
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and company-paid holidays.
* Company-supported professional development and training opportunities.
* Collaborative work environment with direct exposure to Sales, Operations, Finance, Project Management, and Client Success leadership.
* Company-provided technology and tools necessary to effectively manage customer implementations.

**Why Green Office Partner**

At Green Office Partner, we believe great customer experiences are created by great teams working together. The **OTI Coordinator** plays a central role in that experience—connecting the promise made during the sales process with the operational execution that follows.

If you enjoy **organization, accountability, customer interaction, process improvement, and bringing multiple departments together to get things done**, this position provides an opportunity to have a direct impact on both our clients and our organization.

*Green Office Partner is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.*

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role.
* Experience with core cloud computing concepts and enterprise architecture principles, (e.g., networking, compute, storage, IT security, database systems, application development, operational frameworks).

-----------------

As a Technical Success Account Manager (TSAM), you will serve as a strategic technical leader aligned with Google Cloud’s most critical customers. You are responsible for driving sustained platform health, achieving technical excellence, and ensuring stability for key business critical workloads running on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role requires independently forging executive relationships, advocating the implementation of Google Cloud architecture standards, elevating platform stability, and establishing technical standards across the customer’s Google Cloud footprint, through a programmatic approach. Additionally, you will serve as the internal customer advocate, translating their strategic needs into feedback for Google Cloud’s Product and Engineering teams, ensuring continuous service improvement and feature development.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Establish and lead Technical Governance, focusing on platform health metrics and enterprise readiness planning.
* Provide technical guidance and advocate the adoption of Google Cloud architecture and best practices via deep dives and workshops.
* Drive platform stability and excellence through deep architectural health assessments.
* Serve as the strategic technical advisor to address and resolve critical reliability concerns, advising on and guiding the architecture of robust, scalable, and resilient workloads.
* Act as the internal customer advocate, translating technical obstacles to influence GCP product roadmaps. Own workload success, stabilization, and ongoing optimization to ensure sustained business value.

jobs.title: Marketing Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Built on service. Powered by people.**
========================================

Impact exists because a small group of industry leaders believed companies in our space were doing it wrong. Many prioritized margins while the people doing the work and the clients relying on it became an afterthought. Impact was built differently: invest in great people, trust them to do great work, and deliver the kind of service clients remember. That approach helped us grow from a small office technology company into a national managed services provider, while remaining privately owned and people-first.

What makes Impact special is that growth has never come at the expense of the values that got us here. We continue to reinvest in our people, our capabilities, and the opportunities ahead so employees can grow alongside the business. We’ve built something special, but we’re far from finished. The people who join Impact now will help define what comes next.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are looking for a Marketing Manager who owns client relationships — not just manages them. Accountable for the full client experience from Executive Marketing Consultant handoff through renewal, the Marketing Manager serves as a fractional marketing director for a portfolio of 8-10 B2B clients. You translate each client’s business case into 90-day execution plans, lead Quarterly Business Reviews and Campaign Planning Reviews, direct cross-functional delivery across Strategy, Creative, Paid Media, and Web, and own the renewal conversation. Success in this role is defined by one thing: your clients’ businesses grow, and they renew because of it. This is an ownership role, not a coordination role.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the primary client relationship from Executive Marketing Consultant handoff through renewal and expansion as the client’s single point of strategic accountability at IMM.
* Own the client business case as the single source of truth and continuously pressure-test it against evolving client objectives and market conditions.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews and Campaign Planning Reviews by building the narrative, running the meeting, and following through on every commitment.
* Translate annual strategy into 90-day, hypothesis-driven execution plans tied to client business outcomes.
* Direct cross-functional delivery across Strategy, Creative, Paid Media, and Web for assigned accounts, aligning the team around the business case rather than only the task list.
* Manage the account handoff process by reviewing the full brief, flagging gaps, signing off in writing, and booking the first client check-in within 5 business days.
* Proactively monitor retention risk, account health, and expansion potential, surfacing threats and opportunities before they require escalation.
* Identify and present upsell and cross-sell opportunities to clients, with expansion MRR tracked and reviewed quarterly.
* Own the renewal conversation with support from the Head of Delivery on at-risk accounts.
* Maintain IMM Elevate records, including brief submissions, account intelligence, performance data, and renewal documentation.
* Write and execute an annual Business Plan covering role north star, value creation targets, strategic exclusions, and personal operating system.

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* 3-5 years of account management, client services, or marketing management experience at an agency or B2B marketing services firm.
* Proven ownership of client business reviews, including building the narrative, running the meeting, and handling hard conversations when results are off.
* B2B marketing fluency with an understanding of how marketing connects to pipeline, revenue, and business outcomes.
* Performance marketing literacy with the ability to hold paid media, SEO, and content specialists accountable and tell a data-backed performance story to client executives.
* Active AI workflow adoption, with current hands-on use of AI tools in day-to-day work.
* Cross-functional delivery experience managing output across creative, strategy, and digital teams under real deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to identify retention risk early and address it before it becomes a client-facing problem.
* Track record of growing accounts through upsell, expansion, or NRR improvement, not just renewing them flat.
* Executive communication skills with the confidence to challenge clients with perceptiveness and business acumen.
* Disciplined operating rhythm, including timely QBRs, current Elevate records, and an active business plan.

**What Drives Impact**
----------------------

Behaviors define what our core values look like in action. Leaders are expected to model them; teams are expected to live them:

* Innovation: We embrace change because innovation lives outside the comfort zone.
* Passion: We are driven by purpose, fueled by passion, and obsessed with making an impact.
* Honesty: We are fiercely transparent and consistently honest.
* Fun: We fuel work with fun, knowing life's too short for boring.
* Low Ego: We champion ideas over titles, because brilliance knows no rank.
* One Team: We win as a team, we lose as a team, we are one team.

**Compensation**
----------------

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skillset, experience and training, licensures and/or certifications, and other organizational needs.

Impact may offer applicable incentive compensation plans depending on role and/or department.

Full compensation details can and will be discussed with an Impact Talent Acquisition team member at the start of the interview process.

**Benefits We Take Pride In**
-----------------------------

* 5-year Tiffany & Co. Gift Card or Custom Menswear, 10-year Custom Rolex, 20-year $20,000 Check incentive rewards
* Valuable time off with up to 20 days of PTO, 7 Paid Sick Days, 12+ paid holiday

jobs.title: Surety Account Manager III
jobs.description:
Posting Description:

**Surety Account Manager III**

Are you a surety professional who thrives at the intersection of client service, underwriting strategy, and operational execution? Join a high-performing team and take on a meaningful role managing and delivering surety bond solutions for many clients!

This hybrid position requires working 3 days a week from an Aon office.

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**

At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What the day will look like**

Provides analytical and operational services for a portfolio of surety bond clients, with an emphasis on accuracy, client interaction, underwriting pricing rigor & negotiation, and execution quality. Partners closely with clients to facilitate timely issuance of surety obligations. Reports to the regional Surety Operations leader. (Director or Team Lead).

* Operates with a high degree of autonomy and judgment across complex or strategically significant accounts and in dealing with markets.
* Takes primary accountability for handling selected key accounts, including coordination of large bond programs and sophisticated underwriting submissions.
* Possesses strong, in-depth knowledge of surety bonds, including contract and commercial surety, indemnity structures, and market dynamics.
* Serves as a technical lead within the team; assists in training, mentoring, and developing internal team, and contributes to improvement in execution initiatives.
* Collaborates daily with carriers on complex needs. Prepares and processes a broad range of surety instruments, including but not limited to bid, final, miscellaneous, and court bonds, ensuring alignment with underwriting parameters and client requirements.
* Collaborates daily with clients on complex needs. Completes Consents of Surety, Prequalification Letters, Riders, and other client required obligations per State requirements. Determines appropriate documentation to finalize issuance, i.e. power-of-attorney, resident license, etc. with attention to contractual, legal, and financial implications.
* Prepares General Indemnity Agreements and bond applications, coordinating with and advising clients to obtain complete, accurate financial and corporate information for underwriting review – including any other nuanced client needs or requirements.
* Maintains and facilitates data integrity and enabling proactive management of bond programs in AonBondLink (ABL).
* Works closely with internal collaborators to build and maintain accurate, complete electronic bond files in AonBondLink (ABL). It also confirms and manages client financial and underwriting records while following internal controls and audit requirements to avoid E&O.
* Manages countersignature requirements and related jurisdictional nuances to support compliant bond issuance across multiple states and territories.
* Provides technical surety guidance and support to non-surety colleagues, helping interpret bond forms, indemnity requirements, and program structures for internal stakeholders.
* Coordinates receipt and organization of pertinent client related underwriting information (e.g., financial statements, work-in-progress schedules, bank information, organizational documents) to support timely carrier decisions.
* Verifies that all bonds are issued within established surety lines of credit and brokerage authority; assists in structuring and negotiating approvals for bond requests that exceed standard limits or fall outside delegated authority.

**How this opportunity is different**

Unlike many surety operations roles focused mainly on transaction processing, this position combines technical surety expertise with client advisory duties and meaningful market involvement. You will work directly with complex bonding programs, underwriting negotiations, and carrier relationships while acting as a trusted resource for clients and internal colleagues. The role also allows for broader influence through mentoring, participation in operational improvement, and responsibility for critical compliance and underwriting workflows. For professionals wanting to move beyond administrative bond issuance and act as a strategic partner in the surety process, this is an outstanding chance to increase visibility, expand impact, and grow within a leading organization.

**Skills and experience that will lead to success**

* Is able to effectively interpret a wide range of technical instructions and documentation involving abstract and concrete variables, including financial analyses, contractual provisions, and underwriting guidelines.
* Possesses experience or formal education in Risk Management, Insurance, and/or Surety, and applies this background to enhance client and market outcomes.
* Demonstrates strong organizational, time-management, and multi-tasking skills, consistently managing high-volume and complex workloads.
* Maintains Notary Public designation.
* Maintains Power of Attorney appointments with major surety markets and is regarded as a trusted signatory.
* Maintains appropriate Producer license
* Is proficient in all required technology platforms, including AonBondLink, Bridge, and Outlook, and utilizes these systems to manage data, analyze bond portfolios, and support decision-making.

Education and licensing requirements: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred for this position. Maintain Notary Public designation and hold the appropriate Property and Casualty license.

More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT and many more.

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient.
  
  
The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

------------------------

* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience with Microsoft Excel
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for two (2) of the following: compute, storage, networking, CDN, databases, DevOps, big data and analytics, security, or applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Experience designing, implementing, operating or consulting on distributed applications

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience producing executive-level written materials and presenting to executive audiences
* Do you have experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings?
* Do you have experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead?

This role is also the foundation of your sales career. The skills, commercial instincts, and client relationships you build here are what will prepare you for promotion to Business Development Manager within 6 to 12 months, where you will own the full sales cycle from first conversation to close.

TheAssistant Project Manager (APM) supports the planning, coordination, and execution of building automation and controls projects from installation through commissioning and turnover. This role is responsible for managing defined portions of projects and smaller-scale jobs while developing the skills required for full project ownership.

Working under the guidance of a Project Manager or Sr. Project Manager, the APM plays a key role in coordinating field activities, maintaining project documentation, and supporting budget and schedule tracking. This position is designed as a transitional step toward a full Project Manager role.

**Benefits and Compensation**

UMMA offers a competitive compensation and benefits package with comprehensive and cost-effective medical plans. Benefits package includes Medical, Dental, Vision, AD&D and Supplemental Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Program Tuition Reimbursement, loan repayment opportunities, 403(b) savings plan, employee discounts, extended lunch on Fridays, and more!

Our compensation plan also includes Paid Holidays, Paid Time Off (accruals begin on the first day of hire), Employee Recognition, and more!!

**SUMMARY**
-----------

The Mobile Optometry Program Coordinator is responsible for coordinating patient access, scheduling, registration, school-site logistics, outreach, and follow-up activities for the Mobile Optometry Program. This position serves as the primary front-office and patient coordination resource for mobile optometry services and serves as the primary driver and logistics lead for the mobile optometry vehicle.

The Mobile Optometry Program Coordinator works closely with schools, clinic staff, patients, families, the Optometry Assistant, and the Program Manager to ensure patients are identified, registered, scheduled, prepared, and ready for their optometry services. At school locations, the Program Coordinator serves as the primary onsite liaison with school personnel and coordinates the movement and readiness of students scheduled to receive services. At clinic and community sites, the coordinator organizes patient arrival, registration, waiting areas, and flow into the mobile optometry unit.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**
--------------------

**Patient Scheduling and Registration**

* Coordinate scheduling of patients for mobile and portable optometry services.
* Contact patients and families to schedule or confirm appointments.
* Verify demographic and contact information prior to appointments.
* Obtain or coordinate collection of insurance information.
* Assist patients and families with completion of required registration forms, consents, questionnaires, and other documentation.
* Identify incomplete registration information before scheduled service dates and conduct outreach to resolve outstanding items.
* Coordinate appointment reminders through telephone calls, text messages, electronic systems, or other approved methods.
* Maintain accurate appointment schedules and patient rosters.
* Work to fill cancelled appointments and unused appointment capacity.

**School Coordination**

* Serve as the day-of-service operational contact for school administrators, nurses, teachers, office personnel, and other designated school staff.
* Receive and maintain approved student appointment rosters.
* Coordinate with school staff to identify students who are scheduled to receive services.
* Assist with coordinating students' release from classrooms according to school procedures.
* Escort or coordinate students from designated areas to the mobile optometry service location when appropriate.
* Ensure students are returned to the appropriate school location following completion of services.
* Track students who are absent, unavailable, decline services, or cannot be seen and coordinate rescheduling when appropriate.
* Communicate schedule changes, delays, or operational concerns to school representatives and the Program Manager.
* Protect student and patient privacy when coordinating services in school environments.

**Mobile Site Setup and Patient Flow**

* Serve as the onsite logistics lead for patient arrival and waiting-area operations.
* Establish and organize registration and waiting areas outside the mobile unit when appropriate, including tents, tables, chairs, signage, and registration materials.
* Check patients in and confirm completion of required documentation before entering the mobile unit.
* Coordinate patient flow with the Optometry Assistant to prevent congestion and unnecessary delays.
* Communicate delays and estimated wait times to patients, families, and school personnel as appropriate.
* Assist with setup and breakdown of mobile service locations.

**Outreach and Patient Communication**

* Serve as a primary telephone and program contact for patients and families.
* Answer general questions regarding appointments, mobile service locations, registration requirements, eyeglass delivery, and program processes.
* Conduct outreach to patients who miss appointments or require rescheduling.
* Provide approved instructions regarding where patients should report for services and what documentation they should bring.
* Assist patients with navigating follow-up appointments and other non-clinical next steps.
* Route clinical questions to the Optometry Assistant, licensed optometrist, or appropriate clinical staff.

**Eyeglass and Follow-Up Coordination**

* Track patients requiring eyeglasses or additional follow-up following their optometry examination

new_jobs.description:
**GENERAL FUNCTION / SUMMARY**

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Executive Assistant to provide high-level administrative support to multiple senior executives while taking ownership of day-to-day operational coordination, including purchasing, vendor management, and shipment tracking. The ideal candidate is proactive, resourceful, and thrives in a fast-paced environment managing competing priorities.

This role requires excellent communication skills, strong judgment, and the ability to maintain confidentiality at all times. Bilingual proficiency in English and Chinese is required.

**MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**ExecutiveAdministrative Support:**

* Manage and coordinate complex calendars for multiple executives, including scheduling meetings, appointments, and resolving scheduling conflicts
* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, and detailed itineraries
* Serve as a primary point of contact between executives and internal/external stakeholders
* Prioritize and manage incoming requests, ensuring alignment with executive priorities
* Prepare, proofread, and manage correspondence, reports, and presentations
* Organize meetings, including agenda preparation, logistics coordination, note-taking, and follow-ups
* Track deadlines, action items, and deliverables across multiple executives
* Handle confidential and sensitive information with the highest level of discretion
* Assist with event planning and coordination as needed

* Coordinate and track shipments, deliveries, and order fulfillment to ensure on-time and accurate delivery
* Communicate directly with vendors and suppliers to resolve issues, negotiate timelines, and prevent disruptions
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate replenishment to avoid shortages or overstock
* Process and reconcile purchase orders, invoices, and expense tracking with high accuracy
* Maintain organized and up-to-date records of vendors, orders, and logistics activities
* Identify operational inefficiencies and proactively implement process improvements
* Support cost control efforts through vendor comparison, pricing analysis, and negotiation

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Proven experience as an Executive Assistant supporting multiple executives or senior leadership
* Bilingual in English (written and verbal) and Chinese (verbal)
* Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to multitask and perform under tight deadlines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to exercise sound judgment
* High level of professionalism and discretion
* Experience in operations, logistics, procurement, or a related field (experience supporting executives is a plus)
* Experience with vendor management, purchasing, and shipment tracking

* Experience supporting C-level executives
* Experience in financial industries
* Familiarity with travel booking platforms and expense reporting systems

* Experience with inventory management systems, ERP platforms, or procurement tools
* Background in supply chain, distribution, or operations-heavy environments
* Experience with cost analysis, budgeting, or vendor negotiations
* Comfortable handling high-volume operational workflows

**Additional Expectations**

* Ability to act as a gatekeeper and effectively manage executive time and priorities
* Proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate needs and address issues before they arise
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
* Occasional flexibility outside standard business hours, as needed
* Takes ownership of tasks and drives them through completion with minimal supervision

With over 30 years of experience, TransGlobal has grown into the largest Asian-focused, all-in-one financial services platform in the U.S. We offer a comprehensive suite of services-including life and health insurance, annuities, real estate, private lending, tax and estate planning, and investment management-through a network of 30+ branches across 14 states and over 5,000 professional independent agents. Our mission is to deliver trustworthy, customer-centric financial solutions, all in your language and aligned with your goals.

* **Industry Leader**: Join the nation's largest Asian-focused financial services firm with a well-established brand and expansive network.

* **Career Growth**: Access to cross-functional training, licensing support, and professional development opportunities.
* **Collaborative Culture**: Be part of a supportive team that values innovation, initiative, and shared success.
* **Impactful Work**: Help individuals and families achieve financial security and generational wealth.

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to work in a collaborative and innovative environment.
* Professional development and growth opportunities.
* Pay starts at $25 ~ $38/hour based on experience.

**About Westlake Financial**

Westlake Financial is the largest privately held auto finance company in the United States with demonstrated growth year over year. We continue to expand our teams and diversify our business model. This leads to cementing us as a leader in the automotive lending industry.

Westlake continues to grow its market share within the Auto Industry with assets in excess of 22B. We have business relationships in all 50 states, including Puerto Rico. Westlake Financial believes in PEOPLE with the PURPOSE and PASSION to assist our more than 22,000 dealer partners throughout North America.

Our Account Manager – Internal Sales Representatives are individuals with the vision and dedication to provide world-class customer service to our dealer partners through training and prospecting for business opportunities. This is a challenging, dynamic position with high earnings potential and opportunities for career advancement.

The Account Manager – Internal Sales Representative position offers a highly incentivized performance-based compensation package. A motivated and driven individual can earn up to and beyond a six-figure income.

We invite you to learn more about the position, please visit https://www.westlakefinancial.com/employee-recruitment/ (https://www.westlakefinancial.com/employee-recruitment/)

  

**Job Description**

Our Account managers create and nurture ongoing relationship contacts with our number one customer – our dealers. Your objective is to increase the number of deals funded by partnering with nationwide dealers who will be a good fit. Your ability to identify, onboard, and manage growth with dealers around the US from our headquarters office locations.

Being in a fast-paced environment, this role requires a consultative sales and management approach. Each Account Manager will manage their own dealer base to understand the Westlake Program so they can grow and succeed.

This is a full-time position including full-time benefits. We are looking for highly motivated, highly dedicated candidates who are comfortable working in an office-based team environment.

* New Hire training is provided to ensure your success in your new role. This training will prepare and provide you with proper knowledge and skills to perform the role successfully.

* We are a well-established and constantly growing auto finance company; we believe in PEOPLE with the PURPOSE and PASSION.

* Present and communicate company products and services to all levels of management within Independent and Franchise Dealerships
* Identify sales prospects and contact these and other accounts assigned to you
* Follow-up on new CRM generated leads and referrals resulting from telephone calls to Independent and Franchise Dealerships
* Develop, maintain and grow current and potential dealer partners within the Independent and Franchise Dealer communities
* Constant and effective communication via phone, email and video meetings with dealer partners to train on current programs and fast funding requirements
* Provide solutions, rehash and restructure vehicle loans for approval in a profitable manner for Westlake and the Dealership Partners

  

**Qualifications**

**Qualities we look for in our Account Manager - Internal Sales Representative?**

* Demonstrated experience in Automotive, Finance and Sales (preferred)
* 1-2 year’s previous experience in a Sales role with a proven track record of success
* High School Diploma required
* College degree (preferred or equivalent work experience)
* Strong knowledge of warm calling, appointment setting, and sales techniques
* Clear and effective presentation skills
* Strong Interpersonal and communication skills
* Knowledge of advertising and sales promotion techniques
* Strong computer skills, telephone management, and adaptability to new technology
* Goal oriented with a desire for improvement and advancement
* Able to communicate and work amicably with diverse teams

  

**Benefits**

**What is our pay plan?**

* Target first year income: $55,000.00 - $130,000.00
* Self-determined, performance-based compensation package
* Hourly position, $18.47/hr + performance-based commissions and bonuses
  + 6-month compensation guarantee of $5,000.00 monthly, Then another 6-month compensation guarantee of $4,000.00 monthly
  + Average rep earnings after 1 year - $160,000.00
  + Average earnings of the top 25% reps - $245,00.00
  + Average earnings of the top 50 reps - $305,000.00
* No limit on commissions
* The exact starting compensation to be offered will be determined at the time of selecting an applicant for hire and will be dependent on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to geographic location, skill set, experience, education, credentials, and licensure when applicable

  

**Full Time Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
* Life Insurance and Long-term disability plans
* Flexible Spending Account
* 401K matching
* Employee Stock Ownership Program in a $18.2 Billion Company, plus company matching
* Wellness Programs
* Metro Tap Card and Metro-link Reimbursement (for Los Angeles, CA employees only)
* Career Path Opportunities

* Annual Flu Shot

new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing and Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About:**  
IJW Whiskey Company, LLC (IJW) is a dynamic, fully integrated spirits company. Founded in 2017, we’ve compiled the largest independent library of aged Kentucky bourbon and rye and established a global presence including offices in Beverly Hills, Louisville and Tokyo, Japan, a 40-acre campus in Danville. Our ambitious growth trajectory includes a new whiskey distillery in Shelbyville, KY, slated for completion in early 2026, and a Japanese distillery in Chitose that that will be completed in late 2026.
  
  
With over 100 years of combined industry expertise, our diverse team of seasoned professionals and dynamic newcomers has propelled IJW to the forefront of the spirits industry. Our strategic partnership with one of the nation's largest independent Wine & Spirits distributors has enabled us to offer 22 products across four unique private label bourbon brands in 28 states. We have added to our spirits portfolio with our first Tequila and Mezcal brands.
  
  
Role Overview
  
The Digital Marketing and Social Media Manager, reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, is responsible for building and growing digital marketing as a key strategic pillar of the IJW organization. You will drive brand awareness, engagement, and e-commerce performance through social media, content marketing, influencer partnerships, and paid digital advertising. This role is ideal for a creative, data-driven marketer who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment and understands how to build impactful digital brand ecosystems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Digital Strategy and Execution
  

* Develop and implement integrated digital marketing strategies across social media, paid media, email, and SEO to enhance brand awareness and drive conversions.
* Lead and evolve IJW’s digital marketing function, aligning efforts with business goals and brand positioning.
* Manage digital marketing budgets, ensuring effective allocation across paid social, programmatic advertising, and e-commerce initiatives.

Social Media and Content Creation
  

* Oversee organic social media strategy and execution for all brands, ensuring engaging and brand-aligned storytelling.
* Build and nurture online communities, fostering brand advocacy and consumer engagement.
* Collaborate with internal and external teams to develop high-quality visual and written content.

E-Commerce and Digital Advertising
  

* Optimize global and local e-commerce strategies, ensuring seamless integration with third-party retailers and DTC platforms.
* Plan and execute paid digital campaigns to maximize brand visibility and consumer acquisition.

Analytics, Optimization, and Innovation
  

* Analyze performance metrics across all digital channels, providing insights to optimize strategies and improve ROI.
* Stay ahead of digital marketing trends, tools, and best practices to maintain a competitive edge.

**Qualifications:**  

* 5+ years of digital marketing experience, preferably in the spirits, beverage alcohol, or luxury consumer goods industry.
* Proven ability to grow social media communities, manage content creation, and drive digital engagement.
* Strong understanding of SEO, paid media, e-commerce marketing, and influencer strategy.
* Analytical mindset with experience using Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, and social media management tools.
* Entrepreneurial and creative thinker who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Passionate about the spirits industry, with a deep appreciation for whiskey, bourbon, and tequila.

Why Join IJW Whiskey Company?
  

* Industry Disruptor: Rapidly growing spirits company with a global footprint and a unique portfolio of premium brands.
* High-Impact Role: Entrepreneurial environment where your ideas drive real business results.
* Collaborative Culture: Work with experienced industry leaders in a creative, fast-paced, and dynamic team.
* Competitive Benefits: Attractive salary, benefits, and perks to reward top talent.

CODAN USA Corporation

**On-Site - Santa Ana, CA**

**Salary Range:** $25-$30 hourly+ commission/incentive opportunity

CODAN USA Corporation is seeking a motivated **Inside Sales Representative** to support continued growth across U.S. hospital, EMS, specialty-care, and distribution markets.

Working closely with the Inside Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager, the Inside Sales Representative will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, expanding existing customer relationships, supporting distributor growth initiatives, and advancing qualified opportunities through the sales process.

This is a hands-on sales role focused on proactive prospecting, lead qualification, account development, customer and distributor support, opportunity management, and sales administration. The ideal candidate is a results-oriented professional who enjoys building relationships, identifying new business opportunities, following up with customers, and working collaboratively across Sales, Customer Service, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Quality, and Product Management.

* Conduct proactive outbound prospecting to hospitals, health systems, EMS agencies, ambulatory surgery centers, specialty-care facilities, distributors, and other targeted customer segments.

new_jobs.description:
Are you a current Associate? To be considered, you must submit your application through the internal Career Portal (Jobs Hub). Click here to access.

**Time Type:**

Full time

**Remote Type:**

**Job Family Group:**

Sales

**Job Description Summary:**

This position is designed as a sales development role and will rotate through a number of different territories. The primary responsibility for this position will be to fill in open territories as needed in order to maximize the sales of supplier brands to the trade. This position may be asked to assist the Merchandising Department during particularly heavy merchandising periods.

**Job Description:**

**Job Responsibilities:**

Calls on accounts and covers daily routes by creating an established and efficient routing pattern.

* Prepares and delivers professional sales presentations to customers by balancing the company’s priorities and customer’s needs to include selling display ideas, new products, cold box, shelf, back bar placements and resets, drink and wine lists, and promotions.
* Maintains product levels in accounts by taking inventory and restocking shelves (where legal).
* Ensures maximum brand visibility within accounts by using effective and current point of sale materials when appropriate.
* Obtains payments for company by collecting and delivering checks or other remittance from accounts where legally permissible.
* Educates account staff by conducting educational staff training seminars on brands.
* Services accounts by delivering products to customers in extenuating circumstances, handling customer issues and complaints and referring these issues as appropriate to management.

Strategizes/preplans on how best to achieve sales and merchandising objectives by understanding company pricing and product programming information on a monthly basis and maintaining accurate historical account purchase information.

* Ensures national account compliance where applicable by accurately completing all necessary surveys.
* Understands the account’s buying patterns by reviewing the company pricing and product programming information on a monthly basis and maintains accurate historical account purchase information.
* Attains standards of performance goals by achieving the distribution, volume and activity goals of supplier brands as set by management.
* Manages customer account receivables by timely processing of credits and returns and communicating with accounts on aged receivables.
* Remains informed of company/supplier activities and updates by attending and actively participating in weekly sales meetings.

Other duties, as assigned by the jobholder’s supervisor, may also be required.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or equivalent training and work experience
* Minimum of 2 years’ experience in sales
* Basic PC skills using MS Office and other various computer programs including presentation software
* Must be a results-oriented professional with verbal/written communication skills using diplomacy and discretion as well as customer service skills
* Ability to multi-task, work independently and/or within a team, pay attention to detail and meet deadlines
* Analytic and Reporting skills
* Utilize sound judgement and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work in fast-paced, high-volume, team environment
* Have a valid driver’s license

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ability to hold a Solicitor’s Permit
* Understanding of wine and spirits

**Physical Requirements:**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to, stand, sit; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to reach overhead, squat and bend
* Carrying and lifting 45-65 pounds

**Competencies:**

* Accountable for results which impact the department.
* Selects best option from a set of defined procedures/ solutions using common sense and experience of similar situations.

*This job description is only a summary of the typical functions of this position, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible job responsibilities, tasks and duties. Responsibilities, tasks, and duties of individual jobholders may vary from the above description.*

***Salary and Benefit Statement:***

Any offered salary is determined based on internal equity, internal salary ranges, market data/ranges, applicant's skills, and prior relevant experience.

**Compensation**

* $45k - $50k Salary
* Mileage Reimbursement at 70 cents per Business Miles driven

**Benefits**

* Medical (HMO & PPO), Dental, Vision (PPO)401(k) matching.
* Annual PTO Accrual and holidays
* Rollover Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
* Free Life and AD&D Insurance Employee Assistance Program

Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.
