new_jobs.title: Inside Sales Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Inside Sales Manager**

CODAN USA Corporation

**On-Site - Santa Ana, CA**

**Salary Range:** $90,000-$105,000 base salary + commission/incentive opportunity

CODAN USA Corporation is seeking an experienced **Inside Sales Manager** to develop and lead a high-performing inside sales function supporting growth across U.S. hospital, EMS, specialty-care, and distribution markets.

Working closely with the Director of Sales and Regional Sales Managers, the Inside Sales Manager will be responsible for developing prospecting and account-development strategies, improving pipeline quality, advancing qualified opportunities, and supporting revenue growth through disciplined sales execution and customer engagement.

This is a hands-on sales leadership role that combines team development with direct involvement in business development, customer and distributor relationships, CRM and pipeline management, online-store operations, sales administration, and cross-functional coordination. The ideal candidate is a results-oriented sales professional who enjoys developing people, building customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and creating processes that improve sales performance and customer responsiveness.

* Lead and develop CODAN's U.S. inside sales function, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, training, and evaluating Inside Sales Representatives as the team grows.
* Establish standardized processes for prospecting, lead qualification, account development, quotation follow-up, sample requests, product evaluations, and opportunity management.
* Support Regional Sales Managers by qualifying leads, coordinating account-development activities, and managing the transfer of opportunities requiring field-sales involvement.
* Prioritize opportunities by territory, product category, distributor, customer segment, and revenue potential to maximize commercial impact.
* Develop targeted business-development campaigns for hospitals, health systems, EMS agencies, ambulatory surgery centers, specialty-care facilities, and distribution partners.
* Drive product growth through strategic distributor partners, including Medline, Cardinal Health, Owens & Minor, McKesson, Henry Schein, IMA, and regional distributors.
* Support growth initiatives across CODAN product categories, including Transfusion, EMS/Whole Blood, Cobra Coil, Trauma Flow, IV Administration, Extension Sets, Neo/Peds, and specialty or custom products.
* Establish and maintain Microsoft Dynamics 365 standards for opportunity tracking, pipeline management, activity documentation, forecasting, ownership, and follow-up accountability.
* Review pipeline activity with sales leadership and Regional Sales Managers to identify opportunities requiring pricing, product, engineering, quality, operational, or leadership support.
* Develop programs to reactivate dormant accounts, expand existing customer relationships, increase distributor penetration, and generate new business opportunities.
* Coordinate quotations, product evaluations, samples, customer onboarding activities, and cross-functional follow-up to improve conversion rates and customer responsiveness.
* Develop and maintain sales dashboards and reporting to provide visibility into pipeline health, sales activity, opportunity progression, conversion rates, revenue contribution, and customer engagement.
* Collaborate with Marketing on lead generation, campaigns, customer communications, product launches, and promotional initiatives.
* Support commercial leadership through account research, pricing analysis, forecasting, sales analytics, business intelligence, and special projects.
* Manage assigned customer and distributor relationships while ensuring timely responses to inquiries, issue resolution, customer retention, and account expansion opportunities.
* Oversee inbound sales inquiries and online-store activities, including customer communications, product updates, order coordination, and issue resolution.
* Support sales-order and customer-management workflows involving WooCommerce, Foundry, EDI, and Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Ensure customer interactions, sales activities, opportunities, account information, and follow-up actions are accurately documented and maintained within company systems.
* Monitor sales performance and key metrics, including pipeline progression, opportunity conversion, new accounts, dormant-account reactivation, distributor growth, evaluation-to-order conversion, pipeline aging, and follow-up responsiveness.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer service, sales operations, or a related commercial role preferred.
* 2+ years of leadership, supervisory, coaching, or team-development experience preferred.
* Experience in medical device, healthcare, distribution, manufacturing, or B2B sales strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to organize sales activity, improve follow-up discipline, develop opportunities, and maintain exceptional customer-service standards.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience using CRM systems to manage leads, activities, accounts, forecasts, and sales opportunities.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 experience preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, Teams, PowerPoint, and related business applications.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related discipline preferred; equivalent education and experience may be considered.
* Experience serving hospital, EMS, infusion, transfusion, acute-care, or healthcare distribution markets is highly desirable.

**Benefits**

Medical, dental and vision insurance

401(k) with company contribution

Paid vacation and sick time

Paid holidays

Commission/incentive opportunity

and more

Pay: $90,000.00 - $105,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Field Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
Inizio Engage has a long-standing partnership with Boehringer Ingelheim Pharmaceuticals to offer support for an expanding product portfolio in primary care.

We are seeking a performance driven Pharmaceutical Field Sales Representative with strategic problem- solving skills that can collaborate with multiple stakeholders. The Ideal candidate will demonstrate a track record of sales success or related experience, regardless of industry background. Pharmaceutical experience is not required. We are seeking individuals who can quickly make a meaningful impact, leveraging their proven ability to deliver results, build relationships, and adapt in a dynamic environment.

The Pharmaceutical Field Sales Representative will achieve sales and activity targets on assigned territories across primary care customers and meet all relevant standards as set by Inizio and Boehringer Ingelheim Pharmaceuticals leadership. This is your opportunity to join Inizio Engage and represent Boehringer Ingelheim Pharmaceuticals!

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

We believe great people deserve great support—at work and beyond. That’s why we offer a rewards experience designed to help you thrive personally, professionally, and financially:

* Competitive pay that recognizes your experience, expertise, and impact
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; accrued paid time off; 401(k) with company match; disability and life insurance; and paid maternity and paternity leave
* Company-paid holidays so you can rest, recharge, and focus on what matters most
* Recognition programs, contests, and awards that celebrate your contributions
* Continuous growth opportunities through learning, leadership development, and career advancement support
* A collaborative culture where your ideas are valued and your work makes a difference

We’re also proud to be recognized for creating an exceptional employee experience:

* Best Place to Work in BioPharma — 2022, 2023, 2025
* Certified Great Place to Work® — 2021, 2023, 2025, 2026

Learn more: https://www.greatplacetowork.com/certified-company/7003732

**What will you be doing?**

  

* Driving demand through clinical selling and education to targeted Physicians
* Establish, maintain and develop strong relationships with HCPs (includes physicians, Nurses, NP, PA, MA, etc.)
* Deliver sales messaging, patient and product information to targeted HCP offices
* Achieve or exceed activity targets as set by the company
* Complete administrative items daily
* Comply with all Boehringer Ingelheim Pharmaceuticals and Inizio policies, including compliance and ethics requirements, and trainings
* Effective time management and coordination of:
* Routing plans
* Daily/weekly call activities
* Demonstrate persistence towards accomplishing defined sales objectives
* Must have a dependable automobile with insurance coverage in compliance with company guidelines.
* Collaborate with geographic partners

**What do you need for this position?**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Business to Business sales experience preferred
* Comfort with Technology/Virtual Engagements
* Ability to travel up to 20% of time as required (some territories could be more than 20%)
* Overnight Travel Required
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record

The base pay range for this position is $70K – $90K per year. The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, internal equity, and business needs.

We're looking to add a Freelance Print Specialist / Production Coordinator to our freelance roster. This is an on-site role in Burbank, CA supporting our Production team with everything from color-accurate print proofs and client boards to packaging, shipments, and day-to-day production needs.

This is a great opportunity for someone with a strong understanding of print production who enjoys being part of a creative team and wants to be part of our go-to freelance roster for future projects.

**Responsibilities**

* Output color-accurate, large-format Epson print proofs
* Handle all printed materials with care to keep them in pristine condition
* Size, cut, mount, and accurately label boards for clients
* Pack and organize shipments so they reach clients on time
* Coordinate runner and courier services for pickups and deliveries
* Notify the Production Manager or Director when printing or packaging supplies are needed
* Assist in preparing client-facing deliverables, including PDFs, Keynotes, Google Slides presentations, copy documents, record sets and contact sheets

**Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of the printing process
* Detail-oriented, with the ability to multitask and respond to requests promptly
* Flexible and adaptable to changing schedules and circumstances
* Positive, professional communicator who supports the team and clients
* Able to work on-site, as this is an in-office position
* Knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, especially InDesign, Acrobat and Photoshop

**Requirements:**

* Reliable transportation to be on site in Burbank, CA

Rate: $20 - $30 / hour

new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager – DTC & Brand Growth
new_jobs.description:
**About Us** C Brands is a consumer brand in the smoke shop/c-store space with products sold online and through retail partners nationwide. We're growing our direct-to-consumer business and building new brands to branch out, and we're looking for a marketing leader to drive traffic, sales, and brand presence online.

**About the Role**This person will own DTC growth and website marketing across about six brand websites within C Brands, and will help launch and grow new brands over time. It is a strategy and execution role focused on building our online sales channels, running campaigns that convert, and growing our brands for the long term. It is not a social media role, and you won't be running day to day Instagram or TikTok posting.

**Duties**

* Build and grow our direct-to-consumer channels online
* Create and carry out marketing strategies for each brand to grow website traffic, conversions, and repeat customers
* Plan and run marketing campaigns across websites, email, SMS, and paid channels, and measure what drives sales
* Help launch new brands and products through marketing campaigns, from positioning to launch to driving conversions
* Grow brand presence and awareness for each brand online
* Manage and improve about six brand websites: content, product pages, landing pages, promotions, and the user experience
* Lead SEO efforts, including keywords, on-page optimization, site health, and content planning
* Run email and SMS marketing: campaigns, automated flows, list growth, and segmentation
* Plan and manage paid and affiliate channels where they are allowed for our category
* Track performance (traffic, conversion rate, average order value, customer lifetime value, return on spend) and report results to leadership
* Keep a clear calendar and workflow across all brands so launches, promotions, and updates stay on schedule
* Work with internal teams and outside vendors (designers, developers, agencies) to get projects done
* Keep marketing content compliant with the advertising rules and platform restrictions that apply to our industry

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in digital, e-commerce, or DTC marketing, including time managing websites and marketing strategy on your own
* A proven track record of growing sales revenue through DTC channels
* Experience planning and running marketing campaigns with measurable results
* Experience launching new brands or products through marketing campaigns, with proven conversions
* Strong organization, with experience juggling several brands or projects at once
* Experience managing multiple brands under one company
* Hands-on experience with e-commerce platforms such as Shopify or WooCommerce, Google Analytics, and email/SMS tools such as Klaviyo
* A working knowledge of SEO and conversion rate optimization
* Comfort with data: you set goals, measure results, and adjust
* Clear communicator who can work on their own and manage priorities
* Experience in the cannabis, hemp, CBD, or alcohol industry is a strong plus, along with familiarity with marketing in regulated categories (ad restrictions, payment and platform rules, compliance)
* Ability to build or develop websites is a plus

**Benefits**

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

**To Apply** Submit your resume and a cover letter. In your cover letter, please tell us:

* How you've grown sales revenue for a DTC brand, with specific results (for example, revenue growth, conversion rate, or traffic increases)
* A brand or product you helped launch, and how your marketing campaign performed
* Why you're interested in this role and in working with consumer brands in a regulated industry

Applications without a cover letter will not be considered.

Pay: $90,000.00 - $115,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
### **The Position**

Are you looking to make a meaningful impact in bioprocess development and join a collaborative team dedicated to scientific excellence? As a **Project Coordinator**, you will drive sample logistics and testing integrity to support critical process validation studies across our global network. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional technical teams and quality assurance to help deliver life-changing biopharmaceutical products to patients.

  
  

**The Opportunity:**

  
  

* Coordinate assigned Process Validation (PV) study samples across technical development teams, internal laboratories, and external contract manufacturing facilities.
* Ensure the integrity and progress of PV studies by meticulously following protocols, preparing samples, coordinating submissions, and accurately entering data.
* Proactively monitor study status, communicate updates to key stakeholders, and guarantee the quality and compliance of all completed work.
* Review PV protocols and reports for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with regulatory guidelines and internal sample testing standards.
* Generate, review, and approve PV data summary tables.
* Perform routine and non-routine analytical testing using techniques such as ELISA, PCR, U/HPLC, CE, LC-MS, and ICP-MS according to established protocols.
* Actively engage in clear and impactful communication across all organizational levels and escalate PV issues at team and department meetings to drive resolution.
* Attend PV and project meetings to represent the analytical operations team and ensure cross-functional alignment.
  

  

**Who you are:**

  
  

* You hold a Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related field.
* You have a minimum of 1 year of laboratory experience in biotechnology or a related area, along with knowledge of analytical methodologies.
* You possess familiarity and working knowledge of GxP, including documentation and compliance standards.
* You demonstrate meticulous attention to detail and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality, compliant work.
* You bring strong written and verbal communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
  

  

**Preferred:**

  
  

* Experience in project management within a biopharmaceutical or biotechnology setting.
  

  

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

  
  

The expected salary range for this position based in California is $90,100.00 - $167,300.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance.

It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. new_jobs.title: Program Coordinator (Youth Services RAICES)
new_jobs.description:
The **RAICES Program Coordinator** will provide gender-specific services to youth who are at risk. The RAICES Program Coordinator is responsible for the coordination and management of school groups. Will provide supervision to the Youth Engagement Counselors by checking in and supporting group facilitation as needed.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS / RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Primary Functions**

* Plan, coordinate, and evaluate gender-specific workshops, recreation and enrichment activities of the on-site and off-site RAICES program in accordance with contract regulations.
* Contact schools to coordinate groups for each cohort (Fall, Winter, Spring, and Summer Internship)
* Prepare and submit accurate reports as required by program, including monthly program reports to funding sources (DCYF) and the collection of evaluation and demographic data (surveys).
* Develop curriculum on gender specific topics such as healthy relationships, self-advocacy, hygiene, bullying, and others related to the DCYF contact.
* Supervise, evaluate and provide leadership development to Youth Engagement Counselors, Youth Interns, and volunteers involved in the RAICES program.
* Plan and implement project-based learning and experiential outings and activities to enhance youth learning and skill development.
* Plan outreach and resource events for the community, youth, schools, etc as part of the contract requirement.
* Ensure that all contact requirements are implemented, documented, and met.
* Support a program environment that is learner centered promotes a sense of physical and emotional safety.
* Support positive relationships between staff and youth, and between youth and their peers.
* Conduct case consultations and check-ins with the Youth Engagement counselors.
* Provide resources to youth, schools, families, community, and Youth Engagement Counselors.
* Communicate with school, community, public agencies and parents/guardians of youth.
* Supervise, evaluate and provide leadership development to youth interns and volunteers involved in the program.
* Ensure all youth completed the intake forms and communicate with youth families to complete.
* Utilize HUBB software to keep track of all youth’s profiles.
* Ensure Youth Engagement Counselors are completing incident reports on HUBB when youth disclose anything that would be reportable and is required to document.
* Provide individual follow-up services and information and referrals to youth as needed and to other MNC youth services and community services.
* Coordinates, schedules, and handles all logistical details of the weekly check ins and group coordination.
* Review CMS data and prepare monthly program reports.
* Develops and oversees outreach plan to recruit target population into case RAICES program.

* Monitors school advocacy efforts including school meetings such as parent conferences, IEP meetings, school disciplinary meetings, as necessary.
* Attending meetings with the Associate Director.
* Support the hiring process, selecting, interviewing, and filling out forms required to hire new employees in the department. Also, assist with the onboarding/offboarding of Youth Engagement Counselors.
* Supporting other MNC Programs as needed.

**Secondary Functions**

* Collaborate in the planning and production of community events including Dia de los Muertos, Holiday/Winter break, Black History month, Carnival SF, Spring break, family nights, program graduations and showcase, etc.
* Recruit in kind service providers to implement gender specific activities, cultural enrichment, health and wellness, youth leadership, and other enrichment activities within the program.
* Create partnerships with other organizations.
* Advocate for youth needs, providing referral information, when appropriate to internal and external services based on individual youth needs. Provide individual follow-up services to clients as needed.
* Collaborate with community to coordinate services.
* Represent MNC at appropriate community forums and funder meetings/trainings; maintain superior customer service with funders, staff, collaborating agencies, parents, and youth. Adequately inform, share information, and collaborate with anyone benefiting from the RAICES program.
* Maintain accurate program records and follow reporting procedures. Compile, analyze, verify, and submit data according to the funding schedule and guidelines.
* Participate in weekly staff meetings, 1:1 supervision, and as training courses are offered.
* Ensure team is completing all training, progress reports, and required documentation for program.
* Actively participate in the creation and implementation of a personal staff development plan striving for self-improvement.
* Must be available to participate in late afternoon, evening, and some weekend activities as needed (including Memorial Day Weekend, during school breaks, and MNC events).
* Ensuring that the curriculum, orders, and any required document is updated and completed.
* Collaborate with program staff to identify individual needs and create proactive strategies that foster social-emotional growth and success.
* Provide case consultations and support to staff, ensuring holistic and trauma-informed approaches.
* Maintain accurate program records and submit data in accordance with funding and reporting requirements.
* Attend required team meetings (weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly). Coordinate services with other MNC programs and community partners to ensure smooth referrals and continuity of care.
* Assist with planning and participating in MNC-sponsored community and cultural events.
* Supporting other MNC Programs as needed.

new_jobs.description:
**SALES COORDINATOR**

**Hotel Emblem**

***Temporary Position through April 2027***

**ABOUT THE PROPERTY**

Located in the heart of San Francisco where Nob Hill meets Union Square and the Theater District, Hotel Emblem is a distinctive boutique hotel inspired by the city’s Beat Generation and creative spirit. The 96-room property features eclectic accommodations, a book-filled Writer’s Alcove, Obscenity Bar & Lounge, Bluestone Lane Coffee Shop, and unique programming including live jazz, poetry events, and literary experiences. With its bold design, intimate atmosphere, and central downtown location, Hotel Emblem offers guests an experience that celebrates self-expression, creativity, and the unexpected.

**THE ROLE**

As Sales Coordinator, you’ll support the General Manager and Director of Sales in growing hotel revenue through group and business transient business. You’ll help manage sales leads and accounts, coordinate group bookings, support the sales process, and work closely with hotel teams to make sure every opportunity is followed through. You will:

* Support the General Manager and Director of Sales with day-to-day sales initiatives
* Assist with developing new group, business transient, and local business opportunities
* Conduct outreach to prospective accounts and help qualify new leads
* Maintain and grow relationships with existing accounts
* Support group bookings, including guest rooms, meetings, banquets, and F&B opportunities
* Assist with catering and sales activities as needed
* Respond promptly to sales inquiries, referrals, and customer correspondence
* Follow up on leads, accounts, and repeat business opportunities
* Maintain accurate account and group information in the sales system
* Confirm group bookings within approved availability and rate guidelines
* Stay informed about local competitors, market conditions, and hotel offerings
* Support site tours, networking events, civic activities, and other sales opportunities
* Communicate group arrangements and client needs to hotel departments
* Help create a positive, collaborative environment across Sales and Catering
* Promote other Parable-managed hotels when appropriate
* Prepare sales reports and assist with other projects and assignments

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

Sales opportunities are organized, followed up on, and moving forward. Leads and accounts are accurately documented, group arrangements are clearly communicated, and the Sales team has a reliable partner who helps turn opportunities into business while creating a positive experience for clients and hotel teams.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* 1+ year of hotel sales or Front Desk experience
* Interest in developing a career in hotel sales
* Strong communication, presentation, organization, and follow-up skills
* Comfortable with outreach, relationship building, and customer service
* Ability to manage multiple leads, accounts, and priorities
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate sales records
* Professional and positive approach with guests, clients, and team members
* Ability to make sound decisions and use good judgment
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* English speaking or bilingual
* Dependable, organized, and team-oriented
* Ability to lift/carry up to 35 lbs.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
* 401(k)
* Vacation & Sick Leave
* Team Member Travel Program: Hotel & Dining discounts
* Opportunities to connect, give back, and build community through team events & volunteering.

**POSITION DETAILS**

* Hourly Rate Range: $28.00 - $32.00
* Full-Time, Temporary Position through April 2027

Reunirse con los coordinadores o anfitriones del grupo antes de la recepción, realizar las presentaciones y asegurarse de que todos los preparativos se encuentren acordados. Leer y analizar el pedido del banquete para el evento a fin de reunir la información de los huéspedes, determinar la organización adecuada, la cronología, las necesidades específicas de los huéspedes, los bufés, los puestos de comida, etc. Atender y tratar de cumplir con todos los preparativos especiales para el banquete del evento. Realizar un seguimiento de los preparativos especiales para el banquete del evento para asegurar su cumplimiento.

Cumplir con todas las políticas y procedimientos de seguridad de la compañía; informar cualquier problema de mantenimiento, peligros para la seguridad, accidentes o lesiones; completar la capacitación y certificaciones sobre seguridad. Asegurarse de que tanto el uniforme como la apariencia personal sean pulcros y profesionales. Mantener la privacidad de la información propiedad de la compañía; proteger sus bienes. Apoyar a todos los compañeros de trabajo y tratarlos con dignidad y respeto. Dar apoyo al equipo para alcanzar metas comunes. Cumplir las expectativas y los estándares de aseguramiento de la calidad. Mover, levantar, transportar, empujar, arrastrar y colocar objetos con un peso inferior a 25 libras (11,25 Kg) o su equivalente sin asistencia. Estar de pie, sentarse o caminar durante períodos prolongados o durante el turno de trabajo completo. Leer y verificar visualmente información en varios formatos (por ejemplo, las letras menudas). Inspeccionar visualmente herramientas, equipos o máquinas (por ejemplo, para identificar defectos). Alcanzar por encima de la cabeza y debajo de la rodillas, incluso agacharse, girar la cintura, arrastrar e inclinarse. Moverse por espacios angostos, confinados o elevados. Moverse por superficies inclinadas, desniveladas o resbalosas y escalinatas. Subir y bajar escalinatas y/o rampas de servicio. Acoger y reconocer a todos los huéspedes de acuerdo con las normas de la compañía. Hablar con otras personas usando un lenguaje claro y profesional; contestar las llamadas telefónicas usando la etiqueta apropiada. Efectuar otras tareas de trabajo razonables solicitadas por sus supervisores

Educación: Título de estudios secundarios o certificado equivalente de un programa de Desarrollo de Educación General

(General Educational Development, GED).

Con más de 100 hoteles galardonados en todo el mundo, las damas y caballeros de The Ritz-Carlton crean experiencias tan excepcionales que el huésped recuerda durante mucho tiempo, incluso cuando ya se ha ido. Queremos atraer a los mejores profesionales del sector hotelero del mundo para que creen recuerdos duraderos, ya que creemos que todos tienen éxito cuando están empoderados para ser creativos, amables y compasivos.

Todos los días, establecemos los estándares para un servicio de lujo excepcional y especial en todo el mundo y nos enorgullecemos de brindar excelencia en el cuidado y el confort de los huéspedes.

Los estándares de oro son la base de The Ritz-Carlton, lo que nos guía para que cada día sea mejor que el anterior. Gracias a esta base y la creencia de que nuestra cultura conduce al éxito, The Ritz Carlton se ha ganado la reputación de marca mundial líder en el sector hotelero de lujo. Además, te prometemos que te ofreceremos la oportunidad de estar orgulloso del trabajo que haces y de tu equipo.

Al unirte a The Ritz-Carlton, te unes a una cartera de marcas con Marriott International. **Estarás** donde puedes llevar a cabo tu mejor trabajo, **comenzarás** a cumplir tu propósito, **formarás parte** de un increíble equipo mundial y **te convertirás** en tu mejor versión.

new_jobs.description:
**AT&T Account Sales Representative**

San Jose Business Solutions is expanding its sales team and is seeking an AT&T Account Sales Representative to represent AT&T products and services while building strong customer relationships and supporting account growth. This position is suited to a motivated professional who enjoys connecting with customers, understanding their needs, presenting solutions, and working toward measurable sales goals.

The AT&T Account Sales Representative will be responsible for engaging directly with customers, learning about their communication needs, presenting relevant AT&T products and services, and guiding customers through available options. The role requires strong communication skills, a customer-focused approach, confidence in sales conversations, and the ability to work effectively in a performance-driven environment.

**Responsibilities:**

* Engage with customers to understand their telecommunications needs, preferences, and priorities.
* Present AT&T wireless products, services, plans, devices, and features in a clear and professional manner.
* Recommend appropriate AT&T solutions based on individual customer requirements.
* Conduct sales conversations and confidently communicate the value and benefits of available products.
* Assist customers with new account enrollments, upgrades, activations, and service selections.
* Build and maintain positive customer relationships throughout the sales process.
* Identify opportunities to introduce additional products or services that may benefit the customer.
* Maintain accurate customer information, sales documentation, and account records.
* Follow established sales procedures and contribute toward individual and team performance goals.

**Candidate Requirements:**

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Strong verbal and written communication abilities.
* Confident and professional approach to customer interactions.
* Motivated by goals, performance, and opportunities to develop professionally.
* Ability to understand customer needs and communicate suitable solutions.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment.
* Previous experience in sales, customer service, retail, telecommunications, account management, or business development is beneficial but not mandatory.
* Reliable transportation to assigned work locations.

**Career Development & Benefits**

San Jose Business Solutions is committed to providing team members with the training, coaching, and professional development necessary to build a successful career in sales.

* Comprehensive paid training and structured onboarding.
* Ongoing sales coaching and professional development.
* Hands-on experience with AT&T products, services, and customer engagement.
* Opportunities to strengthen sales, communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Performance-based incentive opportunities.
* Collaborative workplace with dedicated leadership and team support.
* Full-time opportunity with direct exposure to a recognized telecommunications campaign.
* Potential for increased responsibility and professional advancement based on performance and business needs.

Bring your communication skills, ambition, and willingness to learn to an AT&T Account Sales Representative opportunity where your performance can help shape your growth. Benefits:

Education:

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, Strategic Accounts
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

A Strategic Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with AWS high-value strategic customer. Key aspects of the role include:  
  

* Relationship Management: Building deep, multi-threaded executive relationships, serving as the primary point of accountability for the overall account.

  

* Strategic Account Planning: creating and executing long-term account strategy that span quarters (not weeks), aligning cross-functional resources e.g. sales, customer success, product, and executive leadership.

  

* Revenue Expansion: owning revenue growth and identifying growth opportunities proactively, often before the customer realizes the need.

  
Key job responsibilities  
Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for a strategic account and owning the overall account strategy, relationship health, and long-term growth trajectory  
  
Develop and execute multi-year strategic account plans that align AWS services and solutions with customer business objectives, driving adoption across compute, storage, database, analytics, AI/ML, and generative AI workloads  
  
Build and maintain deep, multi-threaded executive relationships across all levels of the customer organization  
  
Drive revenue growth by identifying expansion opportunities, accelerating new workload migrations, and positioning AWS as the preferred cloud platform across the customer's global operations  
  
Collaborate cross-functionally with AWS specialist teams, solutions architects, partner managers, professional services, and executive leadership to deliver tailored solutions that address complex customer needs  
  
Lead strategic negotiations for large-scale enterprise agreements, including Enterprise Discount Programs (EDPs), Private Pricing Agreements (PPAs), and Marketplace procurement strategies  
  
Act as the customer's advocate within Amazon, influencing product roadmaps and service improvements by capturing and communicating customer feedback, feature requests, and competitive insights  
  
Monitor account health metrics, pipeline development, and revenue attainment against targets, proactively identifying and mitigating risks to retention and growth

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
* 10+ years of sales or sales management in infrastructure or cloud technology experience
* Experience in managing global stakeholders
* Experience leading and interacting with cross-functional teams
* 5+ years of business development, or account management with a proven ability to deliver results experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with customers on substantial, strategic, and complex software or cloud services/infrastructure deals from opportunity through closure
* Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
* Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint
* Experience in building and developing a high performance team

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments, restricted stock units (RSUs), and sales incentives. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

  
USA, CA, Mountain View - 187,000.00 - 252,900.00 USD annually

new_jobs.description:
**Full time • San Francisco, CA • $80K – $90K base • $130K – $160K OTE**

Parameter builds AI agents that do offensive security work. Our agents run autonomous penetration tests against production applications and cloud environments, finding IDORs, broken access control, XSS, and infrastructure misconfigurations that scanners miss and that human pentest firms only look for once or twice a year.

We are not a theoretical security company. Our team has responsibly disclosed real, high-severity vulnerabilities to well-known technology companies, and our findings are the front door to most of our customer relationships.

Our best conversations start the same way: we find something real in a prospect's environment and tell them about it. You'll own the top of that funnel. That means researching accounts, working with the security team on what we found, and writing the outbound that makes a CISO reply within the hour.

This is not a role where you read a script into a dialer. The people you're emailing break software for a living and can tell within one line whether you understand their problem. You'll need to learn enough security to be credible: what an IDOR is, why broken access control is the thing that keeps them up, and why a once-a-year pentest doesn't cover a codebase that ships daily.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own outbound to security and engineering leaders: build the account list, write the sequences, and run the follow-up
* Turn our vulnerability research into first meetings. When we find something real, you're the reason the right person hears about it
* Book and prepare qualified calls for the founders, and sit in on them until you're running discovery yourself
* Keep the CRM honest. Clean data, accurate stages, and a pipeline number nobody has to caveat
* Close the loop on messaging. Tell us which lines land, which segments convert, and what we should stop saying

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 1+ years of outbound sales development, ideally into technical buyers, or a track record that makes the case some other way
* You write well. Short, specific, and free of the phrasing every other vendor in their inbox is using
* Genuine curiosity about security. You do not need a background in it, but you do need to want one
* Comfort with rejection and with volume. The job is a lot of activity and a small number of very good conversations
* You build your own leverage: research workflows, enrichment, automation, whatever gets you more at-bats without more hours
* Bonus: sold into security or developer tools, worked at an early-stage startup, or hold a security certification

* Intro call with a founder (30 minutes)

new_jobs.title: Digital Skilling Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Position Description: **Who We Are:**

Hispanic Federation (HF) is the nation's premier Latino nonprofit membership organization. Founded in 1990, HF supports Hispanic families and strengthens Latino institutions through grantmaking and direct services in the areas of education, health, immigration, civic engagement, economic empowerment and the environment. Values that drive our work include equality, fairness, diversity, and empathy.

Technological advancements are changing the workforce requirements of our economy. According to Brookings, nearly two-thirds of all new jobs created since 2010 required either high or medium level digital skills. Latinos make up 18% of the overall U.S. labor market and account for approximately one out of every two new workers entering the workforce in 2025 but also make up 35% of workers with no digital skills; 20% of those with limited skills; and only 8% of all STEM jobs. Hispanic Federation's Digital Skilling Program seeks to address these issues through community-based workforce development and technology trainings.

  

**Who we seek:**

Hispanic Federation (HF) seeks a Digital Skilling Program Coordinator to help manage and contribute to HF’s Workforce Initiatives programmatic efforts aimed at increasing the financial security of Latino families. Under the supervision of the Workforce Initiatives Program Manager, the coordinator will be instrumental in supporting administrative and reporting duties for a technology program running three (3) cycles a year at three (3) locations within New York City. The coordinator will learn the intricacies of community outreach, workforce development, program management, technology training programs, digital adoption programs, and poverty reduction efforts.

  

The successful candidate is detail-oriented and has experience and interest in technology training programs, workforce development, and nonprofits. The position requires a high attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and a commitment to increasing workforce development opportunities to underserved communities.

  

**Position Location:** New York, NY

**Reports to:** Workforce Initiatives Program Manager

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming and active program participants providing guidance through the entire program lifecycle and tracking attendance and engagement
* Coordinate day-to-today logistics across site locations for program cycles
* Weekly travel within New York City to the Bronx, Queens and Manhattan
* Prepare, organize, and update digital and physical course materials and cohort schedules
* Administer, distribute, and collect mid-cohort and closeout evaluation surveys; organize qualitative feedback and quantitative ratings into summary decks
* Travel nationally once a year to participate in a train-the-trainer program
* Manage regular communication with program leadership and stakeholders to provide updates on program health, and/or additional support
* Maintain accurate records and provide timely program activity reports
* Ensure compliance with all reporting requirements and prepare programmatic reports
* Serve as point of contact to other program service providers, grantees, and consultants, monitoring performance, funding, and payments
Complete additional tasks as assigned  

  

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* Minimum of a bachelor's degree and demonstrated knowledge of non-profit programs and services within underserved low-income communities preferably centered around digital equity and workforce development
* At least one (1) year of professional experience in administration, logistics, adult education and / or program management
* Excellent technology skills; experience with Office 365, conference platforms, and third-party databases
* Efficient, detail-oriented and organized
* Ability to multi-task and balance assignments from more than one staff person
* Strong, well-developed verbal and writing skills
* Exceptional ability to work with others and develop trust with partner agencies, staff and program participants
* Commitment to Hispanic Federation's mission and core values
* Willingness to learn new technology programs, including AI tools and the Swift Programming Language
* Familiarity with Apple products and systems is a plus, but not required
Fluency in written and spoken Spanish is a plus, but not required  

  

**Compensation**

The salary for this position is $55,000. Compensation includes fully subsidized medical, dental, vision insurance accessible on first day of employment; access to flexible spending for medical and transportation; and a 403 (B) retirement plan with a company match after 6 months of service.

**To Apply**

Please submit a résumé and cover letter detailing your interest and qualifications via the dedicated link. No telephone calls or emails will be accepted regarding this position. Only specific candidates will be contacted regarding their application for this role.

Hispanic Federation is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against actual or perceived race, color, religion, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, creed, disability, marital status, sexual orientation and/or other protected categories.

For more information about the Hispanic Federation, go to www.hispanicfederation.org.

new_jobs.title: Residence Program Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Why Join ADAPT?**

It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.

For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**

Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
* Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.
* Ensures all actions are conducted in a manner that prevents abuse, neglect, or exploitation, and immediately reports any concerns in accordance with agency policy.
* Follows all OPWDD-approved behavior management guidelines, including use of approved interventions when required.
* Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
* Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
* Valid New York State Driver’s License, maintained in good standing
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $20.17/hour (after probation) + Industry-Leading Benefits for all full-time employees.

**At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging.** We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.

ADAPT Community Network is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified candidates of diverse ethnic and racial backgrounds and status are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

new_jobs.description:
Clinical Research Nurse Practitioner and clinical research rater (Senior Level) — Psychiatry & Neurology

About Us

Manhattan Behavioral Medicine is an independent clinical research site conducting industry-sponsored trials in psychiatry and neurology.

We are seeking a Clinical Research Nurse Practitioner to bring both advanced clinical expertise and senior-level research operations experience to our psychiatry and neurology trials. In this hybrid role, you will provide protocol-directed clinical assessment and medical oversight in partnership with our Principal Investigator, while also leading study coordination activities and mentoring our research staff. This position is ideal for an NP who has worked as a senior or lead Clinical Research Coordinator and understands what it takes to run industry-sponsored drug trials well from both the clinical and operational sides.

Key Responsibilities

**Clinical Responsibilities**

* Perform protocol-required clinical assessments, including medical and psychiatric histories, physical and neurological exams, and review of concomitant medications, within NP scope of practice and under PI delegation.
* Assess participant eligibility and ongoing suitability for study participation, in collaboration with the Principal Investigator.
* Evaluate, document, and follow up on adverse events and serious adverse events, including causality and severity assessment as delegated; ensure timely reporting to sponsors and the IRB.
* Conduct participant safety monitoring, including suicidality assessment (e.g., C-SSRS), vital signs, ECGs, and review of laboratory results.
* Administer or oversee standardized psychiatric and neurological rating scales and cognitive assessments per protocol.
* Serve as sub-investigator on select studies where permitted by state law, institutional policy, and sponsor requirements.
* Provide clinical guidance to the research team on medical questions and participant concerns, and escalate urgent issues to the PI as appropriate.

**Study Leadership & Coordination**

* Serve as lead clinical and operational point of contact on assigned industry-sponsored drug trials, from site initiation through closeout.
* Partner with sponsors, CRAs, and monitors; prepare for and support site initiation visits, monitoring visits, and audits.
* Ensure compliance with ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and sponsor requirements across regulatory documentation, source documentation, and informed consent processes.
* Oversee investigational product accountability, EDC data entry, and query resolution in collaboration with coordination staff.
* Support IRB submissions, protocol amendments, and continuing reviews.
* Mentor and train clinical research coordinators and other research staff on protocol requirements, clinical procedures, and best practices.
* Contribute to site feasibility assessments, recruitment and retention planning, and process improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

* Active, unrestricted license as a Nurse Practitioner (APRN) in NY and NJ, with national board certification (e.g., PMHNP-BC, FNP-BC, AGNP-BC, or equivalent).
* Master's degree (MSN) or Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) from an accredited program.
* Minimum of [2–3] years of clinical research experience, including prior experience as a senior or lead Clinical Research Coordinator on industry-sponsored drug trials.
* Experience in psychiatry and/or neurology clinical trials.
* Strong working knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines, FDA regulations, and human subjects protection requirements.
* Current GCP and human subjects research training; current BLS/CPR certification.
* Proficiency with EDC systems and clinical trial management systems.
* Excellent clinical judgment, organizational skills, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent studies.

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior experience serving as a sub-investigator on FDA-regulated trials.
* Experience with CNS rating scale training and certification processes.
* Certification such as CCRC (SOCRA) or CCRP (ACRP).
* DEA registration and prescriptive authority, as applicable to the role.
* Experience mentoring or supervising research staff.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**About the Role**
------------------

At LoadUp, our partners count on us to take care of their customers the same way we take care of our own. As an Account Manager, Partnerships, you'll own the day-to-day relationship with a portfolio of partner accounts, including e-commerce brands, retailers, moving and logistics companies, and property managers. You'll report to the Director of Strategic Partnerships and work closely with Accounting, Operations, and Partner Support to keep accounts running smoothly and build partner relationships that support retention and growth. This is a full-time role.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Set up new partner accounts end-to-end, including credit applications, required compliance documentation, and partner portal credentials

* Respond promptly to partner questions about their account, orders, and reporting, escalating platform or data limitations when needed
* Troubleshoot account access and login issues for new and existing users
* Monitor outstanding invoices for assigned accounts and follow up on overdue balances on a predictable, proactive cadence
* Resolve invoice discrepancies with the Accounting team and provide supporting documentation, such as proof of service and receipts, on request
* Uphold LoadUp's brand values in every partner interaction
* Travel occasionally (up to 25% of the time) for partner visits, industry conferences, and trade shows

### **What You'll Bring**

* 2+ years of experience in account management, partner or vendor support, customer success, or a similar client-facing operations role
* Excellent written communication skills with a professional, service-oriented tone, and a commitment to consistent, timely responses to partner emails and account issues
* Strong organization, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and open items at once without dropping details
* A calm, patient, solutions-first approach to resolving concerns from frustrated partners or customers
* Basic familiarity with invoicing and accounts receivable workflows
* A team-first attitude and the ability to collaborate across Accounting, Operations, and Partner Support
* Experience with a CRM (ideally HubSpot) and support or ticketing tools preferred
* Experience in logistics, delivery, e-commerce, or a related industry preferred
* Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, preferred

### **Benefits**

* Competitive compensation
* Health & wellness coverage
* Generous paid time off
* 401(k) with 5% company match
* Monthly lifestyle stipends, employee recognition programs, and referral bonuses

#### **About LoadUp**

LoadUp is a tech-powered, on-demand junk removal and home services platform, connecting individuals and businesses nationwide with a vetted network of local providers for removal, disposal, assembly, and hourly labor. Founded in 2014, LoadUp set out to replace an industry known for hidden fees and vague pricing with real-time, upfront pricing and dependable local pros — no guessing, no surprises, just honest service done right. Today, LoadUp is one of the largest on-demand junk removal and home services platforms in the country. We've been named to Inc.'s 5000 list of Fastest-Growing Companies and have been a certified Great Place to Work since 2019. As we continue growing, we're looking for talented, driven people who want to help reimagine what this industry can be.

Onsite | Avalon, Alpharetta, GA (Metro Atlanta / Greater Atlanta / North Atlanta)

We have a passion for hospitality culinary delights on every elevated floor and in the sky. With our three business segments, Airline Catering, International Event Catering, Restaurants, Lounges & Hotels, we offer gourmet entertainment all over the world. We operate in 33 locations, 12 countries and 3 Continents, maintaining the highest standard of quality in both our products and services. We refine the classics, develop the unknown and grow constantly – sometimes beyond our own expectations.

* Provide technical oversight and guidance for sanitation programs across DO & CO’s U.S. facilities.
* Develop, standardize, and continuously improve SSOPs, Master Sanitation Schedules, cleaning procedures, and verification standards.
* Conduct sanitation assessments across production areas, ready-to-eat environments, equipment, coolers, freezers, dishrooms, drains, docks, and waste areas.

* Verify the proper selection, concentration, labeling, storage, dispensing, and use of sanitation chemicals.
* Ensure cleaning practices follow manufacturer instructions and established sanitation procedures.
* Evaluate equipment and facilities for harborage points, damaged surfaces, standing water, condensation, deteriorated seals, and other contamination risks.
* Participate in sanitation reviews for new equipment, renovations, construction projects, and process changes.
* Partner with Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, FSQA, chemical suppliers, and facility leadership to resolve sanitation-related deficiencies.
* Review pest-control programs, activity trends, and corrective actions with FSQA and facility leadership.
* Assess waste-handling areas, docks, compactors, recycling areas, and exterior conditions for sanitation and pest risks.

* Evaluate cleaning and tool-control practices designed to prevent allergen and Halal/non-Halal cross-contact.
* Lead sanitation-related investigations and root-cause analyses.
* Develop risk-based corrective and preventive action recommendations.
* Verify the completion and sustained effectiveness of sanitation CAPAs.
* Identify recurring findings across facilities and recommend long-term, systemic solutions.
* Escalate significant sanitation and food safety risks to FSQA leadership.
* Develop and deliver technical training on SSOPs, GMPs, chemical safety, sanitation verification, environmental pathogen controls, and cross-contamination prevention.
* Coach Sanitation Managers, supervisors, FSQA personnel, Operations teams, and frontline employees.
* Verify training effectiveness through field observations and follow-up assessments.
* Support FDA inspections, customer audits, third-party audits, and internal food safety assessments.
* Assist facilities with regulatory observations, customer findings, CAPAs, and effectiveness verification.
* Promote sanitation as a critical food safety preventive control and shared organizational responsibility.

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Food Safety, Biology, Environmental Health, Public Health, Food Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* At least five years of progressive experience in food manufacturing, airline catering, commissary operations, sanitation, food safety, or quality assurance.
* Strong working knowledge of food sanitation, GMPs, HACCP, Environmental Monitoring Programs, sanitation verification, and preventive controls.
* Demonstrated experience conducting sanitation inspections, investigations, root-cause analyses, and corrective-action follow-up.
* Experience identifying microbiological, sanitation, hygienic-design, allergen, and cross-contamination risks in complex food-production environments.
* Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Capable of working independently while effectively influencing and collaborating with cross-functional tea

**About the Department**

The Del Rios lab, housed within the section of Emergency Medicine, centers on identifying and mitigating place-based barriers to preventing and surviving catastrophic medical emergencies. We partner with multidisciplinary, multi-institutional research teams to combine rigorous quantitative methods, community engagement, and implementation-focused approaches to address urgent public health challenges, including out-of-hospital cardiac arrest, respiratory virus communication, and the mental health effects of structural and policy environments on minoritized youth. The Strategic Account Manager, Dermatology - Chicago / Indiana plays a crucial role in the Company's mission to transform lives through innovative treatments in immuno-dermatology. Reporting to the Western Regional Account Director, this position is responsible for developing and executing strategic business plans that align with the organization's sales objectives while adhering to all regulatory and compliance standards. The Strategic Account Manager will engage in daily consultations with prescribers and key office personnel, ensuring a deep understanding of the prescribing platforms utilized within these offices. The role also involves daily interactions with pharmacies to ensure the appropriate application of patient access resources, as well as educating prescribers and their staff on the resources available to optimize access to Dermavant's product portfolio. Building and maintaining strong relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and pharmacies is a key responsibility, as is sharing best practices and proactive communication with peers. Participation in company-sponsored events and meetings is also expected, contributing to the overall success of the organization and its mission to improve the lives of those with chronic skin conditions.

new_jobs.description:
**Social Media Manager — Empire Restaurant Group**  
**Location: Naperville and Lombard, Illinois**

Empire Restaurant Group is looking for a creative, organized, and consistent Social Media Manager to bring our restaurants to life online.

Our portfolio includes Empire Burgers & Brew in Naperville and Lombard, Hizemans, Fiamme, The Northcott, The George, and The Belmont. Each restaurant has its own personality, and we want someone who can capture what makes each one special—from a great burger and a busy game day to an exceptional steak dinner or cocktail.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll spend time in our restaurants, build relationships with our teams, and create content that makes people want to visit.

**What you’ll do**

* Manage Instagram, Facebook, and other relevant social channels across our restaurants.
* Shoot and edit engaging photos, short videos, Reels, and Stories.
* Build and maintain a content calendar with consistent posting for every location.
* Promote menu items, specials, events, private dining, and new offerings.
* Work with restaurant managers to identify timely content and promotional opportunities.
* Respond to comments and messages professionally and promptly.
* Coordinate local creator partnerships and paid social campaigns.
* Track results and provide a simple monthly report on audience growth, engagement, and actions that support restaurant visits and bookings.
* Maintain a distinct voice and visual style for each restaurant.

**Who we’re looking for**

* Experience managing social media for restaurants, hospitality, lifestyle, or consumer brands.
* Strong photography, video editing, and writing skills.
* Comfortable creating content with a phone and appearing on camera or directing others when needed.
* Organized enough to manage multiple brands and meet deadlines.
* Someone who follows through consistently and takes ownership without needing daily reminders.
* An eye for good food, atmosphere, and the details that make hospitality memorable.
* Ability to travel between Naperville and Lombard, with occasional evening and weekend availability to capture events and busy service periods.

**What success looks like**

A steady stream of quality content, recognizable personalities for each restaurant, timely promotion of what’s happening, and measurable progress in turning online attention into guests walking through our doors.

**To apply**

Send your résumé, links to accounts you’ve managed, and three examples of content you personally created. Tell us briefly how you would approach managing social media for several restaurants with different personalities. You will need to send examples of posts that you would create for our brands, either screen shots or shared files etc.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, **Divcon** delivers fully integrated automation solutions *nationwide* that optimize performance, energy efficiency, and reliability across HVAC, lighting, power monitoring, and mission-critical systems. Leveraging advanced technologies - including Allen-Bradley PLCs, Ignition SCADA, and Delta DDC systems - we combine deep technical expertise with field-tested execution to deliver precise, scalable, and high-performance solutions.

**About the role:**

TheAssistant Project Manager (APM) supports the planning, coordination, and execution of building automation and controls projects from installation through commissioning and turnover. This role is responsible for managing defined portions of projects and smaller-scale jobs while developing the skills required for full project ownership.

Working under the guidance of a Project Manager or Sr. Project Manager, the APM plays a key role in coordinating field activities, maintaining project documentation, and supporting budget and schedule tracking. This position is designed as a transitional step toward a full Project Manager role.

Please note our office address is 1702 4th Ave NW West Fargo, North Dakota 58078.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Project Execution Support**

* Assist in coordinating day-to-day execution of BAS/controls projects to ensure alignment with engineering designs, schedules, and customer requirements.
* Manage defined scopes of work or smaller projects under supervision.
* Support development and maintenance of project schedules, including milestone tracking and updates.

**Documentation & Project Controls**

* Obtain, organize, and maintain project documentation including contracts, drawings, and specifications.
* Assist in reviewing submittals and drawing packages prior to field execution.
* Maintain accurate project records in DivPro, including notes, milestones, and billing support data.

**Field & Subcontractor Coordination**

* Coordinate subcontractors and Controls Technicians for assigned project scopes.
* Support commissioning activities by tracking progress and ensuring task completion.
* Conduct site visits as needed to monitor progress and document field conditions.

**Financial & Administrative Support**

* Track purchase orders, change orders, and project expenses.
* Assist in monitoring project budgets and identifying potential variances.
* Support monthly billing processes and milestone reporting for review by the Project Manager.
* Assist with review of technician timecards for alignment with project work.

**Communication & Stakeholder Support**

* Participate in project meetings and provide updates on progress, risks, and issues.
* Support customer communication and help manage expectations on schedules and deliverables.
* Escalate project risks or issues to the Project Manager in a timely manner.

**Qualifications:**

* 2–3 years of experience in construction, project coordination, or related field (BAS, MEP, HVAC preferred).
* Experience supporting project execution, documentation, or field coordination.
* Exposure to project scheduling, subcontractor coordination, or construction processes preferred.
* Working knowledge of building automation systems, HVAC controls, or electrical systems preferred.
* Strong organizational, coordination, and time management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Effective communication skills with both internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management software platforms.
* OSHA 30 certification obtained within the past two (2) years is required.
* + If certification is not current or has not been completed, OSHA 30 training will be provided and must be successfully completed within the first week of employment.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to travel frequently to job sites by car or plane, up to 95%
* Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout job sites for extended periods
* Ability to climb ladders, stairs, and lifts as required
* Ability to bend, kneel, crouch, and work in tight or confined spaces
* Ability to lift, carry, and maneuver equipment and materials up to 50 pounds
* Manual dexterity to handle tools, wiring, and small components
* Ability to work at heights and in varying indoor and outdoor conditions
* Ability to wear and work in personal protective equipment when required (hard hat, vest, safety glasses, gloves, and safety-toed boots)
* Visual keenness to read schematics, labels, and digital displays
* Ability to visually identify and differentiate wires by assigned color
* Ability to hear and respond to alarms, equipment sounds, and verbal instructions
* Capability to safely operate hand and power tools

**Benefits & Total Rewards:**

* **Opportunities for Growth**

Hands-on training and career advancement in an exploding data-center industry.

* **Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance**

We cover 100% of individual medical premiums and help offset the cost of family coverage.

* **401K with Employer Match**

Eligible after 90 days, with company matching to help you invest in your future.

* **Disability Coverage**

Both short- and long-term disability insurance provided at no cost to our employees.

* **Flexible PTO**

Take time off when you need it, no accruing time necessary.

* **Field-Based Employee Benefits**

For eligible field-based roles that require travel, Divcon covers all business travel expenses and provides a per diem, phone allowance, tools, and PPE at no cost. Eligible employees also receive paid training and additional reimbursable business expenses.

Divcon does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Agencies must have a signed agreement in place prior to submitting any candidate. Unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Divcon, and no fees will be paid.
